Nota do Foundry

Esse recurso não automatiza a alternância entre as opções de magias preparadas.

Land's Aid.name: Auxílio da Terra
Land's Aid.description:
Como uma ação mágica, você pode gastar um uso de Forma a Selvagem e escolher um ponto a até 18 metros de você. Flores de vitalidade e espinhos que drenam vida aparecem por um momento dentro de uma esfera de 3 metros de raio centrada nesse ponto. Cada criatura à sua escolha nessa esfera deve fazer uma salvaguarda de Constituição contra sua CD para evitar magia, sofrendo 2d6 pontos de dano necrótico se falhar, ou metade desse dano em caso de sucesso. Além disso, uma criatura à sua escolha nessa área recupera [[/healing @scale.land.lands-aid]]{[[lookup @scale.land.lands-aid]] pontos de vida}.

O dano e a cura aumentam em 1d6 quando você atinge os níveis de druida 10 (3d6) e 14 (4d6).

Nota do Foundry

Esse recurso inclui uma atividade para a Salvaguarda e cura.

Os valores de cura/dano são ajustados automaticamente à medida que você sobe de nível.

Wild Resurgence.name: Ressurgimento Selvagem
Wild Resurgence.description:
Uma vez a cada um de seus turnos, se não tiver mais usos de Forma Selvagem, você pode recuperar um uso gastando um espaço de magia (nenhuma ação necessária).

Além disso, você pode gastar um uso de Forma Selvagem (nenhuma ação necessária) para recuperar um de seus espaços de magia de 1° círculo, mas não pode fazer isso novamente até que termine um descanso longo.

Nota do Foundry

A atividade Recuperar Forma Selvagem consome um espaço de magia e concede a você mais uma utilização da Forma Selvagem.

A atividade Recuperar Espaço de Magia consumirá uma utilização da Forma Selvagem e concederá a você um espaço de magia de 1º círculo.

Regain Spell Slot.name: Recuperar Espaço de Magia
Regain Spell Slot.condition: Uma vez a cada um de seus turnos

Regain Wild Shape.name: Recuperar Forma Selvagem
Regain Wild Shape.condition: Uma vez a cada um de seus turnos

Lightning Bolt.name: Lightning Bolt
Lightning Bolt.description:
A stroke of lightning forming a 100-foot-long, 5-foot-wide Line blasts out from you in a direction you choose. Each creature in the Line makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking 8d6 Lightning damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

Usando Espaços de Magia de Círculo Superior. The damage increases by 1d6 for each spell slot level above 3.
Lightning Bolt.materials: a bit of fur and a crystal rod

Misty Step.name: Misty Step
Misty Step.description: Briefly surrounded by silvery mist, you teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see.

Sleep.name: Sleep
Sleep.description:
Each creature of your choice in a 5-foot-radius Sphere centered on a point within range must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or have the &Reference[incapacitated apply=false] condition until the end of its next turn, at which point it must repeat the save. If the target fails the second save, the target has the &Reference[unconscious] condition for the duration. The spell ends on a target if it takes damage or someone within 5 feet of it takes an action to shake it out of the spell's effect.

Creatures that don't sleep, such as elves, or that have Immunity to the Exhaustion condition automatically succeed on saves against this spell.
Sleep.materials: a pinch of sand or rose petals

Sleeping.name: Sleeping
Sleeping.description: The target has the &Reference[incapacitated apply=false] condition until the end of its next turn, at which point it must repeat the save. If the target fails the second save, the target has the &Reference[unconscious] condition for the duration. The spell ends on a target if it takes damage or someone within 5 feet of it takes an action to shake it out of the spell’s effect.

Shocking Grasp.name: Shocking Grasp
Shocking Grasp.description:
Lightning springs from you to a creature that you try to touch. Make a melee spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes 1d8 Lightning damage, and it can't make Opportunity Attacks until the start of its next turn.

Aprimoramento de Truque. The damage increases by 1d8 when you reach levels 5 (2d8), 11 (3d8), and 17 (4d8).

Shocked.name: Shocked
Shocked.description: The target can’t make Opportunity Attacks until the start of its next turn.

Guidance.name: Orientação
Guidance.description: Você toca uma criatura disposta e escolhe uma perícia. Até a magia terminar, a criatura adiciona 1d4 a todos os testes de atributo usando a perícia escolhida.

Starry Wisp.name: Starry Wisp
Starry Wisp.description:
You launch a mote of light at one creature or object within range. Faça um ataque mágico à distância contra o alvo. On a hit, the target takes 1d8 Radiant damage, and until the end of your next turn, it emits Dim Light in a 10-foot radius and can't benefit from the &Reference[Invisible] condition.

Aprimoramento de Truque. The damage increases by 1d8 when you reach levels 5 (2d8), 11 (3d8), and 17 (4d8).

Illuminated.name: Illuminated
Illuminated.description: Until the end of your next turn, it emits Dim Light in a 10-foot radius and can’t benefit from the &Reference[Invisible] condition.

Shillelagh.name: Shillelagh
Shillelagh.description:
A Club or Quarterstaff you are holding is imbued with nature's power. For the duration, you can use your spellcasting ability instead of Strength for the attack and damage rolls of melee attacks using that weapon, and the weapon's damage die becomes a d8. If the attack deals damage, it can be Force damage or the weapon's normal damage type (your choice).

The spell ends early if you cast it again or if you let go of the weapon.

Aprimoramento de Truque. The damage die changes when you reach levels 5 (d10), 11 (d12), and 17 (2d6).

Aid.name: Aid
Aid.description:
Choose up to three creatures within range. Each target's Hit Point maximum and current Hit Points increase by 5 for the duration.

Usando Espaços de Magia de Círculo Superior. Each target's Hit Points increase by 5 for each spell slot level above 2.

Level 2: +5 Max HP.name: Level 2: +5 Max HP
Level 2: +5 Max HP.description: The target's Hit Point maximum is increased for the duration.

Level 3: +10 Max HP.name: Level 3: +10 Max HP
Level 3: +10 Max HP.description: The target's Hit Point maximum is increased for the duration.

Level 4: +15 Max HP.name: Level 4: +15 Max HP
Level 4: +15 Max HP.description: The target's Hit Point maximum is increased for the duration.

Level 5: +20 Max HP.name: Level 5: +20 Max HP
Level 5: +20 Max HP.description: The target's Hit Point maximum is increased for the duration.

Level 6: +25 Max HP.name: Level 6: +25 Max HP
Level 6: +25 Max HP.description: The target's Hit Point maximum is increased for the duration.

Level 7: +30 Max HP.name: Level 7: +30 Max HP
Level 7: +30 Max HP.description: The target's Hit Point maximum is increased for the duration.

Level 8: +35 Max HP.name: Level 8: +35 Max HP
Level 8: +35 Max HP.description: The target's Hit Point maximum is increased for the duration.

Level 9: +40 Max HP.name: Level 9: +40 Max HP
Level 9: +40 Max HP.description: The target's Hit Point maximum is increased for the duration.

Darkvision.name: Visão no Escuro
Darkvision.description: For the duration, a willing creature you touch has &Reference[darkvision] with a range of 150 feet.

Darkvision.name: Visão no Escuro
Darkvision.description: For the duration, a willing creature you touch has &Reference[darkvision] with a range of 150 feet.

Goodberry.name: Goodberry
Goodberry.description:
@UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbutlMagicalBer]{Ten berries} appear in your hand and are infused with magic for the duration. A creature can take a Bonus Action to eat one berry. Eating a berry restores 1 Hit Point, and the berry provides enough nourishment to sustain a creature for one day.

Uneaten berries disappear when the spell ends.

Lesser Restoration.name: Lesser Restoration
Lesser Restoration.description: You touch a creature and end one condition on it: &Reference[blinded], &Reference[deafened], &Reference[paralyzed], or &Reference[poisoned].

Longstrider.name: Longstrider
Longstrider.description:
You touch a creature. The target's Speed increases by 10 feet until the spell ends.

Usando Espaços de Magia de Círculo Superior. Ao conjurar esta magia utilizando um espaço de magia de 2º círculo ou superior, você pode escolher uma criatura adicional como alvo para cada círculo do espaço acima do 1º.

Longstrider.name: Longstrider
Longstrider.description: The target’s Speed increases by 10 feet until the spell ends.

Moonbeam.name: Moonbeam
Moonbeam.description:
A silvery beam of pale light shines down in a 5-foot-radius, 40-foot-high Cylinder centered on a point within range. Until the spell ends, Dim Light fills the Cylinder, and you can take a Magic action on later turns to move the Cylinder up to 60 feet.

When the Cylinder appears, each creature in it makes a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 2d10 Radiant damage, and if the creature is shape-shifted (as a result of the Polymorph spell, for example), it reverts to its true form and can't shape-shift until it leaves the Cylinder. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage only. A creature also makes this save when the spell's area moves into its space and when it enters the spell's area or ends its turn there. A creature makes this save only once per turn.

Usando Espaços de Magia de Círculo Superior.The damage increases by 1d10 for each spell slot level above 2.

Revivify.name: Revivify
Revivify.description: You touch a creature that has died within the last minute. That creature revives with 1 Hit Point. This spell can't revive a creature that has died of old age, nor does it restore any missing body parts.
Revivify.materials: a diamond worth 300+ GP, which the spell consumes

Spike Growth.name: Spike Growth
Spike Growth.description:
The ground in a 20-foot-radius Sphere centered on a point within range sprouts hard spikes and thorns. The area becomes Difficult Terrain for the duration. When a creature moves into or within the area, it takes [[/damage 2d4 type=piercing]] damage for every 5 feet it travels.

The transformation of the ground is camouflaged to look natural. Any creature that can't see the area when the spell is cast must take a Search action and succeed on a [[/check ability=wis skill=prc dc=@attributes.spell.dc]] or [[/check ability=wis skill=sur dc=@attributes.spell.dc]] check against your spell save DC to recognize the terrain as hazardous before entering it.

Potion of Healing.name: Potion of Healing
Potion of Healing.description: This potion is a magic item. As a Bonus Action, you can drink it or administer it to another creature within 5 feet of yourself. The creature that drinks the magical red fluid in this vial regains 2d4 + 2 Hit Points.

Protection from Evil and Good.name: Protection from Evil and Good
Protection from Evil and Good.description: Until the spell ends, one willing creature you touch is protected against creatures that are Aberrations, Celestials, Elementals, Fey, Fiends, or Undead. The protection grants several benefits. Creatures of those types have Disadvantage on attack rolls against the target. The target also can't be possessed by or gain the &Reference[Charmed apply=false] or &Reference[Frightened apply=false] conditions from them. If the target is already possessed, Charmed, or Frightened by such a creature, the target has Advantage on any new saving throw against the relevant effect.
Protection from Evil and Good.materials: a flask of Holy Water worth 25+ GP, which the spell consumes

Protected.name: Protegido
Protected.description: Creatures of those types have Disadvantage on attack rolls against the target. The target also can’t be possessed by or gain the &Reference[Charmed apply=false] or &Reference[Frightened apply=false] conditions from them.

Create or Destroy Water.name: Create or Destroy Water
Create or Destroy Water.description:
You do one of the following:

Create Water. You create up to 10 gallons of clean water within range in an open container. Alternatively, the water falls as rain in a 30-foot Cube within range, extinguishing exposed flames there.

Destroy Water. You destroy up to 10 gallons of water in an open container within range. Alternatively, you destroy fog in a 30-foot Cube within range.

Usando Espaços de Magia de Círculo Superior. You create or destroy 10 additional gallons of water, or the size of the Cube increases by 5 feet, for each spell slot level above 1.
Create or Destroy Water.materials: a mix of water and sand

Detect Magic.name: Detect Magic
Detect Magic.description:
For the duration, you sense the presence of magical effects within 30 feet of yourself. If you sense such effects, you can take the Magic action to see a faint aura around any visible creature or object in the area that bears the magic, and if an effect was created by a spell, you learn the spell's school of magic.

The spell is blocked by 1 foot of stone, dirt, or wood; 1 inch of metal; or a thin sheet of lead.

Detect Poison and Disease.name: Detect Poison and Disease
Detect Poison and Disease.description:
For the duration, you sense the location of poisons, poisonous or venomous creatures, and magical contagions within 30 feet of yourself. You sense the kind of poison, creature, or contagion in each case.

The spell is blocked by 1 foot of stone, dirt, or wood; 1 inch of metal; or a thin sheet of lead.

Wild Shape.name: Forma Selvagem
Wild Shape.description:
O poder da natureza permite que você assuma uma forma animal. Como uma ação bônus, você muda de forma para uma fera na qual aprendeu a se transformar com esta característica (veja “Formas Conhecidas” abaixo). Você permanece nessa forma por um número de horas igual à metade do seu nível de druida (atualmente [[lookup @classes.druid.levels]]) ou até usar Forma Selvagem novamente, ficar sob a condição incapacitado ou morrer. Você também pode abandonar a Forma Selvagem como uma ação bônus.

Número de Usos. You can use Wild Shape twice. You regain one expended use when you finish a Short Rest, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest.

You gain additional uses when you reach certain Druid levels, as shown in the Wild Shape column of the @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.content24.JournalEntry.phbDruid00000000.JournalEntryPage.UCOh3zlvGxyk5jLr#class-features]{Druid Features} table.

Número de Usos Atual: [[lookup @scale.druid.wild-shape-uses]]

Formas Conhecidas. You know four Beast forms for this feature, chosen from among Beast stat blocks that have a maximum Challenge Rating of 1/4 and that lack a Fly Speed. The @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.actors24.Actor.mmRat00000000000]{Rato}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.actors24.Actor.mmRidingHorse000]{Cavalo de Montaria}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.actors24.Actor.mmSpider00000000]{Aranha}, and @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.actors24.Actor.mmWolf0000000000]{Lobo} are recommended. Whenever you finish a Long Rest, you can replace one of your known forms with another eligible form.

Automação da Forma Selvagem

Depois de selecionar a criatura na qual você deseja se transformar por meio da característica Forma Selvagem, basta arrastá-la para a sua ficha de personagem, selecionar a opção Forma Selvagem e o Foundry atualizará automaticamente sua ficha. Você pode reverter a transformação na parte superior da sua ficha ou clicando com o botão direito do mouse no seu Personagem na barra lateral.

Ao atingir determinados níveis de druida, seu número de formas conhecidas e o nível de desafio máximo para essas formas aumentam, conforme a tabela Formas de Fera. Além disso, a partir do nível 8, você pode adotar uma forma que tenha deslocamento de voo.

Máximo Atual de Formas Conhecidas: [[lookup @scale.druid.known-forms]]

ND Máximo Atual: [[lookup @scale.druid.wild-shape]]

Ao escolher formas conhecidas, você pode consultar o Livro dos Monstros
Formas de Fera
Nível de DruidaFormas ConhecidasND MáximoDeslocamento de Voo
241/4Não
461/2Não
881Yes

Regras Enquanto Transformado. Enquanto estiver em uma Forma Selvagem, você mantém sua personalidade, memórias e a capacidade de falar, e as seguintes regras se aplicam:

Pontos de Vida Temporários. Ao assumir uma Forma Selvagem, você ganha um número de pontos de vida temporários igual ao seu nível de druida.

Estatísticas de Jogo. Suas estatísticas de jogo são substituídas pelo bloco de estatísticas da fera, mas você mantém seu tipo de criatura, pontos de vida, dados de vida, valores de Inteligência, Sabedoria e Carisma, características de classe, idiomas e talentos. Você também mantém suas proficiências em salvaguardas e perícias e usa seu bônus de prociência para elas, além de ganhar as proficiências da criatura. Se um modificador de salvaguarda ou perícia no bloco de estatísticas da fera for maior que seu, use o do bloco de estatísticas.

Sem Conjuração. Você não pode conjurar magias, mas mudar de forma não quebra sua concentração nem interfere de qualquer outra maneira com magias que você já tenha lançado.

Objetos. Sua habilidade de manipular objetos é deterinada pelos membros da criatura em vez dos seus. Além disso, você escolhe se o seu equipamento cai no espaço que você ocupava antes de se transformar, funde-se à sua nova forma ou é usado por ela. O equipamento usado funciona normalmente, mas o DM decide se é prático para a nova forma usar determinado equipamento com base no tamanho e na forma da criatura. Seu equipamento não muda de tamanho ou de forma para corresponder à nova forma, e qualquer equipamento que ela não possa usar deve cair no chão ou se fundir a ela. Os equipamentos que se fundem a essa forma animal não têm efeito enquanto você estiver transformado nela.

Nota do Foundry

Você pode ativar esse recurso para acompanhar o uso da sua Forma Selvagem.

Ele restaurará automaticamente um uso durante um Descanso Curto e todos os usos durante um Descanso Longo.

AothLv1100000000.name: Aoth
AothLv1100000000.description:
Aoth lived among animals for so long that he now has difficulty speaking Common. His natural habitat in danger, he decided to join an adventuring group to return balance to his land.

Token artwork by Forgotten Adventures.

Token artwork by Forgotten Adventures.

Human.name: Human
Human.description:
@Embed[Compendium.dnd5e.content24.JournalEntry.phbAppendixSpeci.JournalEntryPage.phbspHuman000000 inline classes="free-rules-embed"]

Human Traits

Tipo de Criatura: Humanoide

Tamanho: Médio (de 1,2 a 2 metros de altura) ou Pequeno (de 0,5 a 1,2 metro de altura), escolhido ao selecionar esta espécie

Speed: 30 feet

Como alguém desta espécie, você tem os seguintes traços especiais.

Resourceful. You gain Heroic Inspiration whenever you finish a Long Rest.

Skillful. You gain proficiency in one skill of your choice.

Versatile. You gain an Origin feat of your choice (see chapter 5). Skilled is recommended.

dLxv96vt2B2KOEe2.hint: Médio (about 4-7 feet tall) ou Pequeno (about 2-4 feet tall), escolhido ao selecionar esta espécie

Skillful.title: Skillful
Skillful.hint: You gain proficiency in one skill of your choice.

Versatile.title: Versatile
Versatile.hint: You gain an Origin feat of your choice. Skillful is recommended.

Resourceful.name: Resourceful
Resourceful.description: You gain Heroic Inspiration whenever you finish a Long Rest.

Skillful.name: Skillful
Skillful.description:
You gain proficiency in one skill of your choice.

Nota do Foundry

You will be prompted for this choice when you select this Species.

Versatile.name: Versatile
Versatile.description:
You gain an @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.content24.JournalEntry.phbFeats00000000.JournalEntryPage.otAeQs0TLHYIBNuj]{Origin feat} of your choice. @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.feats24.Item.phbftSkilled0000]{Skilled} is recommended.

Nota do Foundry

You will be prompted for your choice when you select this Species.

Skilled.name: Habilidoso
Skilled.description:
Você ganha proficiência em qualquer combinação de três perícias ou ferramentas à sua escolha.

Repetível. Você pode obter este talento mais de uma vez.

Recluse.name: Recluse
Recluse.description:
Valores de Atributo: Destreza, Constituição, Sabedoria

Talento: Alert

Proficiências em Perícias: Medicine, Religion

Proficiência com Ferramentas: Herbalism Kit

Equipamento: Choose A or B: (A) @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagCaseMaporSc]{Scroll Case}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagBlanket0000], @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagClothesTrav], @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbtulHerbalismK], [[/award 41gp]]; ou (B) [[/award 50gp]]

Alert.name: Alerta
Alert.description:
Você ganha os seguintes benefícios.

Proficiência em Iniciativa. Ao rolar iniciativa, você pode adicionar seu bônus de proficiência ao resultado.

Troca de Iniciativa. Imediatamente após rolar iniciativa, você pode trocar sua iniciativa com a de um aliado disposto no mesmo combate. You can't make this swap if you or the ally has the &Reference[Incapacitated] condition.

Nota do Foundry

Essa característica adiciona automaticamente o bônus à sua Iniciativa.

Druid.name: Druida
Druid.description:
Core Druid Traits

Atributo Primário

Sabedoria

Dado de Vida

D8 per Druid level

Proficiências em Salvaguardas

Intelligence and Wisdom

Proficiências em Perícias

Escolha 2: Animal Handling, Arcana, Insight, Medicine, Nature, Perception, Religion, or Survival

Armas simples

Equipamento Inicial

@Embed[Compendium.dnd5e.content24.JournalEntry.phbAppendixClass.JournalEntryPage.phbdrdDruid00000 inline classes="free-rules-embed"]

Becoming a Druid …

Como um Personagem de 1º Nível

  • Gain all the traits in the Core Druid Traits table.
  • Gain the Druid's level 1 features, which are listed in the Druid Features table.

Como um Personagem Multiclasse

  • Gain the following traits from the Core Druid Traits table: Hit Point Die and training with Light armor and Shields.
  • Gain the Druid's level 1 features, which are listed in the Druid Features table. Veja as regras de multiclasse no capítulo 2 para determinar seus espaços de magia disponíveis.

Primal Order.title: Ordem Primordial
Primal Order.hint: Você se dedicou a uma das seguintes funções sagradas à sua escolha.

Elemental Fury.title: Fúria Elemental
Elemental Fury.hint: O poder dos elementos flui através de você. Você ganha uma das seguintes opções à sua escolha.

Druidic.title: Druídico
Druidic.hint: Você conhece Druídico, o idioma secreto dos druidas.

Spellcasting.name: Conjuração
Spellcasting.description:
As a student of arcane magic, you have learned to cast spells. See the @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.content24.JournalEntry.phbSpells0000000.JournalEntryPage.b2QVn25z2N1ykWpf]{rules on spellcasting}. The information below details how you use those rules with Wizard spells, which appear in the @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.content24.JournalEntry.phbSpells0000000.JournalEntryPage.6AnqLUowgdsqMFvz]{Lista de Magias do Mago}.

Cantrips. You know three Wizard cantrips of your choice. @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplLight00000]{Luz}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplMageHand00]{Mãos Mágicas}, and @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplRayofFrost]{Ray of Frost} are recommended. Whenever you finish a Long Rest, you can replace one of your cantrips from this feature with another Wizard cantrip of your choice.

When you reach Wizard levels 4 and 10, you learn another Wizard cantrip of your choice, as shown in the Cantrips column of the @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.content24.JournalEntry.phbWizard0000000.JournalEntryPage.g7cMRWzsgAsEF7zC#class-features]{Wizard Features table}.

Spellbook. Your wizardly apprenticeship culminated in the creation of a unique book: your spellbook. It is a Tiny object that weighs 3 pounds, contains 100 pages, and can be read only by you or someone casting @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplIdentify00]{Identify}. You determine the book's appearance and materials, such as a gilt-edged tome or a collection of vellum bound with twine.

The book contains the level 1+ spells you know. It starts with six level 1 Wizard spells of your choice. @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplDetectMagi]{Detectar Magia}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplFeatherFal]{Feather Fall}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplMageArmor0]{Mage Armor}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplMagicMissi]{Magic Missile}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplSleep00000]{Sleep}, and @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplThunderwav]{Thunderwave} are recommended.

Whenever you gain a Wizard level after 1, add two Wizard spells of your choice to your spellbook. Each of these spells must be of a level for which you have spell slots, as shown in the Wizard Features table. The spells are the culmination of arcane research you do regularly.

Espaços de Magia. The Wizard Features table shows how many spell slots you have to cast your level 1+ spells. You regain all expended slots when you finish a Long Rest.

Magias Preparadas de 1º Círculo ou Maior. Você prepara a lista de magias de 1° círculo ou maior disponíveis para conjuração com esta característica. To do so, choose four spells from your spellbook. The chosen spells must be of a level for which you have spell slots.

The number of spells on your list increases as you gain Wizard levels, as shown in the Prepared Spells column of the Wizard Features table. Whenever that number increases, choose additional Wizard spells until the number of spells on your list matches the number in the table. The chosen spells must be of a level for which you have spell slots. For example, if you're a level 3 Wizard, your list of prepared spells can include six spells of levels 1 and 2 in any combination, chosen from your spellbook.

If another Wizard feature gives you spells that you always have prepared, those spells don't count against the number of spells you can prepare with this feature, but those spells otherwise count as Wizard spells for you.

Mudando Suas Magias Preparadas. Whenever you finish a Long Rest, you can change your list of prepared spells, replacing any of the spells there with spells from your spellbook.

Spellcasting Ability. Intelligence is your spellcasting ability for your Wizard spells.

Foco de Conjuração. You can use an Arcane Focus or your spellbook as a Spellcasting Focus for your Wizard spells.

Druidic.name: Druídico
Druidic.description:
You know Druidic, the secret language of Druids. While learning this ancient tongue, you also unlocked the magic of communicating with animals; you always have the @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplSpeakwithA]{Falar com Animais} spell prepared.

You can use Druidic to leave hidden messages. You and others who know Druidic automatically spot such a message. Others spot the message's presence with a successful [[/check inv 15]] check but can't decipher it without magic.

Nota do Foundry

Druidic and Speak with Animals are automatically added during advancement.

Primal Order.name: Ordem Primordial
Primal Order.description:
Você se dedicou a uma das seguintes funções sagradas à sua escolha.

Magician. You know one extra cantrip from the Druid spell list. Além disso, sua conexão mística com a natureza lhe dá um bônus nos seus testes de Inteligência (Arcanismo ou Natureza). The bonus equals your Wisdom modifier (minimum bonus of +1).

Warden. Treinado para a batalha, você adquire proficiência com armas Marciais e treinamento com armadura Média.

Nota do Foundry

You will be prompted to choose during advancement.

Speak with Animals.name: Speak with Animals
Speak with Animals.description:
For the duration, you can comprehend and verbally communicate with Beasts, and you can use any of the Influence action's skill options with them.

Most Beasts have little to say about topics that don't pertain to survival or companionship, but at minimum, a Beast can give you information about nearby locations and monsters, including whatever it has perceived within the past day.

Primal Order: Warden.name: Ordem Primordial: Guarda
Primal Order: Warden.description:
Treinado para a batalha, você adquire proficiência com armas Marciais e treinamento com armadura Média.

Nota do Foundry

Essa característica inclui um Efeito Ativo que automatiza a adição das proficiências em armas marciais e o treinamento com armaduras médias.

Case, Map or Scroll.name: Case, Map or Scroll
Case, Map or Scroll.description: A Map or Scroll Case holds up to 10 sheets of paper or 5 sheets of parchment.

Blanket.name: Cobertor
Blanket.description: While wrapped in a blanket, you have Advantage on saving throws against extreme cold (see @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.content24.JournalEntry.dmgDmsToolbox000.JournalEntryPage.xgLA30rErlkjIPAK]{Gameplay Toolbox}).

Clothes, Traveler's.name: Traje de Viajante
Clothes, Traveler's.description: Traveler's Clothes are resilient garments designed for travel in various environments.

Herbalism Kit.name: Herbalism Kit
Herbalism Kit.description:
Atributo: Intelligence

Usar: Identify a plant (DC 10)

Criação: @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagAntitoxin00]{Antitoxin}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagCandle00000]{Candle}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagHealersKit0]{Kit de Curandeiro}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagPotionofHea]{Potion of Healing}

Shield.name: Escudo
Shield.description: Você ganha o benefício de classe de armadura de um escudo somente se tiver treinamento com ele.

Staff.name: Staff
Staff.description:
An @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagArcaneFocus]{Arcane Focus} is bejeweled or carved to channel arcane magic. A Sorcerer, Warlock, or Wizard can use such an item as a Spellcasting Focus.

This item also functions as a @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbwepQuartersta]{Bastão}

Nota do Foundry

This item has been configured with the additional properties of a Quarterstaff.

Explorer's Pack.name: Explorer's Pack
Explorer's Pack.description: An Explorer's Pack contains the following items: @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagBackpack000]{Mochila}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagBedroll0000]{Saco de Dormir}, 2 frascos de @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagOil00000000]{Óleo}, 10 dias de @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagRations0000]{Rações}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagRope0000000]{Corda}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagTinderbox00]{Caixa para Fogo}, 10 @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagTorch000000]{Tochas}, and @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagWaterskin00]{Cantil}.

Tinderbox.name: Caixa para Fogo
Tinderbox.description: A caixa para fogo é um pequeno recipiente contendo sílica, pederneira e uma acendalha (geralmente pano seco embebido em óleo) usada para atear fogo. Suas utilidades incluem, como uma ação bônus, acender vela, lamparina, lanterna ou tocha, bem como qualquer outro objeto com combustível exposto. Acender outros tipos de fogo leva 1 minuto.

Rope.name: Corda
Rope.description:
As a Utilize action, you can tie a knot with Rope if you succeed on a DC 10 Dexterity (Prestidigitação) check. The Rope can be burst with a successful DC 20 Strength (Athletics) check.

You can bind an unwilling creature with the Rope only if the creature has the &Reference[Grappled], &Reference[Incapacitated], or &Reference[Restrained] condition. If the creature's legs are bound, the creature has the Restrained condition until it escapes. Escaping the Rope requires the creature to make a successful DC 15 Dexterity (Acrobatics) check as an action.

Bedroll.name: Saco de Dormir
Bedroll.description: A Bedroll sleeps one Small or Medium creature. While in a Bedroll, you automatically succeed on saving throws against extreme cold (see @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.content24.JournalEntry.dmgDmsToolbox000]{Gameplay Toolbox}).

Waterskin.name: Cantil
Waterskin.description: A Waterskin holds up to 4 pints. If you don't drink sufficient water, you risk &Reference[dehydration].

Water (Pint).name: Água (Quartilho)
Water (Pint).description: If you don't drink sufficient water, you risk &Reference[dehydration].

Oil.name: Óleo
Oil.description:
You can douse a creature, object, or space with Oil or use it as fuel, as detailed below.

Dousing a Creature or an Object. When you take the Attack action, you can replace one of your attacks with throwing an Oil flask. Target one creature or object within 20 feet of yourself. The target must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw (DC 8 plus your Dexterity modifier and Proficiency Bonus) or be covered in oil. If the target takes Fire damage before the oil dries (after 1 minute), the target takes an extra [[/damage 5 type=fire]] damage from burning oil.

Dousing a Space. You can take the Utilize action to pour an Oil flask on level ground to cover a 5-foot-square area within 5 feet of yourself. If lit, the oil burns until the end of the turn 2 rounds from when the oil was lit (or 12 seconds) and deals 5 Fire damage to any creature that enters the area or ends its turn there. A creature can take this damage only once per turn.

Fuel. Oil serves as fuel for Lamps and Lanterns. Once lit, a flask of Oil burns for 6 hours in a Lamp or Lantern. That duration doesn't need to be consecutive; you can extinguish the burning Oil (as a Utilize action) and rekindle it again until it has burned for a total of 6 hours.

Rations.name: Rações
Rations.description: Rações consistem em alimentos prontos para viagem, incluindo carne seca, frutas secas, biscoito e nozes. Veja &Reference[Malnutrition] no glossário de regras em relação aos efeitos da falta de alimentação.

Cure Wounds.name: Curar Ferimentos
Cure Wounds.description:
Uma criatura tocada por você recupera um número de pontos de vida igual a 2d8 mais seu modificador de atributo de conjuração.

Usando Espaços de Magia de Círculo Superior. A cura aumenta em 2d8 para cada círculo de espaço de magia acima do 1°.

Wild Companion.name: Companheiro Selvagem
Wild Companion.description:
You can summon a nature spirit that assumes an animal form to aid you. As a Magic action, you can expend a spell slot or a use of Wild Shape to cast the @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplFindFamili]{Find Familiar} spell without Material components.

Quando você conjura essa magia dessa forma, o familiar é feérico e desaparece quando você termina um descanso longo.

Nota do Foundry

Essa habilidade inclui uma atividade de convocação que pode ser usada para invocar seu companheiro selvagem. Você pode escolher se deseja gastar uma utilização de “Forma Selvagem” ou um espaço de magia ao ativá-la.

A convocação não desaparece automaticamente ao concluir um Descanso Prolongado.

Circle of the Land.name: Círculo da Terra
Circle of the Land.description:
Celebre a conexão com o mundo natural

O Círculo da Terra é formado por místicos e sábios que protegem o conhecimento e os ritos antigos. Esses druidas se reúnem em círculos sagrados de árvores ou pedras verticais para sussurrar segredos primordiais em Druídico. Os membros mais sábios do círculo presidem essas cerimônias como sacerdotes principais de suas comunidades.

Circle of the Land Spells.name: Magias do Círculo da Terra
Circle of the Land Spells.description:
Sempre que você terminar um descanso longo, escolha um tipo de terreno: árido, polar, temperado ou tropical. Veja a tabela correspondente ao tipo escolhido abaixo: você tem as magias listadas de seu nível de druida e abaixo preparadas.

Terreno Árido
Nível de DruidaMagias do Círculo

Nota do Foundry

Esse recurso não automatiza a alternância entre as opções de magias preparadas.

Land's Aid.name: Auxílio da Terra
Land's Aid.description:
Como uma ação mágica, você pode gastar um uso de Forma a Selvagem e escolher um ponto a até 18 metros de você. Flores de vitalidade e espinhos que drenam vida aparecem por um momento dentro de uma esfera de 3 metros de raio centrada nesse ponto. Cada criatura à sua escolha nessa esfera deve fazer uma salvaguarda de Constituição contra sua CD para evitar magia, sofrendo 2d6 pontos de dano necrótico se falhar, ou metade desse dano em caso de sucesso. Além disso, uma criatura à sua escolha nessa área recupera [[/healing @scale.land.lands-aid]]{[[lookup @scale.land.lands-aid]] pontos de vida}.

O dano e a cura aumentam em 1d6 quando você atinge os níveis de druida 10 (3d6) e 14 (4d6).

Nota do Foundry

Esse recurso inclui uma atividade para a Salvaguarda e cura.

Os valores de cura/dano são ajustados automaticamente à medida que você sobe de nível.

Wild Resurgence.name: Ressurgimento Selvagem
Wild Resurgence.description:
Uma vez a cada um de seus turnos, se não tiver mais usos de Forma Selvagem, você pode recuperar um uso gastando um espaço de magia (nenhuma ação necessária).

Além disso, você pode gastar um uso de Forma Selvagem (nenhuma ação necessária) para recuperar um de seus espaços de magia de 1° círculo, mas não pode fazer isso novamente até que termine um descanso longo.

Nota do Foundry

A atividade Recuperar Forma Selvagem consome um espaço de magia e concede a você mais uma utilização da Forma Selvagem.

A atividade Recuperar Espaço de Magia consumirá uma utilização da Forma Selvagem e concederá a você um espaço de magia de 1º círculo.

Regain Spell Slot.name: Recuperar Espaço de Magia
Regain Spell Slot.condition: Uma vez a cada um de seus turnos

Regain Wild Shape.name: Recuperar Forma Selvagem
Regain Wild Shape.condition: Uma vez a cada um de seus turnos

Lightning Bolt.name: Lightning Bolt
Lightning Bolt.description:
A stroke of lightning forming a 100-foot-long, 5-foot-wide Line blasts out from you in a direction you choose. Each creature in the Line makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking 8d6 Lightning damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

Usando Espaços de Magia de Círculo Superior. The damage increases by 1d6 for each spell slot level above 3.
Lightning Bolt.materials: a bit of fur and a crystal rod

Misty Step.name: Misty Step
Misty Step.description: Briefly surrounded by silvery mist, you teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see.

Sleep.name: Sleep
Sleep.description:
Each creature of your choice in a 5-foot-radius Sphere centered on a point within range must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or have the &Reference[incapacitated apply=false] condition until the end of its next turn, at which point it must repeat the save. If the target fails the second save, the target has the &Reference[unconscious] condition for the duration. The spell ends on a target if it takes damage or someone within 5 feet of it takes an action to shake it out of the spell's effect.

Creatures that don't sleep, such as elves, or that have Immunity to the Exhaustion condition automatically succeed on saves against this spell.
Sleep.materials: a pinch of sand or rose petals

Sleeping.name: Sleeping
Sleeping.description: The target has the &Reference[incapacitated apply=false] condition until the end of its next turn, at which point it must repeat the save. If the target fails the second save, the target has the &Reference[unconscious] condition for the duration. The spell ends on a target if it takes damage or someone within 5 feet of it takes an action to shake it out of the spell’s effect.

Shocking Grasp.name: Shocking Grasp
Shocking Grasp.description:
Lightning springs from you to a creature that you try to touch. Make a melee spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes 1d8 Lightning damage, and it can't make Opportunity Attacks until the start of its next turn.

Aprimoramento de Truque. The damage increases by 1d8 when you reach levels 5 (2d8), 11 (3d8), and 17 (4d8).

Shocked.name: Shocked
Shocked.description: The target can’t make Opportunity Attacks until the start of its next turn.

Guidance.name: Orientação
Guidance.description: Você toca uma criatura disposta e escolhe uma perícia. Até a magia terminar, a criatura adiciona 1d4 a todos os testes de atributo usando a perícia escolhida.

Starry Wisp.name: Starry Wisp
Starry Wisp.description:
You launch a mote of light at one creature or object within range. Faça um ataque mágico à distância contra o alvo. On a hit, the target takes 1d8 Radiant damage, and until the end of your next turn, it emits Dim Light in a 10-foot radius and can't benefit from the &Reference[Invisible] condition.

Aprimoramento de Truque. The damage increases by 1d8 when you reach levels 5 (2d8), 11 (3d8), and 17 (4d8).

Illuminated.name: Illuminated
Illuminated.description: Until the end of your next turn, it emits Dim Light in a 10-foot radius and can’t benefit from the &Reference[Invisible] condition.

Shillelagh.name: Shillelagh
Shillelagh.description:
A Club or Quarterstaff you are holding is imbued with nature's power. For the duration, you can use your spellcasting ability instead of Strength for the attack and damage rolls of melee attacks using that weapon, and the weapon's damage die becomes a d8. If the attack deals damage, it can be Force damage or the weapon's normal damage type (your choice).

The spell ends early if you cast it again or if you let go of the weapon.

Aprimoramento de Truque. The damage die changes when you reach levels 5 (d10), 11 (d12), and 17 (2d6).

Aid.name: Aid
Aid.description:
Choose up to three creatures within range. Each target's Hit Point maximum and current Hit Points increase by 5 for the duration.

Usando Espaços de Magia de Círculo Superior. Each target's Hit Points increase by 5 for each spell slot level above 2.

Level 2: +5 Max HP.name: Level 2: +5 Max HP
Level 2: +5 Max HP.description: The target's Hit Point maximum is increased for the duration.

Level 3: +10 Max HP.name: Level 3: +10 Max HP
Level 3: +10 Max HP.description: The target's Hit Point maximum is increased for the duration.

Level 4: +15 Max HP.name: Level 4: +15 Max HP
Level 4: +15 Max HP.description: The target's Hit Point maximum is increased for the duration.

Level 5: +20 Max HP.name: Level 5: +20 Max HP
Level 5: +20 Max HP.description: The target's Hit Point maximum is increased for the duration.

Level 6: +25 Max HP.name: Level 6: +25 Max HP
Level 6: +25 Max HP.description: The target's Hit Point maximum is increased for the duration.

Level 7: +30 Max HP.name: Level 7: +30 Max HP
Level 7: +30 Max HP.description: The target's Hit Point maximum is increased for the duration.

Level 8: +35 Max HP.name: Level 8: +35 Max HP
Level 8: +35 Max HP.description: The target's Hit Point maximum is increased for the duration.

Level 9: +40 Max HP.name: Level 9: +40 Max HP
Level 9: +40 Max HP.description: The target's Hit Point maximum is increased for the duration.

Goodberry.name: Goodberry
Goodberry.description:
@UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbutlMagicalBer]{Ten berries} appear in your hand and are infused with magic for the duration. A creature can take a Bonus Action to eat one berry. Eating a berry restores 1 Hit Point, and the berry provides enough nourishment to sustain a creature for one day.

Uneaten berries disappear when the spell ends.

Lesser Restoration.name: Lesser Restoration
Lesser Restoration.description: You touch a creature and end one condition on it: &Reference[blinded], &Reference[deafened], &Reference[paralyzed], or &Reference[poisoned].

Longstrider.name: Longstrider
Longstrider.description:
You touch a creature. The target's Speed increases by 10 feet until the spell ends.

Usando Espaços de Magia de Círculo Superior. Ao conjurar esta magia utilizando um espaço de magia de 2º círculo ou superior, você pode escolher uma criatura adicional como alvo para cada círculo do espaço acima do 1º.

Longstrider.name: Longstrider
Longstrider.description: The target’s Speed increases by 10 feet until the spell ends.

Moonbeam.name: Moonbeam
Moonbeam.description:
A silvery beam of pale light shines down in a 5-foot-radius, 40-foot-high Cylinder centered on a point within range. Until the spell ends, Dim Light fills the Cylinder, and you can take a Magic action on later turns to move the Cylinder up to 60 feet.

When the Cylinder appears, each creature in it makes a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 2d10 Radiant damage, and if the creature is shape-shifted (as a result of the Polymorph spell, for example), it reverts to its true form and can't shape-shift until it leaves the Cylinder. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage only. A creature also makes this save when the spell's area moves into its space and when it enters the spell's area or ends its turn there. A creature makes this save only once per turn.

Usando Espaços de Magia de Círculo Superior.The damage increases by 1d10 for each spell slot level above 2.

Revivify.name: Revivify
Revivify.description: You touch a creature that has died within the last minute. That creature revives with 1 Hit Point. This spell can't revive a creature that has died of old age, nor does it restore any missing body parts.
Revivify.materials: a diamond worth 300+ GP, which the spell consumes

Spike Growth.name: Spike Growth
Spike Growth.description:
The ground in a 20-foot-radius Sphere centered on a point within range sprouts hard spikes and thorns. The area becomes Difficult Terrain for the duration. When a creature moves into or within the area, it takes [[/damage 2d4 type=piercing]] damage for every 5 feet it travels.

The transformation of the ground is camouflaged to look natural. Any creature that can't see the area when the spell is cast must take a Search action and succeed on a [[/check ability=wis skill=prc dc=@attributes.spell.dc]] or [[/check ability=wis skill=sur dc=@attributes.spell.dc]] check against your spell save DC to recognize the terrain as hazardous before entering it.

Potion of Healing.name: Potion of Healing
Potion of Healing.description: This potion is a magic item. As a Bonus Action, you can drink it or administer it to another creature within 5 feet of yourself. The creature that drinks the magical red fluid in this vial regains 2d4 + 2 Hit Points.

Protection from Evil and Good.name: Protection from Evil and Good
Protection from Evil and Good.description: Until the spell ends, one willing creature you touch is protected against creatures that are Aberrations, Celestials, Elementals, Fey, Fiends, or Undead. The protection grants several benefits. Creatures of those types have Disadvantage on attack rolls against the target. The target also can't be possessed by or gain the &Reference[Charmed apply=false] or &Reference[Frightened apply=false] conditions from them. If the target is already possessed, Charmed, or Frightened by such a creature, the target has Advantage on any new saving throw against the relevant effect.
Protection from Evil and Good.materials: a flask of Holy Water worth 25+ GP, which the spell consumes

Protected.name: Protegido
Protected.description: Creatures of those types have Disadvantage on attack rolls against the target. The target also can’t be possessed by or gain the &Reference[Charmed apply=false] or &Reference[Frightened apply=false] conditions from them.

Create or Destroy Water.name: Create or Destroy Water
Create or Destroy Water.description:
You do one of the following:

Create Water. You create up to 10 gallons of clean water within range in an open container. Alternatively, the water falls as rain in a 30-foot Cube within range, extinguishing exposed flames there.

Destroy Water. You destroy up to 10 gallons of water in an open container within range. Alternatively, you destroy fog in a 30-foot Cube within range.

Usando Espaços de Magia de Círculo Superior. You create or destroy 10 additional gallons of water, or the size of the Cube increases by 5 feet, for each spell slot level above 1.
Create or Destroy Water.materials: a mix of water and sand

Detect Magic.name: Detect Magic
Detect Magic.description:
For the duration, you sense the presence of magical effects within 30 feet of yourself. If you sense such effects, you can take the Magic action to see a faint aura around any visible creature or object in the area that bears the magic, and if an effect was created by a spell, you learn the spell's school of magic.

The spell is blocked by 1 foot of stone, dirt, or wood; 1 inch of metal; or a thin sheet of lead.

Detect Poison and Disease.name: Detect Poison and Disease
Detect Poison and Disease.description:
For the duration, you sense the location of poisons, poisonous or venomous creatures, and magical contagions within 30 feet of yourself. You sense the kind of poison, creature, or contagion in each case.

The spell is blocked by 1 foot of stone, dirt, or wood; 1 inch of metal; or a thin sheet of lead.

Natural Recovery.name: Recuperação Natural
Natural Recovery.description:
Você pode conjurar uma de suas magias preparadas de 1º círculo ou maior da característica Magias do Círculo sem gastar um espaço de magia. Você só pode fazer isso novamente após terminar um descanso longo.

Além disso, ao fim de um descanso curto, você pode recuperar espaços de magia gastos. Esses espaços de magia devem ter um círculo de magia combinado igual ou menor que a metade do seu nível de druida (arredondar para cima, atualmente [[lookup @classes.druid.levels]]) e nenhum deles pode ser de 6º círculo ou superior. Por exemplo, um druida de 6º nível pode recuperar espaços de magia equivalentes a três círculos de magia. Você pode recuperar um um espalo de magia de 3º círculo; um espaço de 2º e um de 1º; ou três de 1º. Uma vez que recupere espaços de magia com esta característica, você não pode fazer isso novamente até que termine um descanso longo.

Nota do Foundry

A atividade Conjurar Magia pode ser usada para registrar seu único uso gratuito.

A atividade Recuperar Espaço de Magia não automatiza a restauração dos espaços de magia, mas pode ser usada para registrar seu próprio uso único.

Recover Spell Slots.name: Recuperar Espaços de Magia
Recover Spell Slots.condition: Quando você terminar um descanso curto

Elemental Fury.name: Fúria Elemental
Elemental Fury.description:
O poder dos elementos flui através de você. Você ganha uma das seguintes opções à sua escolha.

Conjuração Poderosa. Adicione seu modificador de Sabedoria ao dano que causa com qualquer truque de druida.

Golpe Primordial. Uma vez a cada um de seus turnos, quando acertar uma criatura com uma jogada de ataque usando uma arma ou um ataque da sua forma de fera durante a Forma Selvagem, você pode fazer com que o alvo sofra 1d8 [[/damage 1d8 type=cold]]{gélido}, [[/damage 1d8 type=fire]]{ígneo}, [[/damage 1d8 type=lightning]]{lightning}{elétrico} ou gélido, ígneo ou [[/damage 1d8 type=thunder]]{thunder}{trovejante} (escolha quando acertar).

Nota do Foundry

You will be prompted to choose during advancement.

Elemental Fury: Conjuração Poderosa.name: Fúria Elemental: Conjuração Poderosa
Elemental Fury: Conjuração Poderosa.description:
Adicione seu modificador de Sabedoria ao dano que causa com qualquer truque de druida (atualmente, [[lookup @abilities.wis.mod]]).

Nota do Foundry

Essa característica não automatiza a adição do modificador de Sabedoria aos truques de druida.

Nature's Ward.name: Proteção Natural
Nature's Ward.description:
Você é imune à condição envenenado e tem resistência a um tipo de dano associado à sua escolha de terreno atual na característica Magias do Círculo, conforme a tabela Proteção Natural.

Proteção Natural
Tipo de TerrenoResistência
ÁridoÍgneo
PolarGélido
TemperadoTrovejante
TropicalVenenoso

Nota do Foundry

Essa habilidade inclui um efeito ativo para a imunidade à condição envenenado e um efeito ativo para cada tipo de terreno. Você pode ativar o efeito ativo correspondente ao tipo de terreno que escolher.

Freedom of Movement.name: Freedom of Movement
Freedom of Movement.description:
You touch a willing creature. For the duration, the target's movement is unaffected by &Reference[DifficultTerrain], and spells and other magical effects can neither reduce the target's Speed nor cause the target to have the &Reference[Paralyzed apply=false] or &Reference[Restrained apply=false] conditions. The target also has a Swim Speed equal to its Speed.

In addition, the target can spend 5 feet of movement to automatically escape from nonmagical restraints, such as manacles or a creature imposing the &Reference[Grappled apply=false] condition on it.

Usando Espaços de Magia de Círculo Superior. You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 4.

Tree Stride.name: Tree Stride
Tree Stride.description:
You gain the ability to enter a tree and move from inside it to inside another tree of the same kind within 500 feet. Both trees must be living and at least the same size as you. You must use 5 feet of movement to enter a tree. You instantly know the location of all other trees of the same kind within 500 feet and, as part of the move used to enter the tree, can either pass into one of those trees or step out of the tree you're in. You appear in a spot of your choice within 5 feet of the destination tree, using another 5 feet of movement. If you have no movement left, you appear within 5 feet of the tree you entered.

You can use this transportation ability only once on each of your turns. You must end each turn outside a tree.

Druidcraft.name: Druidcraft
Druidcraft.description:
Whispering to the spirits of nature, you create one of the following effects within range.

Weather Sensor. You create a Tiny, harmless sensory effect that predicts what the weather will be at your location for the next 24 hours. The effect might manifest as a golden orb for clear skies, a cloud for rain, falling snowflakes for snow, and so on. This effect persists for 1 round.

Bloom. You instantly make a flower blossom, a seed pod open, or a leaf bud bloom.

Efeito Sensorial. You create a harmless sensory effect, such as falling leaves, spectral dancing fairies, a gentle breeze, the sound of an animal, or the faint odor of skunk. The effect must fit in a 5-foot Cube.

Brincar com Fogo. You light or snuff out a candle, a torch, or a campfire.

Pass without Trace.name: Pass without Trace
Pass without Trace.description: You radiate a concealing aura in a 30-foot Emanation for the duration. While in the aura, you and each creature you choose have a +10 bonus to [[/check ability=dex skill=ste]] checks and leave no tracks.

Concealed.name: Concealed
Concealed.description: While in the aura, you and each creature you choose have a +10 bonus to [[/check ability=dex skill=ste]] checks and leave no tracks.

Plant Growth.name: Plant Growth
Plant Growth.description:
Casting Time: Action (Overgrowth) or 8 hours (Enrichment)

This spell channels vitality into plants. The casting time you use determines whether the spell has the Overgrowth or the Enrichment effect below.

Overgrowth. Choose a point within range. All normal plants in a 100-foot-radius Sphere centered on that point become thick and overgrown. A creature moving through that area must spend 4 feet of movement for every 1 foot it moves. You can exclude one or more areas of any size within the spell's area from being affected.

Enrichment. All plants in a half-mile radius centered on a point within range become enriched for 365 days. The plants yield twice the normal amount of food when harvested. They can benefit from only one Plant Growth per year.

Conjure Woodland Beings.name: Conjure Woodland Beings
Conjure Woodland Beings.description:
You conjure nature spirits that flit around you in a 10-foot Emanation for the duration. Whenever the Emanation enters the space of a creature you can see and whenever a creature you can see enters the Emanation or ends its turn there, you can force that creature to make a Wisdom saving throw. The creature takes 5d8 Force damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature makes this save only once per turn.

In addition, you can take the &Reference[Disengage] action as a Bonus Action for the spell's duration.

Usando Espaços de Magia de Círculo Superior. The damage increases by 1d8 for each spell slot level above 4.

Giant Insect.name: Giant Insect
Giant Insect.description:
You summon a giant centipede, spider, or wasp (chosen when you cast the spell). It manifests in an unoccupied space you can see within range and uses the @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.actors24.Actor.phbmobGiantInsec]{Giant Insect} stat block. The form you choose determines certain details in its stat block. The creature disappears when it drops to 0 Hit Points or when the spell ends.

The creature is an ally to you and your allies. In combat, the creature shares your Initiative count, but it takes its turn immediately after yours. It obeys your verbal commands (no action required by you). If you don't issue any, it takes the &Reference[Dodge] action and uses its movement to avoid danger.

Usando Espaços de Magia de Círculo Superior. Use the spell slot's level for the spell's level in the stat block.

In addition to the noted usage of the spell's level in the insect's Traits and Actions, the following attributes are also affected.

Giant Insect
AC11 + the spell's level
HP30 + 10 for each spell level above 4
Speed40 ft., Climb 40 ft., Fly 40 ft. (Wasp only)
PBequals your Proficiency Bonus

Heal.name: Heal
Heal.description:
Choose a creature that you can see within range. Positive energy washes through the target, restoring 70 Hit Points. This spell also ends the &Reference[Blinded], &Reference[Deafened], and &Reference[Poisoned] conditions on the target.

Usando Espaços de Magia de Círculo Superior. The healing increases by 10 for each spell slot level above 6.

Polymorph.name: Polymorph
Polymorph.description:
You attempt to transform a creature that you can see within range into a Beast. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or shape-shift into a Beast form for the duration. That form can be any Beast you choose that has a Challenge Rating equal to or less than the target's (or the target's level if it doesn't have a Challenge Rating). The target's game statistics are replaced by the stat block of the chosen Beast, but the target retains its alignment, personality, creature type, Hit Points, and Hit Point Dice. See appendix B for a sample of Beast stat blocks.

The target gains a number of Temporary Hit Points equal to the Hit Points of the Beast form. These Temporary Hit Points vanish if any remain when the spell ends. The spell ends early on the target if it has no Temporary Hit Points left.

The target is limited in the actions it can perform by the anatomy of its new form, and it can't speak or cast spells.

The target's gear melds into the new form. The creature can't use or otherwise benefit from any of that equipment.

Wall of Stone.name: Wall of Stone
Wall of Stone.description:
A nonmagical wall of solid stone springs into existence at a point you choose within range. The wall is 6 inches thick and is composed of ten 10-foot-by-10-foot panels. Each panel must be contiguous with another panel. Alternatively, you can create 10-foot-by-20-foot panels that are only 3 inches thick.

If the wall cuts through a creature's space when it appears, the creature is pushed to one side of the wall (you choose which side). If a creature would be surrounded on all sides by the wall (or the wall and another solid surface), that creature can make a Dexterity saving throw. On a success, it can use its Reaction to move up to its Speed so that it is no longer enclosed by the wall.

The wall can have any shape you desire, though it can't occupy the same space as a creature or object. The wall doesn't need to be vertical or rest on a firm foundation. It must, however, merge with and be solidly supported by existing stone. Thus, you can use this spell to bridge a chasm or create a ramp.

If you create a span greater than 20 feet in length, you must halve the size of each panel to create supports. You can crudely shape the wall to create battlements and the like.

The wall is an object made of stone that can be damaged and thus breached. Each panel has AC 15 and 30 Hit Points per inch of thickness, and it has imunidade a dano psíquico e venenoso. Reducing a panel to 0 Hit Points destroys it and might cause connected panels to collapse at the DM's discretion.

If you maintain your Concentration on this spell for its full duration, the wall becomes permanent and can't be dispelled. Otherwise, the wall disappears when the spell ends.

Ioun Stone of Reserve.name: Ioun Stone of Reserve
Ioun Stone of Reserve.description:
See: @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.dmgIounStone0000]{Ioun Stone}

When you take a Magic action to toss an Ioun Stone into the air, the stone orbits your head at a distance of 1d3 feet, conferring its benefit to you while doing so. You can have up to three Ioun Stones orbiting your head at the same time.

As a Utilize action, you can seize and stow any number of Ioun Stones orbiting your head. If your Attunement to an Ioun Stone ends while it's orbiting your head, the stone falls as though you had dropped it.

This vibrant purple prism stores spells cast into it, holding them until you use them. The stone can store up to 4 levels of spells at a time. When found, it contains [[/r 1d4#Spell Levels]] levels of stored spells chosen by the DM.

Any creature can cast a spell of level 1 through 4 into the stone by touching it as the spell is cast. The spell has no effect, other than to be stored in the stone. If the stone can't hold the spell, the spell is expended without effect. The level of the slot used to cast the spell determines how much space it uses.

While this stone orbits your head, you can cast any spell stored in it. The spell uses the slot level, spell save DC, spell attack bonus, and spellcasting ability of the original caster but is otherwise treated as if you cast the spell. The spell cast from the stone is no longer stored in it, freeing up space.

Goggles of Night.name: Goggles of Night
Goggles of Night.description:
Wondrous Item, Uncommon

While wearing these dark lenses, you have Darkvision out to 60 feet. If you already have Darkvision, wearing the goggles increases its range by 60 feet.

Healing Word.name: Healing Word
Healing Word.description:
A creature of your choice that you can see within range regains Hit Points equal to 2d4 plus your spellcasting ability modifier.

Usando Espaços de Magia de Círculo Superior. The healing increases by 2d4 for each spell slot level above 1.

Censer of Controlling Air Elementals.name: Censer of Controlling Air Elementals
Censer of Controlling Air Elementals.description:
Wondrous Item, Rare

While gently swinging this censer, you can take a Magic action to summon an @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.actors24.Actor.mmAirElemental00]{Air Elemental}. The elemental appears in an unoccupied space as close to the censer as possible, understands your languages, obeys your commands, and takes its turn immediately after you on your Initiative count. The elemental disappears after 1 hour, when it dies, or when you dismiss it as a Bonus Action. The censer can't be used this way again until the next dawn.

summon.target: unoccupied space as close to the brazier as possible

Wild Shape.name: Forma Selvagem
Wild Shape.description:
O poder da natureza permite que você assuma uma forma animal. Como uma ação bônus, você muda de forma para uma fera na qual aprendeu a se transformar com esta característica (veja “Formas Conhecidas” abaixo). Você permanece nessa forma por um número de horas igual à metade do seu nível de druida (atualmente [[lookup @classes.druid.levels]]) ou até usar Forma Selvagem novamente, ficar sob a condição incapacitado ou morrer. Você também pode abandonar a Forma Selvagem como uma ação bônus.

Número de Usos. You can use Wild Shape twice. You regain one expended use when you finish a Short Rest, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest.

You gain additional uses when you reach certain Druid levels, as shown in the Wild Shape column of the @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.content24.JournalEntry.phbDruid00000000.JournalEntryPage.UCOh3zlvGxyk5jLr#class-features]{Druid Features} table.

Número de Usos Atual: [[lookup @scale.druid.wild-shape-uses]]

Formas Conhecidas. You know four Beast forms for this feature, chosen from among Beast stat blocks that have a maximum Challenge Rating of 1/4 and that lack a Fly Speed. The @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.actors24.Actor.mmRat00000000000]{Rato}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.actors24.Actor.mmRidingHorse000]{Cavalo de Montaria}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.actors24.Actor.mmSpider00000000]{Aranha}, and @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.actors24.Actor.mmWolf0000000000]{Lobo} are recommended. Whenever you finish a Long Rest, you can replace one of your known forms with another eligible form.

Automação da Forma Selvagem

Depois de selecionar a criatura na qual você deseja se transformar por meio da característica Forma Selvagem, basta arrastá-la para a sua ficha de personagem, selecionar a opção Forma Selvagem e o Foundry atualizará automaticamente sua ficha. Você pode reverter a transformação na parte superior da sua ficha ou clicando com o botão direito do mouse no seu Personagem na barra lateral.

Ao atingir determinados níveis de druida, seu número de formas conhecidas e o nível de desafio máximo para essas formas aumentam, conforme a tabela Formas de Fera. Além disso, a partir do nível 8, você pode adotar uma forma que tenha deslocamento de voo.

Máximo Atual de Formas Conhecidas: [[lookup @scale.druid.known-forms]]

ND Máximo Atual: [[lookup @scale.druid.wild-shape]]

Ao escolher formas conhecidas, você pode consultar o Livro dos Monstros
Formas de Fera
Nível de DruidaFormas ConhecidasND MáximoDeslocamento de Voo

881Yes

Regras Enquanto Transformado. Enquanto estiver em uma Forma Selvagem, você mantém sua personalidade, memórias e a capacidade de falar, e as seguintes regras se aplicam:

Pontos de Vida Temporários. Ao assumir uma Forma Selvagem, você ganha um número de pontos de vida temporários igual ao seu nível de druida.

Estatísticas de Jogo. Suas estatísticas de jogo são substituídas pelo bloco de estatísticas da fera, mas você mantém seu tipo de criatura, pontos de vida, dados de vida, valores de Inteligência, Sabedoria e Carisma, características de classe, idiomas e talentos. Você também mantém suas proficiências em salvaguardas e perícias e usa seu bônus de prociência para elas, além de ganhar as proficiências da criatura. Se um modificador de salvaguarda ou perícia no bloco de estatísticas da fera for maior que seu, use o do bloco de estatísticas.

Sem Conjuração. Você não pode conjurar magias, mas mudar de forma não quebra sua concentração nem interfere de qualquer outra maneira com magias que você já tenha lançado.

Objetos. Sua habilidade de manipular objetos é deterinada pelos membros da criatura em vez dos seus. Além disso, você escolhe se o seu equipamento cai no espaço que você ocupava antes de se transformar, funde-se à sua nova forma ou é usado por ela. O equipamento usado funciona normalmente, mas o DM decide se é prático para a nova forma usar determinado equipamento com base no tamanho e na forma da criatura. Seu equipamento não muda de tamanho ou de forma para corresponder à nova forma, e qualquer equipamento que ela não possa usar deve cair no chão ou se fundir a ela. Os equipamentos que se fundem a essa forma animal não têm efeito enquanto você estiver transformado nela.

Nota do Foundry

Você pode ativar esse recurso para acompanhar o uso da sua Forma Selvagem.

Ele restaurará automaticamente um uso durante um Descanso Curto e todos os usos durante um Descanso Longo.

AothLv1700000000.name: Aoth
AothLv1700000000.description:
Aoth lived among animals for so long that he now has difficulty speaking Common. His natural habitat in danger, he decided to join an adventuring group to return balance to his land.

Token artwork by Forgotten Adventures.

Token artwork by Forgotten Adventures.

Human.name: Human
Human.description:
@Embed[Compendium.dnd5e.content24.JournalEntry.phbAppendixSpeci.JournalEntryPage.phbspHuman000000 inline classes="free-rules-embed"]

Human Traits

Tipo de Criatura: Humanoide

Tamanho: Médio (de 1,2 a 2 metros de altura) ou Pequeno (de 0,5 a 1,2 metro de altura), escolhido ao selecionar esta espécie

Speed: 30 feet

Como alguém desta espécie, você tem os seguintes traços especiais.

Resourceful. You gain Heroic Inspiration whenever you finish a Long Rest.

Skillful. You gain proficiency in one skill of your choice.

Versatile. You gain an Origin feat of your choice (see chapter 5). Skilled is recommended.

dLxv96vt2B2KOEe2.hint: Médio (about 4-7 feet tall) ou Pequeno (about 2-4 feet tall), escolhido ao selecionar esta espécie

Skillful.title: Skillful
Skillful.hint: You gain proficiency in one skill of your choice.

Versatile.title: Versatile
Versatile.hint: You gain an Origin feat of your choice. Skillful is recommended.

Resourceful.name: Resourceful
Resourceful.description: You gain Heroic Inspiration whenever you finish a Long Rest.

Skillful.name: Skillful
Skillful.description:
You gain proficiency in one skill of your choice.

Nota do Foundry

You will be prompted for this choice when you select this Species.

Versatile.name: Versatile
Versatile.description:
You gain an @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.content24.JournalEntry.phbFeats00000000.JournalEntryPage.otAeQs0TLHYIBNuj]{Origin feat} of your choice. @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.feats24.Item.phbftSkilled0000]{Skilled} is recommended.

Nota do Foundry

You will be prompted for your choice when you select this Species.

Skilled.name: Habilidoso
Skilled.description:
Você ganha proficiência em qualquer combinação de três perícias ou ferramentas à sua escolha.

Repetível. Você pode obter este talento mais de uma vez.

Recluse.name: Recluse
Recluse.description:
Valores de Atributo: Destreza, Constituição, Sabedoria

Talento: Alert

Proficiências em Perícias: Medicine, Religion

Proficiência com Ferramentas: Herbalism Kit

Equipamento: Choose A or B: (A) @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagCaseMaporSc]{Scroll Case}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagBlanket0000], @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagClothesTrav], @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbtulHerbalismK], [[/award 41gp]]; ou (B) [[/award 50gp]]

Alert.name: Alerta
Alert.description:
Você ganha os seguintes benefícios.

Proficiência em Iniciativa. Ao rolar iniciativa, você pode adicionar seu bônus de proficiência ao resultado.

Troca de Iniciativa. Imediatamente após rolar iniciativa, você pode trocar sua iniciativa com a de um aliado disposto no mesmo combate. You can't make this swap if you or the ally has the &Reference[Incapacitated] condition.

Nota do Foundry

Essa característica adiciona automaticamente o bônus à sua Iniciativa.

Druid.name: Druida
Druid.description:
Core Druid Traits

Sabedoria

Intelligence and Wisdom
