Nota do Foundry

As magias serão concedidas automaticamente à medida que você subir de nível.

Sacred Weapon.name: Arma Sagrada
Sacred Weapon.description:
Ao realizar a ação atacar, você pode gastar um uso de Canalizar Divindade para imbuir com energia positiva uma arma corpo a corpo que estiver empunhando. Por 10 minutos ou até que use essa característica novamente, você adiciona seu modificador de Carisma às jogadas de ataque que fizer com essa arma (bônus mínimo de +1) e, cada vez que acertar pode fazer com que a arma cause seu tipo de dano normal ou dano radiante.

A arma também emite luz plena em um raio de 6 metros, e meia-luz por 6 metros além disso.

Você pode enerrar esse efeito prematuramente (nenhuma ação necessária). Esse efeito também termina se você não estiver carregando a arma.

Extra Attack.name: Ataque Extra
Extra Attack.description: Você pode atacar duas vezes, em vez de uma, sempre que executar a ação atacar em seu turno.

Faithful Steed.name: Montaria Fiel
Faithful Steed.description:
Você pode clamar pela ajuda de uma montaria de outro mundo. Você sempre tem a magia @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplFindSteed0]{Convocar Montaria} preparada.

Você também pode conjurá-Ia uma vez sem gastar um espaço de magia, e recupera a habilidade de fazer isso ao final de um descanso longo.

Nota do Foundry

A magia Convocar Montaria é adicionada à sua lista de magias como sempre preparada e com uma utilização gratuita a cada Descanso Longo quando você atingir este nível.

Find Steed.name: Find Steed
Find Steed.description:
You summon an otherworldly being that appears as a loyal steed in an unoccupied space of your choice within range. This creature uses the @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.actors24.Actor.phbmobOtherworld]{Otherworldly Steed} stat block. If you already have a steed from this spell, the steed is replaced by the new one.

The steed resembles a Large, rideable animal of your choice, such as a horse, a camel, a dire wolf, or an elk. Whenever you cast the spell, choose the steed's creature type—Celestial, Fey, or Fiend—which determines certain traits in the stat block.

Combate. The steed is an ally to you and your allies. In combat, it shares your Initiative count, and it functions as a &Reference[controllingamount]{controlled mount} while you ride it (as defined in the rules on mounted combat). If you have the Incapacitated condition, the steed takes its turn immediately after yours and acts independently, focusing on protecting you.

Disappearance of the Steed. The steed disappears if it drops to 0 Hit Points or if you die. When it disappears, it leaves behind anything it was wearing or carrying. If you cast this spell again, you decide whether you summon the steed that disappeared or a different one.

Usando Espaços de Magia de Círculo Superior. Use the spell slot's level for the spell's level in the stat block.

In addition to the noted usage of the spell's level in the steed's Traits and Actions, the following attributes are also affected.

Otherworldly Steed
AC10 + 1 per spell level
HP5 + 10 per spell level (the steed has a number of Hit Dice [d10s] equal to the spell's level)
Speed60 ft., Fly 60 ft. (requires level 4+ spell)
PBequals your Proficiency Bonus

Nota do Foundry

The Summon Flying Steed activity should be used when consuming a fourth level or higher spell slot and is configured to apply the Fly Speed.

When using a second or third level spell slot, the Summon Steed activity should be used instead.

Flying Steed.name: Flying Steed
Flying Steed.description: The steed has a Fly speed of 60ft. when summoned by a level 4+ spell.

Zone of Truth.name: Zone of Truth
Zone of Truth.description:
You create a magical zone that guards against deception in a 15-foot-radius Sphere centered on a point within range. Until the spell ends, a creature that enters the spell's area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there makes a Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, a creature can't speak a deliberate lie while in the radius. You know whether a creature succeeds or fails on this save.

An affected creature is aware of the spell and can avoid answering questions to which it would normally respond with a lie. Such a creature can be evasive yet must be truthful.

Cannot Lie.name: Cannot Lie
Cannot Lie.description:
On a failed save, a creature can’t speak a deliberate lie while in the radius. You know whether a creature succeeds or fails on this save.

An affected creature is aware of the spell and can avoid answering questions to which it would normally respond with a lie. Such a creature can be evasive yet must be truthful.

Aid.name: Aid
Aid.description:
Choose up to three creatures within range. Each target's Hit Point maximum and current Hit Points increase by 5 for the duration.

Usando Espaços de Magia de Círculo Superior. Each target's Hit Points increase by 5 for each spell slot level above 2.

Level 2: +5 Max HP.name: Level 2: +5 Max HP
Level 2: +5 Max HP.description: The target's Hit Point maximum is increased for the duration.

Level 3: +10 Max HP.name: Level 3: +10 Max HP
Level 3: +10 Max HP.description: The target's Hit Point maximum is increased for the duration.

Level 4: +15 Max HP.name: Level 4: +15 Max HP
Level 4: +15 Max HP.description: The target's Hit Point maximum is increased for the duration.

Level 5: +20 Max HP.name: Level 5: +20 Max HP
Level 5: +20 Max HP.description: The target's Hit Point maximum is increased for the duration.

Level 6: +25 Max HP.name: Level 6: +25 Max HP
Level 6: +25 Max HP.description: The target's Hit Point maximum is increased for the duration.

Level 7: +30 Max HP.name: Level 7: +30 Max HP
Level 7: +30 Max HP.description: The target's Hit Point maximum is increased for the duration.

Level 8: +35 Max HP.name: Level 8: +35 Max HP
Level 8: +35 Max HP.description: The target's Hit Point maximum is increased for the duration.

Level 9: +40 Max HP.name: Level 9: +40 Max HP
Level 9: +40 Max HP.description: The target's Hit Point maximum is increased for the duration.

Shining Smite.name: Shining Smite
Shining Smite.description:
The target hit by the strike takes an extra 2d6 Radiant damage from the attack. Until the spell ends, the target sheds &Reference[BrightLight] in a 5-foot radius, attack rolls against it have Advantage, and it can't benefit from the &Reference[Invisible] condition.

Usando Espaços de Magia de Círculo Superior. The damage increases by 1d6 for each spell slot level above 2.
Shining Smite.condition: immediately after hitting a creature with a Melee weapon or an Unarmed Strike

Shining.name: Shining
Shining.description: Until the spell ends, the target sheds &Reference[BrightLight] in a 5-foot radius, attack rolls against it have Advantage, and it can’t benefit from the &Reference[Invisible] condition.

Bless.name: Bênção
Bless.description:
Você abençoa até três criaturas à sua escolha dentro do alcance da magia. Sempre que um alvo realiza um jogada de ataque ou uma salvaguarda antes da magia terminar, ele deve jogar 1d4 e adicionar o número obtido à jogada de ataque ou testes de salvaguarda.

Em Círculos Superiores. Ao conjurar esta magia usando um espaço de magia de 2º círculo ou superior, você pode escolher como alvo uma criatura adicional para cada círculo do espaço acima do 1º.
Bless.materials: um símbolo sagrado no valor de 5 PO ou mais

Blessed.name: Abençoado
Blessed.description: Sempre que um alvo realiza um jogada de ataque ou uma salvaguarda antes da magia terminar, ele deve jogar 1d4 e adicionar o número obtido à jogada.

Divine Favor.name: Divine Favor
Divine Favor.description: Until the spell ends, your attacks with weapons deal an extra 1d4 Radiant damage on a hit.

Warding Bond.name: Warding Bond
Warding Bond.description:
You touch another creature that is willing and create a mystic connection between you and the target until the spell ends. While the target is within 60 feet of you, it gains a +1 bonus to AC and saving throws, and it has &Reference[damageresistance]{Resistance} to all damage. Also, each time it takes damage, you take the same amount of damage.

The spell ends if you drop to 0 Hit Points or if you and the target become separated by more than 60 feet. It also ends if the spell is cast again on either of the connected creatures.
Warding Bond.materials: a pair of platinum rings worth 50+ GP each, which you and the target must wear for the duration

Bonded.name: Bonded
Bonded.description:
While the target is within 60 feet of you, it gains a +1 bonus to AC and saving throws, and it has Resistance to all damage. Also, each time it takes damage, you take the same amount of damage.

The spell ends if you drop to 0 Hit Points or if you and the target become separated by more than 60 feet. It also ends if the spell is cast again on either of the connected creatures.

Potion of Healing.name: Potion of Healing
Potion of Healing.description: This potion is a magic item. As a Bonus Action, you can drink it or administer it to another creature within 5 feet of yourself. The creature that drinks the magical red fluid in this vial regains 2d4 + 2 Hit Points.

Case, Map or Scroll.name: Case, Map or Scroll
Case, Map or Scroll.description: A Map or Scroll Case holds up to 10 sheets of paper or 5 sheets of parchment.

Detect Poison and Disease.name: Detect Poison and Disease
Detect Poison and Disease.description:
For the duration, you sense the location of poisons, poisonous or venomous creatures, and magical contagions within 30 feet of yourself. You sense the kind of poison, creature, or contagion in each case.

The spell is blocked by 1 foot of stone, dirt, or wood; 1 inch of metal; or a thin sheet of lead.

Detect Evil and Good.name: Detect Evil and Good
Detect Evil and Good.description:
For the duration, you sense the location of any Aberration, Celestial, Elemental, Fey, Fiend, or Undead within 30 feet of yourself. You also sense whether the @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplHallow0000]{Hallow} spell is active there and, if so, where.

The spell is blocked by 1 foot of stone, dirt, or wood; 1 inch of metal; or a thin sheet of lead.

Aura of Protection.name: Aura de Proteção
Aura of Protection.description:
Você irradia uma aura protetora e invisível, em uma ação de 3 metros a partir de você. A aura fica inativa enquanto você tiver sob a condição &Reference[Incapacitated apply=false]{incapacitado}.

Você e seus aliados dentro da aura ganham um bônus em salvaguardas igual ao seu modificador de Carisma (bônus mínimo de +1, atualmente [[lookup @abilities.cha.mod]]).

Se outro paladino estiver presente, uma criatura se beneficiar de apenas uma aura de proteção por vez; a criatura opta por uma das auras enquanto estiver dentro delas.

Nota do Foundry

Essa característica inclui um Efeito Ativo que melhora automaticamente suas Salvaguardas, mas não deve ser usada para outros personagens afetados, pois ela somará o modificador de Carisma deles e não o do Paladino. Eles devem somar o seu modificador manualmente.

Aura of Devotion.name: Aura de Devoção
Aura of Devotion.description:
Você e seus aliados têm imunidade à condição enfeitiçado enquanto estiverem dentro de sua Aura de Proteção. Se um aliado enfeitiçado entrar na aura, tal condição não terá efeito sobre aquele aliado enquanto ele permanecer lá.

Nota do Foundry

Esse recurso inclui um Efeito Ativo para rastrear personagens afetados pela sua aura, mas não automatiza os efeitos.

Abjure Foes.name: Repudiar Inimigos
Abjure Foes.description:
Como uma ação mágica, você pode gastar um uso da habilidade Canalizar Divindade desta classe para subjugar os inimigos com pavor. Ao apresentar seu símbolo sagrado ou sua arma, você pode alvejar um número igual ao seu modificador de Carisma (mínimo de uma) de criaturas que você possa ver a até 18 metros de distância. Cada alvo deverá ser bem-sucedido em uma salvaguarda de Sabedoria ou sofrerá a condição &Reference[Frightened] por 1 minuto, ou até sofrer qualquer dano. Enquanto amedrontado dessa forma, o alvo só poderá agir de uma das seguintes formas em seus turnos: mover-se, executar uma ação ou executar uma ação bônus.

Nota do Foundry

Essa habilidade inclui um Efeito Ativo que aplica a condição Amedrontado.

Dispel Magic.name: Dispel Magic
Dispel Magic.description:
Choose one creature, object, or magical effect within range. Any ongoing spell of level 3 or lower on the target ends. For each ongoing spell of level 4 or higher on the target, make an ability check using your spellcasting ability (DC 10 plus that spell's level). On a successful check, the spell ends.

Usando Espaços de Magia de Círculo Superior. You automatically end a spell on the target if the spell's level is equal to or less than the level of the spell slot you use.

Beacon of Hope.name: Beacon of Hope
Beacon of Hope.description: Choose any number of creatures within range. For the duration, each target has Advantage on Wisdom saving throws and Death Saving Throws and regains the maximum number of Hit Points possible from any healing.

Hopeful.name: Hopeful
Hopeful.description: The target has Advantage on Wisdom saving throws and Death Saving Throws and regains the maximum number of Hit Points possible from any healing.

Aura of Courage.name: Aura de Coragem
Aura of Courage.description:
Você e seus aliados têm imunidade à condição amedrontado enquanto estiverem dentro de sua Aura de Proteção. Se um aliado amedrontado entrar na aura, tal condição não terá efeito sobre aquele aliado enquanto ele permanecer lá.

Nota do Foundry

Esse recurso inclui um Efeito Ativo para rastrear quem está dentro da sua aura, mas ele não é adicionado ou removido automaticamente, nem remove a condição amedrontado.

Radiant Strikes.name: Ataques Radiantes
Radiant Strikes.description:
Seus golpes agora carregam um poder sobrenatural. Quando você atinge um alvo com uma jogada de ataque usando uma arma corpo a corpo ou um golpe desarmado, o alvo sofre 1d8 de dano radiante adicional.

Nota do Foundry

Essa característica inclui um Efeito Ativo que adiciona automaticamente o dano Radiante a todas as jogadas de dano realizadas com seus ataques com armas brancas e golpes desarmados.

Revivify.name: Revivify
Revivify.description: You touch a creature that has died within the last minute. That creature revives with 1 Hit Point. This spell can't revive a creature that has died of old age, nor does it restore any missing body parts.
Revivify.materials: a diamond worth 300+ GP, which the spell consumes

Remove Curse.name: Remove Curse
Remove Curse.description: At your touch, all curses affecting one creature or object end. If the object is a cursed magic item, its curse remains, but the spell breaks its owner's Attunement to the object so it can be removed or discarded.

Lesser Restoration.name: Lesser Restoration
Lesser Restoration.description: You touch a creature and end one condition on it: &Reference[blinded], &Reference[deafened], &Reference[paralyzed], or &Reference[poisoned].

Prayer of Healing.name: Prayer of Healing
Prayer of Healing.description:
Up to five creatures of your choice who remain within range for the spell's entire casting gain the benefits of a &Reference[shortrest] and also regain 2d8 Hit Points. A creature can't be affected by this spell again until that creature finishes a Long Rest.

Usando Espaços de Magia de Círculo Superior. The healing increases by 1d8 for each spell slot level above 2.

Healed by Prayer.name: Healed by Prayer
Healed by Prayer.description: A creature can’t be affected by the @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplPrayerofHe] spell again until that creature finishes a Long Rest.

Necklace of Prayer Beads.name: Necklace of Prayer Beads
Necklace of Prayer Beads.description:
Wondrous Item, Rare (Requires Attunement by a Cleric, Druid, or Paladin)

This necklace has [[/r 1d4 + 2#Magic beads]] magic beads made from aquamarine, black pearl, or topaz. It also has many nonmagical beads made from stones such as amber, bloodstone, citrine, coral, jade, pearl, or quartz. If a magic bead is removed from the necklace, that bead loses its magic.

Six types of magic beads exist. The GM decides the type of each bead on the necklace or determines it randomly by rolling on the table below. A necklace can have more than one bead of the same type. To use one, you must be wearing the necklace. Each bead contains a spell that you can cast from it as a Bonus Action (using your spell save DC if a save is necessary). Once a magic bead's spell is cast, that bead can't be used again until the next dawn.

@Embed[Compendium.dnd5e.tables24.RollTable.dmgNecklaceOfPra caption=false rollable]

Nota do Foundry

This item includes an activity for each spell with a limited use per dawn. You can remove the activities for the beads that aren't available on this necklace and duplicate ones that are included multiple times before giving it to a player.

FaUxB5gR0CQhG3qw.name: Bênção
FaUxB5gR0CQhG3qw.description:
Você abençoa até três criaturas à sua escolha dentro do alcance da magia. Sempre que um alvo realiza um jogada de ataque ou uma salvaguarda antes da magia terminar, ele deve jogar 1d4 e adicionar o número obtido à jogada de ataque ou testes de salvaguarda.

Em Círculos Superiores. Ao conjurar esta magia usando um espaço de magia de 2º círculo ou superior, você pode escolher como alvo uma criatura adicional para cada círculo do espaço acima do 1º.
FaUxB5gR0CQhG3qw.materials: um símbolo sagrado no valor de 5 PO ou mais

Blessed.name: Abençoado
Blessed.description: Sempre que um alvo realiza um jogada de ataque ou uma salvaguarda antes da magia terminar, ele deve jogar 1d4 e adicionar o número obtido à jogada.

Cure Wounds.name: Curar Ferimentos
Cure Wounds.description:
Uma criatura tocada por você recupera um número de pontos de vida igual a 2d8 mais seu modificador de atributo de conjuração.

Usando Espaços de Magia de Círculo Superior. A cura aumenta em 2d8 para cada círculo de espaço de magia acima do 1°.

Greater Restoration.name: Greater Restoration
Greater Restoration.description:
You touch a creature and magically remove one of the following effects from it:

  • 1 &Reference[Exhaustion] level
  • The &Reference[Charmed] or &Reference[Petrified] condition
  • A curse, including the target's Attunement to a cursed magic item
  • Any reduction to one of the target's ability scores
  • Any reduction to the target's Hit Point maximum
Greater Restoration.materials: diamond dust worth 100+ GP, which the spell consumes

QH0AgPkivU83QkKR.name: Shining Smite
QH0AgPkivU83QkKR.description:
The target hit by the strike takes an extra 2d6 Radiant damage from the attack. Until the spell ends, the target sheds &Reference[BrightLight] in a 5-foot radius, attack rolls against it have Advantage, and it can't benefit from the &Reference[Invisible] condition.

Usando Espaços de Magia de Círculo Superior. The damage increases by 1d6 for each spell slot level above 2.
QH0AgPkivU83QkKR.condition: immediately after hitting a creature with a Melee weapon or an Unarmed Strike

Shining.name: Shining
Shining.description: Until the spell ends, the target sheds &Reference[BrightLight] in a 5-foot radius, attack rolls against it have Advantage, and it can’t benefit from the &Reference[Invisible] condition.

Efficient Quiver.name: Efficient Quiver
Efficient Quiver.description:
Wondrous Item, Uncommon

Each of the quiver's three compartments connects to an extradimensional space that allows the quiver to hold numerous items while never weighing more than 2 pounds. The shortest compartment can hold up to 60 Arrows, Bolts, or similar objects. The midsize compartment holds up to 18 Javelins or similar objects. The longest compartment holds up to 6 long objects, such as bows, Quarterstaffs, or Spears.

You can draw any item the quiver contains as if doing so from a regular quiver or scabbard.

Long Compartment.name: Long Compartment
Long Compartment.description: The long compartment holds up to 6 long objects, such as bows, Quarterstaffs, or Spears.

Short Compartment.name: Short Compartment
Short Compartment.description: The short compartment can hold up to 60 Arrows, Bolts, or similar objects.

Midsize Compartment.name: Midsize Compartment
Midsize Compartment.description: The midsize compartment holds up to 18 Javelins or similar objects.

Javelin of Lightning.name: Javelin of Lightning
Javelin of Lightning.description:
Each time you make an attack roll with this magic weapon and hit, you can have it deal Lightning damage instead of Piercing damage.

Lightning Bolt. When you throw this weapon at a target no farther than 120 feet from you, you can forgo making a ranged attack roll and instead turn the weapon into a bolt of lightning. This bolt forms a 5-foot-wide Line between you and the target. The target and each other creature in the Line (excluding you) makes a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw, taking 4d6 Lightning damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. Immediately after dealing this damage, the weapon reappears in your hand. This property can't be used again until the next dawn.

Nota do Foundry

The Attack activity allows you to choose between Lightning and Piercing when rolling damage and will remember your last choice.

Guardian of Faith.name: Guardian of Faith
Guardian of Faith.description:
A Large spectral guardian appears and hovers for the duration in an unoccupied space that you can see within range. The guardian occupies that space and is invulnerable, and it appears in a form appropriate for your deity or pantheon.

Any enemy that moves to a space within 10 feet of the guardian for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking 20 Radiant damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. The guardian vanishes when it has dealt a total of 60 damage.

Freedom of Movement.name: Freedom of Movement
Freedom of Movement.description:
You touch a willing creature. For the duration, the target's movement is unaffected by &Reference[DifficultTerrain], and spells and other magical effects can neither reduce the target's Speed nor cause the target to have the &Reference[Paralyzed apply=false] or &Reference[Restrained apply=false] conditions. The target also has a Swim Speed equal to its Speed.

In addition, the target can spend 5 feet of movement to automatically escape from nonmagical restraints, such as manacles or a creature imposing the &Reference[Grappled apply=false] condition on it.

Usando Espaços de Magia de Círculo Superior. You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 4.

Restoring Touch.name: Toque Restaurador
Restoring Touch.description:
Ao usar Mãos Consagradas em uma criatura você pode também remover uma ou mais das seguintes condições dela: amedrontado, atordoado, cego, enfeitiçado, paralisado ou surdo. Você deve gastar 5 pontos de vida da reserva de cura de Mãos Consagradas para cada uma dessas condições que remover; esses pontos não restauram os pontos de vida da criatura.

Nota do Foundry

Esta característica inclui uma solicitação de “Escala” para selecionar quantas condições você deseja remover, o que consumirá automaticamente o número correto do seu estoque de Mãos Consagradas.

Smite of Protection.name: Destruição Protetora
Smite of Protection.description:
Seu golpe mágico agora irradia energia protetora. Sempre que você conjurar @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplDivineSmit]{destruição divina}, você e seus aliados têm cobertura parcial enquanto estiverem em sua Aura de Proteção. A aura tem esse benefício até o início do seu próximo turno.

Nota do Foundry

Esta característica inclui um Efeito Ativo que confere o status de Meia Cobertura, mas esse status não é concedido automaticamente quando as criaturas entram ou saem da sua aura.

Flame Strike.name: Flame Strike
Flame Strike.description:
A vertical column of brilliant fire roars down from above. Each creature in a 10-foot-radius, 40-foot-high Cylinder centered on a point within range makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking 5d6 Fire damage and 5d6 Radiant damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

Usando Espaços de Magia de Círculo Superior. The Fire damage and the Radiant damage increase by 1d6 for each spell slot level above 5.

Commune.name: Commune
Commune.description:
You contact a deity or a divine proxy and ask up to three questions that can be answered with yes or no. You must ask your questions before the spell ends. You receive a correct answer for each question.

Divine beings aren't necessarily omniscient, so you might receive "unclear" as an answer if a question pertains to information that lies beyond the deity's knowledge. In a case where a one-word answer could be misleading or contrary to the deity's interests, the DM might offer a short phrase as an answer instead.

If you cast the spell more than once before finishing a Long Rest, there is a cumulative 25 percent chance for each casting after the first that you get no answer.

Daylight.name: Daylight
Daylight.description:
For the duration, sunlight spreads from a point within range and fills a 60-foot-radius Sphere. The sunlight's area is Bright Light and sheds Dim Light for an additional 60 feet.

Alternatively, you cast the spell on an object that isn't being worn or carried, causing the sunlight to fill a 60-foot Emanation originating from that object. Covering that object with something opaque, such as a bowl or helm, blocks the sunlight.

If any of this spell's area overlaps with an area of Darkness created by a spell of level 3 or lower, that other spell is dispelled.

Banishment.name: Banishment
Banishment.description:
One creature that you can see within range must succeed on a Charisma saving throw or be transported to a harmless demiplane for the duration. While there, the target has the &Reference[Incapacitated apply=false] condition. When the spell ends, the target reappears in the space it left or in the nearest unoccupied space if that space is occupied.

If the target is an Aberration, a Celestial, an Elemental, a Fey, or a Fiend, the target doesn't return if the spell lasts for 1 minute. The target is instead transported to a random location on a plane (DM's choice) associated with its creature type.

Usando Espaços de Magia de Círculo Superior. You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 4.

Banished.name: Banished
Banished.description:
While there, the target has the &Reference[Incapacitated apply=false] condition. When the spell ends, the target reappears in the space it left or in the nearest unoccupied space if that space is occupied.

If the target is an Aberration, a Celestial, an Elemental, a Fey, or a Fiend, the target doesn’t return if the spell lasts for 1 minute. The target is instead transported to a random location on a plane (DM’s choice) associated with its creature type.

Death Ward.name: Death Ward
Death Ward.description:
You touch a creature and grant it a measure of protection from death. The first time the target would drop to 0 Hit Points before the spell ends, the target instead drops to 1 Hit Point, and the spell ends.

If the spell is still in effect when the target is subjected to an effect that would kill it instantly without dealing damage, that effect is negated against the target, and the spell ends.

Protection from Death.name: Protection from Death
Protection from Death.description:
The first time the target would drop to 0 Hit Points before the spell ends, the target instead drops to 1 Hit Point, and the spell ends.

If the spell is still in effect when the target is subjected to an effect that would kill it instantly without dealing damage, that effect is negated against the target, and the spell ends.

C7ieH9vs15W2uncj.name: Greater Restoration
C7ieH9vs15W2uncj.description:
You touch a creature and magically remove one of the following effects from it:

  • 1 &Reference[Exhaustion] level
  • The &Reference[Charmed] or &Reference[Petrified] condition
  • A curse, including the target's Attunement to a cursed magic item
  • Any reduction to one of the target's ability scores
  • Any reduction to the target's Hit Point maximum
C7ieH9vs15W2uncj.materials: diamond dust worth 100+ GP, which the spell consumes

Dwarven Thrower.name: Dwarven Thrower
Dwarven Thrower.description:
Weapon (@UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbwepWarhammer0]{Warhammer}), Very Rare (Requires Attunement by a Dwarf or a Creature Attuned to a @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.dmgBeltOfDwarven]{Belt of Dwarvenkind})

You gain a +3 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. It has the Thrown property with a normal range of 20 feet and a long range of 60 feet. When you hit with a ranged attack using this weapon, it deals an extra [[/damage 1d8 type=force]] damage, or an extra [[/damage 2d8 type=force]] damage if the target is a Giant. Immediately after hitting or missing, the weapon flies back to your hand.

Belt of Dwarvenkind.name: Belt of Dwarvenkind
Belt of Dwarvenkind.description:
Wondrous Item, Rare (Requires Attunement)

While wearing this belt, you gain the following benefits:

Dwarvish. You know Dwarvish.

Friend of Dwarvenkind. You have Advantage on Charisma (Persuasion) checks made to interact with dwarves and duergar.

Toughness. Your Constitution increases by 2, to a maximum of 20.

In addition, while attuned to the belt, you have a 50 percent chance each day at dawn of growing a full beard if you can grow one, or a thicker beard if you already have one.

If you aren't a dwarf or duergar, you gain the following additional benefits while wearing the belt:

Visão no Escuro. Você tem visão no escuro com distância de 18 metros.

Resilience. Você tem resistência a dano venenoso. Você também tem vantagem em salvaguar das para evitar ou encerrar a condição envenenado.

Dwarvenkind Benefits.name: Dwarvenkind Benefits
Dwarvenkind Benefits.description:
Dwarvish. You know Dwarvish.

Friend of Dwarvenkind. You have Advantage on Charisma (Persuasion) checks made to interact with dwarves and duergar.

Toughness. Your Constitution increases by 2, to a maximum of 20.

If you aren’t a dwarf or duergar, you gain the following additional benefits while wearing the belt:

Visão no Escuro. Você tem visão no escuro com distância de 18 metros.

Resilience. Você tem resistência a dano venenoso. Você também tem vantagem em salvaguar das para evitar ou encerrar a condição envenenado.

Bag of Holding.name: Bag of Holding
Bag of Holding.description:
This bag has an interior space considerably larger than its outside dimensions—roughly 2 feet square and 4 feet deep on the inside. The bag can hold up to 500 pounds, not exceeding a volume of 64 cubic feet. The bag weighs 5 pounds, regardless of its contents. Retrieving an item from the bag requires a Utilize action.

If the bag is overloaded, pierced, or torn, it is destroyed, and its contents are scattered in the Astral Plane. If the bag is turned inside out, its contents spill forth unharmed, but the bag must be put right before it can be used again. The bag holds enough air for 10 minutes of breathing, divided by the number of breathing creatures inside.

Placing a Bag of Holding inside an extradimensional space created by a @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.dmgHewardsHandyH]{Handy Haversack}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.dmgPortableHole0]{Portable Hole}, or similar item instantly destroys both items and opens a gate to the Astral Plane. The gate originates where the one item was placed inside the other. Any creature within a 10-foot-radius Sphere centered on the gate is sucked through it to a random location on the Astral Plane. The gate then closes. The gate is one-way and can't be reopened.

Cape of the Mountebank.name: Cape of the Mountebank
Cape of the Mountebank.description:
Wondrous Item, Rare

This cape smells faintly of brimstone. While wearing it, you can use it to cast @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplDimensionD]{Dimension Door} as a Magic action. This property can't be used again until the next dawn.

When you teleport with that spell, you leave behind a cloud of smoke. The space you left is &Reference[LightlyObscured] by that smoke until the end of your next turn.

qsuojT0nn8ZkAY19.chatFlavor: The space you left is &Reference[LightlyObscured] by smoke until the end of your next turn.

Dimension Door.name: Dimension Door
Dimension Door.description:
You teleport to a location within range. You arrive at exactly the spot desired. It can be a place you can see, one you can visualize, or one you can describe by stating distance and direction, such as "200 feet straight downward" or "300 feet upward to the northwest at a 45-degree angle."

You can also teleport one willing creature. The creature must be within 5 feet of you when you teleport, and it teleports to a space within 5 feet of your destination space.

If you, the other creature, or both would arrive in a space occupied by a creature or completely filled by one or more objects, you and any creature traveling with you each take 4d6 Force damage, and the teleportation fails.

changes.name: Ring of Resistance (pearl)
changes.system.description.value:
{}

See: @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.dmgRingOfResista]

You have Resistance to one damage type while wearing this ring. The gemstone in the ring indicates the type.

Potion of Giant Strength (Fire).name: Potion of Giant Strength (Fire)
Potion of Giant Strength (Fire).description:
Potion, Rare

When you drink this potion, your Strength score changes for 1 hour to 25. The type of giant determines the score. The potion has no effect on you if your Strength is equal to or greater than that score.

This potion's transparent liquid has floating in it a sliver of light resembling a giant's fingernail.

MerricLv01000000.name: Merric
MerricLv01000000.description:
Merric was once a vigilante, due to her innate sense of street justice. Though her imposing stature makes her a force to be reckoned with in combat, it is her violent outbursts of rage that truly set her apart.

Token artwork by Forgotten Adventures.

Token artwork by Forgotten Adventures.

Vigilante.name: Vigilante
Vigilante.description:
Valores de Atributo: Strength, Constitution, Charisma

Talento: Savage Attacker

Proficiências em Perícias: Athletics, Insight

Proficiência com Ferramentas: Choose one kind of Artisan's Tools

Equipamento: Choose A or B: (A) Artisan's Tools (same as above), @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagClothesTrav], [[/award 32gp]] ou (B) [[/award 50gp]]

Savage Attacker.name: Savage Attacker
Savage Attacker.description: You've trained to deal particularly damaging strikes. Once per turn when you hit a target with a weapon, you can roll the weapon's damage dice twice and use either roll against the target.

Barbarian.description:
Core Barbarian Traits

Atributo Primário

Strength

Dado de Vida

D12 per Barbarian level

Proficiências em Salvaguardas

Força e Constituição

Proficiências em Perícias

Escolha 2: Animal Handling, Athletics, Intimidation, Nature, Perception, or Survival

Proficiências com Armas

Armas simples e marciais

Treinamento com Armadura

Armaduras leves e médias, escudos

Equipamento Inicial

Escolha A ou B: (A) @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbwepGreataxe00]{Greataxe}, 4 @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbwepHandaxe000]{Handaxes}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagExplorersPa]{Explorer's Pack} e [[/award 15GP]]; ou (B) [[/award 75GP]]

Becoming a Barbarian …

Como um Personagem de 1º Nível

  • Gain all the traits in the Core Barbarian Traits table.
  • Gain the Barbarian's level 1 features, which are listed in the Barbarian Features table.

Como um Personagem Multiclasse

  • Gain the following traits from the Core Barbarian Traits table: Hit Point Die, proficiency with Martial weapons, and training with Shields.
  • Gain the Barbarian's level 1 features, which are listed in the Barbarian Features table.

Primal Knowledge.title: Conhecimento Primordial
Primal Knowledge.hint: Você ganha proficiência em outra perícia à sua escolha da lista de perícias disponíveis para Bárbaros no 1° nível.

Weapon Mastery.title: Maestria com Armas
Weapon Mastery.hint: Seu treinamento com armas permite que você use as propriedades de maestria de mais tipos de armas.

Rage.name: Rage
Rage.description:
You can imbue yourself with a primal power called Rage, a force that grants you extraordinary might and resilience. You can enter it as a Bonus Action if you aren't wearing Heavy armor.

You can enter your Rage the number of times shown for your Barbarian level in the Rages column of the Barbarian Features table (currently [[lookup @scale.barbarian.rages]]). You regain one expended use when you finish a Short Rest, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest.

While active, your Rage follows the rules below.

Resistência a Dano. Você tem resistência a dano Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing.

Rage Damage. When you make an attack using Strength—with either a weapon or an Unarmed Strike—and deal damage to the target, you gain a bonus to the damage that increases as you gain levels as a Barbarian, as shown in the Rage Damage column of the Barbarian Features table.

Strength Vantagem. You have Advantage on Strength checks and Strength saving throws.

No Concentration or Spells. You can't maintain Concentration, and you can't cast spells.

Duration. The Rage lasts until the end of your next turn, and it ends early if you don Heavy armor or have the Incapacitated condition. If your Rage is still active on your next turn, you can extend the Rage for another round by doing one of the following:

  • Make an attack roll against an enemy.
  • Force an enemy to make a saving throw.
  • Take a Bonus Action to extend your Rage.

Each time the Rage is extended, it lasts until the end of your next turn. You can maintain a Rage for up to 10 minutes.

Nota do Foundry

This feature includes an Active Effect which automates the Resistance and additional damage. This feature will also automatically recharge your Rage uses on a Short and Long Rest.

Unarmored Defense.name: Unarmored Defense
Unarmored Defense.description:
While you aren't wearing armor or wielding a Shield, your base Armor Class equals 10 plus your Dexterity and Wisdom modifiers.

Nota do Foundry

This feature includes an Active Effect which updates your Armor Class.

Weapon Mastery.name: Maestria com Armas
Weapon Mastery.description:
Seu treinamento com armas permite que você use as propriedades de maestria de dois tipos de armas, à sua escolha, com as quais tenha proficiência, como adagas e arcos curtos.

Sempre que você terminar um descanso longo, você poderá mudar os tipos de armas escolhidos. Por exemplo, você poderia passar a usar as propriedades de maestria de cimitarras e espadas curtas.

Clothes, Traveler's.name: Traje de Viajante
Clothes, Traveler's.description: Traveler's Clothes are resilient garments designed for travel in various environments.

Mason's Tools.name: Mason's Tools
Mason's Tools.description:
Atributo: Strength

Usar: Chisel a symbol or hole in stone (DC 10)

Criação: @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagBlockandTac]{Block and Tackle}

Explorer's Pack.name: Explorer's Pack
Explorer's Pack.description: An Explorer's Pack contains the following items: @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagBackpack000]{Mochila}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagBedroll0000]{Saco de Dormir}, 2 frascos de @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagOil00000000]{Óleo}, 10 dias de @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagRations0000]{Rações}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagRope0000000]{Corda}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagTinderbox00]{Caixa para Fogo}, 10 @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagTorch000000]{Tochas}, and @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagWaterskin00]{Cantil}.

Tinderbox.name: Caixa para Fogo
Tinderbox.description: A caixa para fogo é um pequeno recipiente contendo sílica, pederneira e uma acendalha (geralmente pano seco embebido em óleo) usada para atear fogo. Suas utilidades incluem, como uma ação bônus, acender vela, lamparina, lanterna ou tocha, bem como qualquer outro objeto com combustível exposto. Acender outros tipos de fogo leva 1 minuto.

Rope.name: Corda
Rope.description:
As a Utilize action, you can tie a knot with Rope if you succeed on a DC 10 Dexterity (Prestidigitação) check. The Rope can be burst with a successful DC 20 Strength (Athletics) check.

You can bind an unwilling creature with the Rope only if the creature has the &Reference[Grappled], &Reference[Incapacitated], or &Reference[Restrained] condition. If the creature's legs are bound, the creature has the Restrained condition until it escapes. Escaping the Rope requires the creature to make a successful DC 15 Dexterity (Acrobatics) check as an action.

Bedroll.name: Saco de Dormir
Bedroll.description: A Bedroll sleeps one Small or Medium creature. While in a Bedroll, you automatically succeed on saving throws against extreme cold (see @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.content24.JournalEntry.dmgDmsToolbox000]{Gameplay Toolbox}).

Waterskin.name: Cantil
Waterskin.description: A Waterskin holds up to 4 pints. If you don't drink sufficient water, you risk &Reference[dehydration].

Water (Pint).name: Água (Quartilho)
Water (Pint).description: If you don't drink sufficient water, you risk &Reference[dehydration].

Torch.name: Tocha
Torch.description: Uma tocha queima por 1 hora, emitindo luz plena em um raio de 6 metros e meia-luz por mais 6 metros. Ao executar a ação atacar, você pode atacar com a tocha, usando-a como uma arma de combate corpo a corpo simples. Em caso de acerto, o alvo sofre 1 ponto de dano ígneo.

Oil.name: Óleo
Oil.description:
You can douse a creature, object, or space with Oil or use it as fuel, as detailed below.

Dousing a Creature or an Object. When you take the Attack action, you can replace one of your attacks with throwing an Oil flask. Target one creature or object within 20 feet of yourself. The target must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw (DC 8 plus your Dexterity modifier and Proficiency Bonus) or be covered in oil. If the target takes Fire damage before the oil dries (after 1 minute), the target takes an extra [[/damage 5 type=fire]] damage from burning oil.

Dousing a Space. You can take the Utilize action to pour an Oil flask on level ground to cover a 5-foot-square area within 5 feet of yourself. If lit, the oil burns until the end of the turn 2 rounds from when the oil was lit (or 12 seconds) and deals 5 Fire damage to any creature that enters the area or ends its turn there. A creature can take this damage only once per turn.

Fuel. Oil serves as fuel for Lamps and Lanterns. Once lit, a flask of Oil burns for 6 hours in a Lamp or Lantern. That duration doesn't need to be consecutive; you can extinguish the burning Oil (as a Utilize action) and rekindle it again until it has burned for a total of 6 hours.

Rations.name: Rações
Rations.description: Rações consistem em alimentos prontos para viagem, incluindo carne seca, frutas secas, biscoito e nozes. Veja &Reference[Malnutrition] no glossário de regras em relação aos efeitos da falta de alimentação.

Goliath.name: Golias
Goliath.description:
@Embed[Compendium.dnd5e.content24.JournalEntry.phbAppendixSpeci.JournalEntryPage.phbspGoliath0000 inline classes="free-rules-embed"]

Traços de Golias

Tipo de Criatura: Humanoide

Tamanho: Médio (de 2 a 2,5 metros de altura).

Deslocamento: 10,5 metros

Como alguém desta espécie, você tem os seguintes traços especiais.

Ancestralidade Gigante. You are descended from Giants. Choose one of the following benefits—a supernatural boon from your ancestry; you can use the chosen benefit a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest:

Cloud's Jaunt (Cloud Giant). As a Bonus Action, you magically teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see.

Fire's Burn (Fire Giant). When you hit a target with an attack roll and deal damage to it, you can also deal 1d10 Fire damage to that target.

Frost's Chill (Frost Giant). When you hit a target with an attack roll and deal damage to it, you can also deal 1d6 Cold damage to that target and reduce its Speed by 10 feet until the start of your next turn.

Hill's Tumble (Hill Giant). When you hit a Large or smaller creature with an attack roll and deal damage to it, you can give that target the &Reference[Prone] condition.

Stone's Endurance (Stone Giant). When you take damage, you can take a Reaction to roll 1d12. Add your Constitution modifier to the number rolled and reduce the damage by that total.

Storm's Thunder (Storm Giant). When you take damage from a creature within 60 feet of you, you can take a Reaction to deal 1d8 Thunder damage to that creature.

Large Form. Starting at character level 5, you can change your size to Large as a Bonus Action if you're in a big enough space. This transformation lasts for 10 minutes or until you end it (no action required). For that duration, you have Advantage on Strength checks, and your Speed increases by 10 feet. Uma vez que você usar este traço, não poderá usá- lo novamente até terminar um descanso longo.

Powerful Build. You have Advantage on any ability check you make to end the Grappled condition. You also count as one size larger when determining your carrying capacity.

Frost's Chill (Frost Giant). When you hit a target with an attack roll and deal damage to it, you can also deal 1d6 Cold damage to that target and reduce its Speed by 10 feet until the start of your next turn.

Hill's Tumble (Hill Giant). When you hit a Large or smaller creature with an attack roll and deal damage to it, you can give that target the Prone condition.

Stone's Endurance (Stone Giant). When you take damage, you can take a Reaction to roll 1d12. Add your Constitution modifier to the number rolled and reduce the damage by that total.

Storm's Thunder (Storm Giant). When you take damage from a creature within 60 feet of you, you can take a Reaction to deal 1d8 Thunder damage to that creature.

Powerful Build.description:
You have Advantage on any ability check you make to end the &Reference[Grappled apply=false] condition. You also count as one size larger when determining your carrying capacity.

This feature includes an Active Effect which automatically upgrades your size when determining carrying capacity.

Rage.description:
You can imbue yourself with a primal power called Rage, a force that grants you extraordinary might and resilience. You can enter it as a Bonus Action if you aren't wearing Heavy armor.

You can enter your Rage the number of times shown for your Barbarian level in the Rages column of the Barbarian Features table (currently [[lookup @scale.barbarian.rages]]). You regain one expended use when you finish a Short Rest, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest.

While active, your Rage follows the rules below.

Resistência a Dano. Você tem resistência a dano Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing.

Rage Damage. When you make an attack using Strength—with either a weapon or an Unarmed Strike—and deal damage to the target, you gain a bonus to the damage that increases as you gain levels as a Barbarian, as shown in the Rage Damage column of the Barbarian Features table.

Strength Vantagem. You have Advantage on Strength checks and Strength saving throws.

No Concentration or Spells. You can't maintain Concentration, and you can't cast spells.

Duration. The Rage lasts until the end of your next turn, and it ends early if you don Heavy armor or have the Incapacitated condition. If your Rage is still active on your next turn, you can extend the Rage for another round by doing one of the following:

  • Make an attack roll against an enemy.
  • Force an enemy to make a saving throw.
  • Take a Bonus Action to extend your Rage.

Each time the Rage is extended, it lasts until the end of your next turn. You can maintain a Rage for up to 10 minutes.

Nota do Foundry

This feature includes an Active Effect which automates the Resistance and additional damage. This feature will also automatically recharge your Rage uses on a Short and Long Rest.

Unarmored Defense.name: Unarmored Defense
Unarmored Defense.description:
While you aren't wearing armor or wielding a Shield, your base Armor Class equals 10 plus your Dexterity and Wisdom modifiers.

Nota do Foundry

This feature includes an Active Effect which updates your Armor Class.

Weapon Mastery.name: Maestria com Armas
Weapon Mastery.description:
Seu treinamento com armas permite que você use as propriedades de maestria de dois tipos de armas, à sua escolha, com as quais tenha proficiência, como adagas e arcos curtos.

Sempre que você terminar um descanso longo, você poderá mudar os tipos de armas escolhidos. Por exemplo, você poderia passar a usar as propriedades de maestria de cimitarras e espadas curtas.

Clothes, Traveler's.name: Traje de Viajante
Clothes, Traveler's.description: Traveler's Clothes are resilient garments designed for travel in various environments.

Mason's Tools.name: Mason's Tools
Mason's Tools.description:
Atributo: Strength

Usar: Chisel a symbol or hole in stone (DC 10)

Criação: @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagBlockandTac]{Block and Tackle}

Explorer's Pack.name: Explorer's Pack
Explorer's Pack.description: An Explorer's Pack contains the following items: @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagBackpack000]{Mochila}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagBedroll0000]{Saco de Dormir}, 2 frascos de @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagOil00000000]{Óleo}, 10 dias de @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagRations0000]{Rações}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagRope0000000]{Corda}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagTinderbox00]{Caixa para Fogo}, 10 @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagTorch000000]{Tochas}, and @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagWaterskin00]{Cantil}.

Tinderbox.name: Caixa para Fogo
Tinderbox.description: A caixa para fogo é um pequeno recipiente contendo sílica, pederneira e uma acendalha (geralmente pano seco embebido em óleo) usada para atear fogo. Suas utilidades incluem, como uma ação bônus, acender vela, lamparina, lanterna ou tocha, bem como qualquer outro objeto com combustível exposto. Acender outros tipos de fogo leva 1 minuto.

Rope.name: Corda
Rope.description:
As a Utilize action, you can tie a knot with Rope if you succeed on a DC 10 Dexterity (Prestidigitação) check. The Rope can be burst with a successful DC 20 Strength (Athletics) check.

You can bind an unwilling creature with the Rope only if the creature has the &Reference[Grappled], &Reference[Incapacitated], or &Reference[Restrained] condition. If the creature's legs are bound, the creature has the Restrained condition until it escapes. Escaping the Rope requires the creature to make a successful DC 15 Dexterity (Acrobatics) check as an action.

Bedroll.name: Saco de Dormir
Bedroll.description: A Bedroll sleeps one Small or Medium creature. While in a Bedroll, you automatically succeed on saving throws against extreme cold (see @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.content24.JournalEntry.dmgDmsToolbox000]{Gameplay Toolbox}).

Waterskin.name: Cantil
Waterskin.description: A Waterskin holds up to 4 pints. If you don't drink sufficient water, you risk &Reference[dehydration].

Water (Pint).name: Água (Quartilho)
Water (Pint).description: If you don't drink sufficient water, you risk &Reference[dehydration].

Torch.name: Tocha
Torch.description: Uma tocha queima por 1 hora, emitindo luz plena em um raio de 6 metros e meia-luz por mais 6 metros. Ao executar a ação atacar, você pode atacar com a tocha, usando-a como uma arma de combate corpo a corpo simples. Em caso de acerto, o alvo sofre 1 ponto de dano ígneo.

Oil.name: Óleo
Oil.description:
You can douse a creature, object, or space with Oil or use it as fuel, as detailed below.

Dousing a Creature or an Object. When you take the Attack action, you can replace one of your attacks with throwing an Oil flask. Target one creature or object within 20 feet of yourself. The target must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw (DC 8 plus your Dexterity modifier and Proficiency Bonus) or be covered in oil. If the target takes Fire damage before the oil dries (after 1 minute), the target takes an extra [[/damage 5 type=fire]] damage from burning oil.

Dousing a Space. You can take the Utilize action to pour an Oil flask on level ground to cover a 5-foot-square area within 5 feet of yourself. If lit, the oil burns until the end of the turn 2 rounds from when the oil was lit (or 12 seconds) and deals 5 Fire damage to any creature that enters the area or ends its turn there. A creature can take this damage only once per turn.

Fuel. Oil serves as fuel for Lamps and Lanterns. Once lit, a flask of Oil burns for 6 hours in a Lamp or Lantern. That duration doesn't need to be consecutive; you can extinguish the burning Oil (as a Utilize action) and rekindle it again until it has burned for a total of 6 hours.

Rations.name: Rações
Rations.description: Rações consistem em alimentos prontos para viagem, incluindo carne seca, frutas secas, biscoito e nozes. Veja &Reference[Malnutrition] no glossário de regras em relação aos efeitos da falta de alimentação.

Goliath.name: Golias
Goliath.description:
@Embed[Compendium.dnd5e.content24.JournalEntry.phbAppendixSpeci.JournalEntryPage.phbspGoliath0000 inline classes="free-rules-embed"]

Traços de Golias

Tipo de Criatura: Humanoide

Tamanho: Médio (de 2 a 2,5 metros de altura).

Deslocamento: 10,5 metros

Como alguém desta espécie, você tem os seguintes traços especiais.

Ancestralidade Gigante. You are descended from Giants. Choose one of the following benefits—a supernatural boon from your ancestry; you can use the chosen benefit a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest:

Cloud's Jaunt (Cloud Giant). As a Bonus Action, you magically teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see.

Fire's Burn (Fire Giant). When you hit a target with an attack roll and deal damage to it, you can also deal 1d10 Fire damage to that target.

Frost's Chill (Frost Giant). When you hit a target with an attack roll and deal damage to it, you can also deal 1d6 Cold damage to that target and reduce its Speed by 10 feet until the start of your next turn.

Hill's Tumble (Hill Giant). When you hit a Large or smaller creature with an attack roll and deal damage to it, you can give that target the &Reference[Prone] condition.

Stone's Endurance (Stone Giant). When you take damage, you can take a Reaction to roll 1d12. Add your Constitution modifier to the number rolled and reduce the damage by that total.

Storm's Thunder (Storm Giant). When you take damage from a creature within 60 feet of you, you can take a Reaction to deal 1d8 Thunder damage to that creature.

Large Form. Starting at character level 5, you can change your size to Large as a Bonus Action if you're in a big enough space. This transformation lasts for 10 minutes or until you end it (no action required). For that duration, you have Advantage on Strength checks, and your Speed increases by 10 feet. Uma vez que você usar este traço, não poderá usá- lo novamente até terminar um descanso longo.

Powerful Build. You have Advantage on any ability check you make to end the Grappled condition. You also count as one size larger when determining your carrying capacity.

Giant Ancestry.hint: You are descended from Giants. Choose one of the following benefits—a supernatural boon from your ancestry; you can use the chosen benefit a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest.

Powerful Build.name: Powerful Build
Powerful Build.description:
You have Advantage on any ability check you make to end the &Reference[Grappled apply=false] condition. You also count as one size larger when determining your carrying capacity.

Nota do Foundry

This feature includes an Active Effect which automatically upgrades your size when determining carrying capacity.

Cloud's Jaunt.name: Cloud's Jaunt
Cloud's Jaunt.description: As a Bonus Action, you magically teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see.

Danger Sense.name: Sentido de Perigo
Danger Sense.description:
Você tem um sentido extraordinário para perceber quando as coisas não estão como deveriam estar, o que lhe dá uma vantagem ao se esquivar de perigos. Você tem vantagem nas salvaguardas de Destreza, a menos que esteja sob a condição &Reference[Incapacitated].

Nota do Foundry

Esse recurso automatiza a vantagem nas salvaguardas de Destreza, mas não é desativado automaticamente quando o personagem está Incapacitado. Ele pode ser desativado temporariamente na aba “Efeitos”.

Danger Sense.name: Sentido de Perigo
Danger Sense.description: Você tem vantagem nas salvaguardas de Destreza, a menos que esteja sob a condição &Reference[Incapacitated].

Reckless Attack.name: Ataque Imprudente
Reckless Attack.description:
Você pode deixar de lado qualquer preocupação com a defesa para atacar com maior ferocidade. Ao fazer a primeira jogada de ataque no seu turno, você pode decidir atacar de forma imprudente. Isso lhe dá vantagem nas jogadas de ataque usando Força até o início do seu próximo turno, mas as jogadas de ataque contra você também têm vantagem durante esse período.

Nota do Foundry

Esse recurso inclui um Efeito Ativo para monitorar se você está agindo de forma imprudente ou não, mas não automatiza a Vantagem em seus ataques nem nos ataques contra você.

Primal Knowledge.name: Conhecimento Primordial
Primal Knowledge.description:
Você ganha proficiência em outra perícia à sua escolha da lista de perícias disponíveis para Bárbaros no 1° nível.

Além disso, enquanto sua Fúria estiver ativa, você pode canalizar o poder primordial ao tentar realizar determinadas tarefas; sempre que fizer um teste de atributo usando uma das seguintes perícias, você pode fazê-lo usando Força, mesmo que normalmente use um atributo diferente: Acrobacia, Furtividade, Intimidação, Percepção ou Sobrevivência. Quando usa essa habilidade sua Força representa o poder primordial que flui através de você, aprimorando sua agilidade, seu equilíbrio e seus sentidos.

Nota do Foundry

Essa característica inclui um Efeito Ativo que fará com que essas perícias utilizem automaticamente seu modificador de Força, caso ele seja maior do que o Valor de Atributo normal associado à perícia.

Path of the Berserker.name: Trilha do Berserker
Path of the Berserker.description:
Canalize a ira para transformá-la em uma fúria violenta

Os bárbaros que seguem a Trilha do Berserker direcionam sua Fúria principalmente para a violência. Seu caminho é o da fúria desenfreada, e eles se ernocioam com o caos da batalha ao permitir que sua Fúria os domine e os fortaleça.

Frenzy.name: Frenesi
Frenzy.description:
Se usar Ataque Imprudente enquanto sua Fúria estiver ativa, você causa dano extra ao primeiro alvo atingido com um ataque baseado em Força no seu turno. Para determinar o dano extra, jogue uma quantidade de d6 igual ao seu bônus de Dano da Fúria e some-os. O dano é do mesmo tipo da arma ou do ataque desarmado utilizado.

Nota do Foundry

A atividade Dano se ajusta automaticamente à medida que você sobe de nível e permite que você selecione o tipo de dano a ser usado na caixa de diálogo do lançamento de dano. A partir daí, ela lembrará da sua escolha para as próximas vezes.

Large Form.name: Large Form
Large Form.description:
Starting at character level 5, you can change your size to Large as a Bonus Action if you're in a big enough space. This transformation lasts for 10 minutes or until you end it (no action required). For that duration, you have Advantage on Strength checks, and your Speed increases by 10 feet. Uma vez que você usar este traço, não poderá usá- lo novamente até terminar um descanso longo.

Nota do Foundry

This feature includes an Active Effect which automates the increase to your Speed and the Advantage on Strength checks.

Large Form.name: Large Form
Large Form.description: For the duration, you have Advantage on Strength checks, and your Speed increases by 10 feet. Uma vez que você usar este traço, não poderá usá-lo novamente até terminar um descanso longo.

Extra Attack.name: Ataque Extra
Extra Attack.description: Você pode atacar duas vezes, em vez de uma, sempre que executar a ação atacar em seu turno.

Fast Movement.name: Movimento Rápido
Fast Movement.description:
Seu deslocamento aumenta em 3 metros enquanto você não estiver usando armadura pesada.

Nota do Foundry

Essa característica inclui um efeito ativo que aumenta automaticamente seu deslocamento. Desative o efeito ativo “Movimento Rápido” se estiver usando armadura pesada.

Potion of Healing.name: Potion of Healing
Potion of Healing.description: This potion is a magic item. As a Bonus Action, you can drink it or administer it to another creature within 5 feet of yourself. The creature that drinks the magical red fluid in this vial regains 2d4 + 2 Hit Points.

Winged Boots.name: Winged Boots
Winged Boots.description:
Wondrous Item, Uncommon (Requires Attunement)

These boots have 4 charges and regain 1d4 expended charges daily at dawn. While wearing the boots, you can take a Magic action to expend 1 charge, gaining a Fly Speed of 30 feet for 1 hour. If you are flying when the duration expires, you descend at a rate of 30 feet per round until you land.

Winged.name: Alado
Winged.description: The wings lasts for 1 hour or until you end the effect early as a Magic action. The wings give you a Fly Speed of 60 feet.

MerricLv11000000.name: Merric
MerricLv11000000.description:
Merric was once a vigilante, due to her innate sense of street justice. Though her imposing stature makes her a force to be reckoned with in combat, it is her violent outbursts of rage that truly set her apart.

Token artwork by Forgotten Adventures.

Token artwork by Forgotten Adventures.

Vigilante.name: Vigilante
Vigilante.description:
Valores de Atributo: Strength, Constitution, Charisma

Talento: Savage Attacker

Proficiências em Perícias: Athletics, Insight

Proficiência com Ferramentas: Choose one kind of Artisan's Tools

Equipamento: Choose A or B: (A) Artisan's Tools (same as above), @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagClothesTrav], [[/award 32gp]] ou (B) [[/award 50gp]]

Savage Attacker.name: Savage Attacker
Savage Attacker.description: You've trained to deal particularly damaging strikes. Once per turn when you hit a target with a weapon, you can roll the weapon's damage dice twice and use either roll against the target.

Barbarian.name: Bárbaro
Barbarian.description:
Core Barbarian Traits

Atributo Primário

Strength

Dado de Vida

D12 per Barbarian level

Proficiências em Salvaguardas

Força e Constituição

Proficiências em Perícias

Escolha 2: Animal Handling, Athletics, Intimidation, Nature, Perception, or Survival

Proficiências com Armas

Armas simples e marciais

Treinamento com Armadura

Armaduras leves e médias, escudos

Equipamento Inicial

Escolha A ou B: (A) @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbwepGreataxe00]{Greataxe}, 4 @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbwepHandaxe000]{Handaxes}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagExplorersPa]{Explorer's Pack} e [[/award 15GP]]; ou (B) [[/award 75GP]]

@Embed[Compendium.dnd5e.content24.JournalEntry.phbAppendixClass.JournalEntryPage.phbbrbBarbarian0 inline classes="free-rules-embed"]

Becoming a Barbarian …

Como um Personagem de 1º Nível

  • Gain all the traits in the Core Barbarian Traits table.
  • Gain the Barbarian's level 1 features, which are listed in the Barbarian Features table.

Como um Personagem Multiclasse

  • Gain the following traits from the Core Barbarian Traits table: Hit Point Die, proficiency with Martial weapons, and training with Shields.
  • Gain the Barbarian's level 1 features, which are listed in the Barbarian Features table.

Primal Knowledge.hint: Você ganha proficiência em outra perícia à sua escolha da lista de perícias disponíveis para Bárbaros no 1° nível.
