Quando seu personagem atinge os níveis 3 e 5, você aprende uma magia de círculo mais alto, como indicado na tabela. Você sempre tem esta magia preparada. Você pode conjurá-la uma vez sem um espaço de magia, e recupera a habilidade de conjurá-la dessa forma ao final de um descanso longo. Você também pode conjurar a magia usando quaisquer espaços de magia do círculo apropriado que tiver. Inteligência, Sabedoria ou Carisma são seu atributo de conjuração para as magias que você conjura com este traço (escolha o atributo ao selecionar a linhagem).

Wood Elf Lineage Features
Nível 1Nível 3Nível 5
Your Speed increases to 35 feet. Você também conhece o truque @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplDruidcraft]{Druidcraft}.@UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplLongstride]{Longstrider}@UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplPasswithou]{Pass without Trace}

Nota do Foundry

Você receberá automaticamente as características e magias relevantes ao selecionar a espécie e à medida que subir de nível.

Ranger.name: Guardião
Ranger.description:
Core Ranger Traits

Atributo Primário

Dexterity and Wisdom

Dado de Vida

D10 per Ranger level

Proficiências em Salvaguardas

Strength and Dexterity

Proficiências em Perícias

Choose 3: Animal Handling, Athletics, Insight, Investigation, Nature, Perception, Stealth, or Survival

Proficiências com Armas

Armas simples e marciais

Treinamento com Armadura

Armaduras leves e médias, escudos

Equipamento Inicial

Choose A or B: (A) @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbarmStuddedLea]{Armadura de Couro Batido}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbwepScimitar00]{Cimitarra}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbwepShortsword]{Shortsword}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbwepLongbow000]{Arco Longo}, 20 @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbamoArrows0000]{Flechas}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagQuiver00000]{Aljava}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagDruidicFocu]{Druidic Focus} (@UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbdfcSprigofmis]{sprig of mistletoe}), @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagExplorersPa]{Explorer's Pack} e [[/award 7GP]]; ou (B) [[/award 150GP]]

@Embed[Compendium.dnd5e.content24.JournalEntry.phbAppendixClass.JournalEntryPage.phbrgrRanger0000 inline classes="free-rules-embed"]

Becoming a Ranger …

Como um Personagem de 1º Nível

  • Gain all the traits in the Core Ranger Traits table.
  • Gain the Ranger's level 1 features, which are listed in the Ranger Features table.

Como um Personagem Multiclasse

  • Gain the following traits from the Core Ranger Traits table: Hit Point Die, proficiency with Martial weapons, proficiency in one skill of your choice from the Ranger's skill list, and training with Light and Medium armor and Shields.
  • Gain the Ranger's level 1 features, which are listed in the Ranger Features table. Veja as regras de multiclasse no capítulo 2 para determinar seus espaços de magia disponíveis.

Druidcraft.name: Druidcraft
Druidcraft.description:
Whispering to the spirits of nature, you create one of the following effects within range.

Weather Sensor. You create a Tiny, harmless sensory effect that predicts what the weather will be at your location for the next 24 hours. The effect might manifest as a golden orb for clear skies, a cloud for rain, falling snowflakes for snow, and so on. This effect persists for 1 round.

Bloom. You instantly make a flower blossom, a seed pod open, or a leaf bud bloom.

Efeito Sensorial. You create a harmless sensory effect, such as falling leaves, spectral dancing fairies, a gentle breeze, the sound of an animal, or the faint odor of skunk. The effect must fit in a 5-foot Cube.

Brincar com Fogo. You light or snuff out a candle, a torch, or a campfire.

Spellcasting.name: Conjuração
Spellcasting.description:
As a student of arcane magic, you have learned to cast spells. See the @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.content24.JournalEntry.phbSpells0000000.JournalEntryPage.b2QVn25z2N1ykWpf]{rules on spellcasting}. The information below details how you use those rules with Wizard spells, which appear in the @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.content24.JournalEntry.phbSpells0000000.JournalEntryPage.6AnqLUowgdsqMFvz]{Lista de Magias do Mago}.

Cantrips. You know three Wizard cantrips of your choice. @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplLight00000]{Luz}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplMageHand00]{Mãos Mágicas}, and @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplRayofFrost]{Ray of Frost} are recommended. Whenever you finish a Long Rest, you can replace one of your cantrips from this feature with another Wizard cantrip of your choice.

When you reach Wizard levels 4 and 10, you learn another Wizard cantrip of your choice, as shown in the Cantrips column of the @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.content24.JournalEntry.phbWizard0000000.JournalEntryPage.g7cMRWzsgAsEF7zC#class-features]{Wizard Features table}.

Spellbook. Your wizardly apprenticeship culminated in the creation of a unique book: your spellbook. It is a Tiny object that weighs 3 pounds, contains 100 pages, and can be read only by you or someone casting @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplIdentify00]{Identify}. You determine the book's appearance and materials, such as a gilt-edged tome or a collection of vellum bound with twine.

The book contains the level 1+ spells you know. It starts with six level 1 Wizard spells of your choice. @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplDetectMagi]{Detectar Magia}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplFeatherFal]{Feather Fall}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplMageArmor0]{Mage Armor}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplMagicMissi]{Magic Missile}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplSleep00000]{Sleep}, and @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplThunderwav]{Thunderwave} are recommended.

Whenever you gain a Wizard level after 1, add two Wizard spells of your choice to your spellbook. Each of these spells must be of a level for which you have spell slots, as shown in the Wizard Features table. The spells are the culmination of arcane research you do regularly.

Espaços de Magia. The Wizard Features table shows how many spell slots you have to cast your level 1+ spells. You regain all expended slots when you finish a Long Rest.

Magias Preparadas de 1º Círculo ou Maior. Você prepara a lista de magias de 1° círculo ou maior disponíveis para conjuração com esta característica. To do so, choose four spells from your spellbook. The chosen spells must be of a level for which you have spell slots.

The number of spells on your list increases as you gain Wizard levels, as shown in the Prepared Spells column of the Wizard Features table. Whenever that number increases, choose additional Wizard spells until the number of spells on your list matches the number in the table. The chosen spells must be of a level for which you have spell slots. For example, if you're a level 3 Wizard, your list of prepared spells can include six spells of levels 1 and 2 in any combination, chosen from your spellbook.

If another Wizard feature gives you spells that you always have prepared, those spells don't count against the number of spells you can prepare with this feature, but those spells otherwise count as Wizard spells for you.

Mudando Suas Magias Preparadas. Whenever you finish a Long Rest, you can change your list of prepared spells, replacing any of the spells there with spells from your spellbook.

Spellcasting Ability. Intelligence is your spellcasting ability for your Wizard spells.

Foco de Conjuração. You can use an Arcane Focus or your spellbook as a Spellcasting Focus for your Wizard spells.

Weapon Mastery.name: Maestria com Armas
Weapon Mastery.description:
Seu treinamento com armas permite que você use as propriedades de maestria de dois tipos de armas, à sua escolha, com as quais tenha proficiência, como adagas e arcos curtos.

Sempre que você terminar um descanso longo, você poderá mudar os tipos de armas escolhidos. Por exemplo, você poderia passar a usar as propriedades de maestria de cimitarras e espadas curtas.

Cure Wounds.name: Curar Ferimentos
Cure Wounds.description:
Uma criatura tocada por você recupera um número de pontos de vida igual a 2d8 mais seu modificador de atributo de conjuração.

Usando Espaços de Magia de Círculo Superior. A cura aumenta em 2d8 para cada círculo de espaço de magia acima do 1°.

Ensnaring Strike.name: Ensnaring Strike
Ensnaring Strike.description:
As you hit the target, grasping vines appear on it, and it makes a Strength saving throw. A Large or larger creature has Advantage on this save. On a failed save, the target has the &Reference[restrained apply=false] condition until the spell ends. On a successful save, the vines shrivel away, and the spell ends.

While Restrained, the target takes 1d6 Piercing damage at the start of each of its turns. The target or a creature within reach of it can take an action to make a [[/check ability=str skill=ath dc=@attributes.spell.dc]] check against your spell save DC. On a success, the spell ends.

Usando Espaços de Magia de Círculo Superior. The damage increases by 1d6 for each spell slot level above 1.
Ensnaring Strike.condition: Immediately after hitting a creature with a weapon

Ensnared.name: Ensnared
Ensnared.description:
The target has the &Reference[restrained apply=false] condition until the spell ends.

While Restrained, the target takes [[/damage 1d6 type=piercing]] (plus 1d6 per spell slot level above 1) damage at the start of each of its turns. The target or a creature within reach of it can take an action to make a [[/check ability=str skill=ath]] check against your spell save DC. On a success, the spell ends.

Herbalism Kit.name: Herbalism Kit
Herbalism Kit.description:
Atributo: Intelligence

Usar: Identify a plant (DC 10)

Criação: @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagAntitoxin00]{Antitoxin}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagCandle00000]{Candle}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagHealersKit0]{Kit de Curandeiro}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagPotionofHea]{Potion of Healing}

Clothes, Traveler's.name: Traje de Viajante
Clothes, Traveler's.description: Traveler's Clothes are resilient garments designed for travel in various environments.

Hunting Trap.name: Hunting Trap
Hunting Trap.description: As a Utilize action, you can set a Hunting Trap, which is a sawtooth steel ring that snaps shut when a creature steps on a pressure plate in the center. The trap is affixed by a heavy chain to an immobile object, such as a tree or a spike driven into the ground. A creature that steps on the plate must succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw or take 1d4 Piercing damage and have its Speed reduced to 0 until the start of its next turn. Thereafter, until the creature breaks free of the trap, its movement is limited by the length of the chain (typically 3 feet). A creature can use its action to make a DC 13 Strength (Athletics) check, freeing itself or another creature within its reach on a success. Each failed check deals [[/damage 1 type=piercing]] damage to the trapped creature.

Net.name: Net
Net.description:
When you take the Attack action, you can replace one of your attacks with throwing a Net. Target a creature you can see within 15 feet of yourself. The target must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw (DC 8 plus your Dexterity modifier and Proficiency Bonus) or have the &Reference[Restrained] condition until it escapes. The target succeeds automatically if it is Huge or larger.

To escape, the target or a creature within 5 feet of it must take an action to make a [[/skill ath 10]] check, freeing the Restrained creature on a success. Destroying the Net (CA 10; 5 HP; Immunity to Bludgeoning, Poison, and Psychic damage) also frees the target, ending the effect.

Arrows.name: Flechas
Arrows.description:
Armazenamento: @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagQuiver00000]{Aljava}

Qualquer arma que possua a propriedade munição requer algum tipo de @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagAmmunitionV]{munição}. A descrição da arma especifica o tipo de munição usada por ela. A tabela Munição lista os diferentes tipos e a quantidade obtida ao comprá-las. A tabela também lista o item normalmente usado para armazenar cada tipo de munição, que é vendido separadamente.

Sprig of mistletoe.name: Sprig of mistletoe
Sprig of mistletoe.description: A @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagDruidicFocu]{Druidic Focus} takes one of the forms in the Druidic Focuses table and is carved, tied with ribbon, or painted to channel primal magic. A Druid or Ranger can use such an object as a Spellcasting Focus.

Explorer's Pack.name: Explorer's Pack
Explorer's Pack.description: An Explorer's Pack contains the following items: @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagBackpack000]{Mochila}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagBedroll0000]{Saco de Dormir}, 2 frascos de @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagOil00000000]{Óleo}, 10 dias de @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagRations0000]{Rações}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagRope0000000]{Corda}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagTinderbox00]{Caixa para Fogo}, 10 @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagTorch000000]{Tochas}, and @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagWaterskin00]{Cantil}.

Tinderbox.name: Caixa para Fogo
Tinderbox.description: A caixa para fogo é um pequeno recipiente contendo sílica, pederneira e uma acendalha (geralmente pano seco embebido em óleo) usada para atear fogo. Suas utilidades incluem, como uma ação bônus, acender vela, lamparina, lanterna ou tocha, bem como qualquer outro objeto com combustível exposto. Acender outros tipos de fogo leva 1 minuto.

Rope.name: Corda
Rope.description:
As a Utilize action, you can tie a knot with Rope if you succeed on a DC 10 Dexterity (Prestidigitação) check. The Rope can be burst with a successful DC 20 Strength (Athletics) check.

You can bind an unwilling creature with the Rope only if the creature has the &Reference[Grappled], &Reference[Incapacitated], or &Reference[Restrained] condition. If the creature's legs are bound, the creature has the Restrained condition until it escapes. Escaping the Rope requires the creature to make a successful DC 15 Dexterity (Acrobatics) check as an action.

Bedroll.name: Saco de Dormir
Bedroll.description: A Bedroll sleeps one Small or Medium creature. While in a Bedroll, you automatically succeed on saving throws against extreme cold (see @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.content24.JournalEntry.dmgDmsToolbox000]{Gameplay Toolbox}).

Waterskin.name: Cantil
Waterskin.description: A Waterskin holds up to 4 pints. If you don't drink sufficient water, you risk &Reference[dehydration].

Water (Pint).name: Água (Quartilho)
Water (Pint).description: If you don't drink sufficient water, you risk &Reference[dehydration].

Torch.name: Tocha
Torch.description: Uma tocha queima por 1 hora, emitindo luz plena em um raio de 6 metros e meia-luz por mais 6 metros. Ao executar a ação atacar, você pode atacar com a tocha, usando-a como uma arma de combate corpo a corpo simples. Em caso de acerto, o alvo sofre 1 ponto de dano ígneo.

Oil.name: Óleo
Oil.description:
You can douse a creature, object, or space with Oil or use it as fuel, as detailed below.

Dousing a Creature or an Object. When you take the Attack action, you can replace one of your attacks with throwing an Oil flask. Target one creature or object within 20 feet of yourself. The target must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw (DC 8 plus your Dexterity modifier and Proficiency Bonus) or be covered in oil. If the target takes Fire damage before the oil dries (after 1 minute), the target takes an extra [[/damage 5 type=fire]] damage from burning oil.

Dousing a Space. You can take the Utilize action to pour an Oil flask on level ground to cover a 5-foot-square area within 5 feet of yourself. If lit, the oil burns until the end of the turn 2 rounds from when the oil was lit (or 12 seconds) and deals 5 Fire damage to any creature that enters the area or ends its turn there. A creature can take this damage only once per turn.

Fuel. Oil serves as fuel for Lamps and Lanterns. Once lit, a flask of Oil burns for 6 hours in a Lamp or Lantern. That duration doesn't need to be consecutive; you can extinguish the burning Oil (as a Utilize action) and rekindle it again until it has burned for a total of 6 hours.

Rations.name: Rações
Rations.description: Rações consistem em alimentos prontos para viagem, incluindo carne seca, frutas secas, biscoito e nozes. Veja &Reference[Malnutrition] no glossário de regras em relação aos efeitos da falta de alimentação.

Favored Enemy.name: Inimigo Favorito
Favored Enemy.description:
You always have the @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplHuntersMar]{Marca do Predador} spell prepared. You can cast it twice without expending a spell slot, and you regain all expended uses of this ability when you finish a Long Rest.

The number of times you can cast the spell without a spell slot increases when you reach certain Ranger levels, as shown in the Favored Enemy column of the Ranger Features table.

Hunter's Mark.name: Hunter's Mark
Hunter's Mark.description:
You magically mark one creature you can see within range as your quarry. Until the spell ends, you deal an extra [[/damage]] damage to the target whenever you hit it with an attack roll. You also have Advantage on any [[/check ability=wis skill=prc]] or [[/check ability=wis skill=sur]] check you make to find it.

If the target drops to 0 Hit Points before this spell ends, you can take a Bonus Action to move the mark to a new creature you can see within range.

Usando Espaços de Magia de Círculo Superior. Your Concentration can last longer with a spell slot of level 3–4 (up to 8 hours) or 5+ (up to 24 hours).

Hunter's Mark.name: Hunter's Mark

Alert.name: Alerta

Você ganha os seguintes benefícios.

Proficiência em Iniciativa. Ao rolar iniciativa, você pode adicionar seu bônus de proficiência ao resultado.

Troca de Iniciativa. Imediatamente após rolar iniciativa, você pode trocar sua iniciativa com a de um aliado disposto no mesmo combate. You can't make this swap if you or the ally has the &Reference[Incapacitated] condition.

Nota do Foundry

Essa característica adiciona automaticamente o bônus à sua Iniciativa.

Elf, Wood.name: Elf, Wood
Elf, Wood.description:
@Embed[Compendium.dnd5e.content24.JournalEntry.phbAppendixSpeci.JournalEntryPage.phbspElf00000000 inline classes="free-rules-embed"]

Wood Elves

@Embed[Compendium.dnd5e.content24.JournalEntry.phbAppendixSpeci.JournalEntryPage.phbspWoodElf0000 inline classes="free-rules-embed"]

Traços de Elfo

Tipo de Criatura: Humanoide

Tamanho: Médio (de 1,5 a 1,8 metro de altura).

Deslocamento: 9 metros

Como um elfo, você possui esses traços especiais.

Visão no Escuro. Você tem visão no escuro com distância de 18 metros.

Linhagem Élfica. Você faz parte de uma linhagem que lhe concede habilidades sobrenaturais.

Quando seu personagem atinge os níveis 3 e 5, você aprende uma magia de círculo mais alto, como indicado na tabela. Você sempre tem esta magia preparada. Você pode conjurá-la uma vez sem um espaço de magia, e recupera a habilidade de conjurá-la dessa forma ao final de um descanso longo. Você também pode conjurar a magia usando quaisquer espaços de magia do círculo apropriado que tiver. Inteligência, Sabedoria ou Carisma são seu atributo de conjuração para as magias que você conjura com este traço (escolha o atributo ao selecionar a linhagem).

Nível 1Nível 3Nível 5

Sentidos Aguçados. Você tem proficiência nas perícias Intuição, Percepção ou Sobrevivência.

Transe. Você não precisa dormir, e magia não pode fazer você dormir. Você pode concluir um descanso longo em 4 horas se passar essas horas meditando em transe, durante o qual você se mantém consciente.

Ranger.name: Guardião
Ranger.description:
Core Ranger Traits

Atributo Primário

Dexterity and Wisdom

Dado de Vida

D10 per Ranger level

Proficiências em Salvaguardas

Strength and Dexterity

Proficiências em Perícias

Choose 3: Animal Handling, Athletics, Insight, Investigation, Nature, Perception, Stealth, or Survival

Armas simples e marciais

Armaduras leves e médias, escudos

Equipamento Inicial

Choose A or B: (A) @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbarmStuddedLea]{Armadura de Couro Batido}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbwepScimitar00]{Cimitarra}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbwepShortsword]{Shortsword}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbwepLongbow000]{Arco Longo}, 20 @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbamoArrows0000]{Flechas}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagQuiver00000]{Aljava}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagDruidicFocu]{Druidic Focus} (@UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbdfcSprigofmis]{sprig of mistletoe}), @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagExplorersPa]{Explorer's Pack} e [[/award 7GP]]; ou (B) [[/award 150GP]]

@Embed[Compendium.dnd5e.content24.JournalEntry.phbAppendixClass.JournalEntryPage.phbrgrRanger0000 inline classes="free-rules-embed"]

Becoming a Ranger …

Como um Personagem de 1º Nível

  • Gain all the traits in the Core Ranger Traits table.
  • Gain the Ranger's level 1 features, which are listed in the Ranger Features table.

Como um Personagem Multiclasse

  • Gain the following traits from the Core Ranger Traits table: Hit Point Die, proficiency with Martial weapons, proficiency in one skill of your choice from the Ranger's skill list, and training with Light and Medium armor and Shields.
  • Gain the Ranger's level 1 features, which are listed in the Ranger Features table. Veja as regras de multiclasse no capítulo 2 para determinar seus espaços de magia disponíveis.

Druidcraft.name: Druidcraft
Druidcraft.description:
Whispering to the spirits of nature, you create one of the following effects within range.

Weather Sensor. You create a Tiny, harmless sensory effect that predicts what the weather will be at your location for the next 24 hours. The effect might manifest as a golden orb for clear skies, a cloud for rain, falling snowflakes for snow, and so on. This effect persists for 1 round.

Bloom. You instantly make a flower blossom, a seed pod open, or a leaf bud bloom.

Efeito Sensorial. You create a harmless sensory effect, such as falling leaves, spectral dancing fairies, a gentle breeze, the sound of an animal, or the faint odor of skunk. The effect must fit in a 5-foot Cube.

Brincar com Fogo. You light or snuff out a candle, a torch, or a campfire.

Spellcasting.name: Conjuração
Spellcasting.description:
As a student of arcane magic, you have learned to cast spells. See the @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.content24.JournalEntry.phbSpells0000000.JournalEntryPage.b2QVn25z2N1ykWpf]{rules on spellcasting}. The information below details how you use those rules with Wizard spells, which appear in the @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.content24.JournalEntry.phbSpells0000000.JournalEntryPage.6AnqLUowgdsqMFvz]{Lista de Magias do Mago}.

Cantrips. You know three Wizard cantrips of your choice. @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplLight00000]{Luz}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplMageHand00]{Mãos Mágicas}, and @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplRayofFrost]{Ray of Frost} are recommended. Whenever you finish a Long Rest, you can replace one of your cantrips from this feature with another Wizard cantrip of your choice.

When you reach Wizard levels 4 and 10, you learn another Wizard cantrip of your choice, as shown in the Cantrips column of the @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.content24.JournalEntry.phbWizard0000000.JournalEntryPage.g7cMRWzsgAsEF7zC#class-features]{Wizard Features table}.

Spellbook. Your wizardly apprenticeship culminated in the creation of a unique book: your spellbook. It is a Tiny object that weighs 3 pounds, contains 100 pages, and can be read only by you or someone casting @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplIdentify00]{Identify}. You determine the book's appearance and materials, such as a gilt-edged tome or a collection of vellum bound with twine.

The book contains the level 1+ spells you know. It starts with six level 1 Wizard spells of your choice. @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplDetectMagi]{Detectar Magia}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplFeatherFal]{Feather Fall}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplMageArmor0]{Mage Armor}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplMagicMissi]{Magic Missile}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplSleep00000]{Sleep}, and @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplThunderwav]{Thunderwave} are recommended.

Whenever you gain a Wizard level after 1, add two Wizard spells of your choice to your spellbook. Each of these spells must be of a level for which you have spell slots, as shown in the Wizard Features table. The spells are the culmination of arcane research you do regularly.

Espaços de Magia. The Wizard Features table shows how many spell slots you have to cast your level 1+ spells. You regain all expended slots when you finish a Long Rest.

Magias Preparadas de 1º Círculo ou Maior. Você prepara a lista de magias de 1° círculo ou maior disponíveis para conjuração com esta característica. To do so, choose four spells from your spellbook. The chosen spells must be of a level for which you have spell slots.

The number of spells on your list increases as you gain Wizard levels, as shown in the Prepared Spells column of the Wizard Features table. Whenever that number increases, choose additional Wizard spells until the number of spells on your list matches the number in the table. The chosen spells must be of a level for which you have spell slots. For example, if you're a level 3 Wizard, your list of prepared spells can include six spells of levels 1 and 2 in any combination, chosen from your spellbook.

If another Wizard feature gives you spells that you always have prepared, those spells don't count against the number of spells you can prepare with this feature, but those spells otherwise count as Wizard spells for you.

Mudando Suas Magias Preparadas. Whenever you finish a Long Rest, you can change your list of prepared spells, replacing any of the spells there with spells from your spellbook.

Spellcasting Ability. Intelligence is your spellcasting ability for your Wizard spells.

Foco de Conjuração. You can use an Arcane Focus or your spellbook as a Spellcasting Focus for your Wizard spells.

Weapon Mastery.name: Maestria com Armas
Weapon Mastery.description:
Seu treinamento com armas permite que você use as propriedades de maestria de dois tipos de armas, à sua escolha, com as quais tenha proficiência, como adagas e arcos curtos.

Sempre que você terminar um descanso longo, você poderá mudar os tipos de armas escolhidos. Por exemplo, você poderia passar a usar as propriedades de maestria de cimitarras e espadas curtas.

Cure Wounds.name: Curar Ferimentos
Cure Wounds.description:
Uma criatura tocada por você recupera um número de pontos de vida igual a 2d8 mais seu modificador de atributo de conjuração.

Usando Espaços de Magia de Círculo Superior. A cura aumenta em 2d8 para cada círculo de espaço de magia acima do 1°.

Ensnaring Strike.name: Ensnaring Strike
Ensnaring Strike.description:
As you hit the target, grasping vines appear on it, and it makes a Strength saving throw. A Large or larger creature has Advantage on this save. On a failed save, the target has the &Reference[restrained apply=false] condition until the spell ends. On a successful save, the vines shrivel away, and the spell ends.

While Restrained, the target takes 1d6 Piercing damage at the start of each of its turns. The target or a creature within reach of it can take an action to make a [[/check ability=str skill=ath dc=@attributes.spell.dc]] check against your spell save DC. On a success, the spell ends.

Usando Espaços de Magia de Círculo Superior. The damage increases by 1d6 for each spell slot level above 1.
Ensnaring Strike.condition: Immediately after hitting a creature with a weapon

Ensnared.name: Ensnared
Ensnared.description:
The target has the &Reference[restrained apply=false] condition until the spell ends.

While Restrained, the target takes [[/damage 1d6 type=piercing]] (plus 1d6 per spell slot level above 1) damage at the start of each of its turns. The target or a creature within reach of it can take an action to make a [[/check ability=str skill=ath]] check against your spell save DC. On a success, the spell ends.

Herbalism Kit.name: Herbalism Kit
Herbalism Kit.description:
Atributo: Intelligence

Usar: Identify a plant (DC 10)

Criação: @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagAntitoxin00]{Antitoxin}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagCandle00000]{Candle}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagHealersKit0]{Kit de Curandeiro}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagPotionofHea]{Potion of Healing}

Clothes, Traveler's.name: Traje de Viajante
Clothes, Traveler's.description: Traveler's Clothes are resilient garments designed for travel in various environments.

Net.name: Net
Net.description:
When you take the Attack action, you can replace one of your attacks with throwing a Net. Target a creature you can see within 15 feet of yourself. The target must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw (DC 8 plus your Dexterity modifier and Proficiency Bonus) or have the &Reference[Restrained] condition until it escapes. The target succeeds automatically if it is Huge or larger.

To escape, the target or a creature within 5 feet of it must take an action to make a [[/skill ath 10]] check, freeing the Restrained creature on a success. Destroying the Net (CA 10; 5 HP; Immunity to Bludgeoning, Poison, and Psychic damage) also frees the target, ending the effect.

Arrows.name: Flechas
Arrows.description:
Armazenamento: @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagQuiver00000]{Aljava}

Qualquer arma que possua a propriedade munição requer algum tipo de @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagAmmunitionV]{munição}. A descrição da arma especifica o tipo de munição usada por ela. A tabela Munição lista os diferentes tipos e a quantidade obtida ao comprá-las. A tabela também lista o item normalmente usado para armazenar cada tipo de munição, que é vendido separadamente.

Sprig of mistletoe.name: Sprig of mistletoe
Sprig of mistletoe.description: A @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagDruidicFocu]{Druidic Focus} takes one of the forms in the Druidic Focuses table and is carved, tied with ribbon, or painted to channel primal magic. A Druid or Ranger can use such an object as a Spellcasting Focus.

Explorer's Pack.name: Explorer's Pack
Explorer's Pack.description: An Explorer's Pack contains the following items: @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagBackpack000]{Mochila}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagBedroll0000]{Saco de Dormir}, 2 frascos de @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagOil00000000]{Óleo}, 10 dias de @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagRations0000]{Rações}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagRope0000000]{Corda}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagTinderbox00]{Caixa para Fogo}, 10 @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagTorch000000]{Tochas}, and @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagWaterskin00]{Cantil}.

Tinderbox.name: Caixa para Fogo
Tinderbox.description: A caixa para fogo é um pequeno recipiente contendo sílica, pederneira e uma acendalha (geralmente pano seco embebido em óleo) usada para atear fogo. Suas utilidades incluem, como uma ação bônus, acender vela, lamparina, lanterna ou tocha, bem como qualquer outro objeto com combustível exposto. Acender outros tipos de fogo leva 1 minuto.

Rope.name: Corda
Rope.description:
As a Utilize action, you can tie a knot with Rope if you succeed on a DC 10 Dexterity (Prestidigitação) check. The Rope can be burst with a successful DC 20 Strength (Athletics) check.

You can bind an unwilling creature with the Rope only if the creature has the &Reference[Grappled], &Reference[Incapacitated], or &Reference[Restrained] condition. If the creature's legs are bound, the creature has the Restrained condition until it escapes. Escaping the Rope requires the creature to make a successful DC 15 Dexterity (Acrobatics) check as an action.

Bedroll.name: Saco de Dormir
Bedroll.description: A Bedroll sleeps one Small or Medium creature. While in a Bedroll, you automatically succeed on saving throws against extreme cold (see @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.content24.JournalEntry.dmgDmsToolbox000]{Gameplay Toolbox}).

Waterskin.name: Cantil
Waterskin.description: A Waterskin holds up to 4 pints. If you don't drink sufficient water, you risk &Reference[dehydration].

Water (Pint).name: Água (Quartilho)
Water (Pint).description: If you don't drink sufficient water, you risk &Reference[dehydration].

Torch.name: Tocha
Torch.description: Uma tocha queima por 1 hora, emitindo luz plena em um raio de 6 metros e meia-luz por mais 6 metros. Ao executar a ação atacar, você pode atacar com a tocha, usando-a como uma arma de combate corpo a corpo simples. Em caso de acerto, o alvo sofre 1 ponto de dano ígneo.

Oil.name: Óleo
Oil.description:
You can douse a creature, object, or space with Oil or use it as fuel, as detailed below.

Dousing a Creature or an Object. When you take the Attack action, you can replace one of your attacks with throwing an Oil flask. Target one creature or object within 20 feet of yourself. The target must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw (DC 8 plus your Dexterity modifier and Proficiency Bonus) or be covered in oil. If the target takes Fire damage before the oil dries (after 1 minute), the target takes an extra [[/damage 5 type=fire]] damage from burning oil.

Dousing a Space. You can take the Utilize action to pour an Oil flask on level ground to cover a 5-foot-square area within 5 feet of yourself. If lit, the oil burns until the end of the turn 2 rounds from when the oil was lit (or 12 seconds) and deals 5 Fire damage to any creature that enters the area or ends its turn there. A creature can take this damage only once per turn.

Fuel. Oil serves as fuel for Lamps and Lanterns. Once lit, a flask of Oil burns for 6 hours in a Lamp or Lantern. That duration doesn't need to be consecutive; you can extinguish the burning Oil (as a Utilize action) and rekindle it again until it has burned for a total of 6 hours.

Rations.name: Rações
Rations.description: Rações consistem em alimentos prontos para viagem, incluindo carne seca, frutas secas, biscoito e nozes. Veja &Reference[Malnutrition] no glossário de regras em relação aos efeitos da falta de alimentação.

Deft Explorer.name: Explorador Hábil
Deft Explorer.description:
Thanks to your travels, you gain the following benefits.

Expertise. Choose one of your skill proficiencies with which you lack Expertise. You gain Expertise in that skill.

Languages. You know two languages of your choice from the language tables in chapter 2.

Nota do Foundry

You will be prompted for choices when you add the Ranger class to your character sheet.

Fighting Style.name: Estilo de Luta
Fighting Style.description:
You gain a @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.content24.JournalEntry.phbFeats00000000.JournalEntryPage.sbHImaCB8ZMEHYkb]{Fighting Style feat} of your choice. Em vez de escolher um desses talentos, você pode escolher a opção abaixo.

@Embed[Compendium.dnd5e.classes24.Item.phbfstDruidicWar caption=false]

Archery.name: Archery
Archery.description:
(pré-requisito: Característica Estílo de Luta)

You gain a +2 bonus to attack rolls you make with Ranged weapons.

Nota do Foundry

This feature includes an Active Effect which adds the bonus to Ranged weapon attack rolls.

Longstrider.name: Longstrider
Longstrider.description:
You touch a creature. The target's Speed increases by 10 feet until the spell ends.

Usando Espaços de Magia de Círculo Superior. Ao conjurar esta magia utilizando um espaço de magia de 2º círculo ou superior, você pode escolher uma criatura adicional como alvo para cada círculo do espaço acima do 1º.

Longstrider.name: Longstrider
Longstrider.description: The target’s Speed increases by 10 feet until the spell ends.

Hunter.name: Caçador
Hunter.description:
Proteja a natureza e os povos da destruição

Você persegue presas por todo lugar, usando suas habilidades como Caçador para proteger a natureza e os povos daqueles que buscam destruí-los.

Hunter's Lore.name: Sabedoria do Caçador
Hunter's Lore.description: Você pode invocar as forças da natureza para revelar pontos fortes e fracos de sua presa. Enquanto uma criatura estiver marcada por sua marca do predador, você sabe se essa criatura tem imunidades, resistências ou vulnerabilidades e, se a criatura as tiver, você sabe quais são.

Hunter's Prey.name: Presa do Caçador
Hunter's Prey.description:
Você ganha uma das características à sua escolha. Sempre que terminar um descanso curto ou longo, você poderá substituir a opção escolhida pela outra.

Assassino de Colossos. Sua tenacidade pode derrubar até mesmo os inimigos mais resiliemtes. Ao acertar uma criatura com uma arma, a arma causa 1d8 pontos de dano adicional caso os pontos de vida da criatura estejam abaixo do máximo de pontos de vida dela. Você pode causar esse dano adicional apenas uma vez por turno.

Destruidor de Hordas. Uma vez em cada um dos seus turnos quando você atacar com uma arma, você pode fazer outro ataque com a mesma arma contra uma criatura diferente que esteja a até 1,5 metro do alvo original, que esteja dentro da distância da arma e que você ainda não tenha atacado neste turno.

Nota do Foundry

Esta atividade inclui a atividade Assassino de Colossos para causar dano adicional. Você pode selecionar o tipo correto de dano na caixa de diálogo da jogada.

Para a opção Destruidor de Hordas, basta realizar outro ataque.

Colossus Slayer.name: Colossus Slayer
Colossus Slayer.condition: Ao acertar uma criatura com uma arma

Pass without Trace.name: Pass without Trace
Pass without Trace.description: You radiate a concealing aura in a 30-foot Emanation for the duration. While in the aura, you and each creature you choose have a +10 bonus to [[/check ability=dex skill=ste]] checks and leave no tracks.

Concealed.name: Concealed
Concealed.description: While in the aura, you and each creature you choose have a +10 bonus to [[/check ability=dex skill=ste]] checks and leave no tracks.

Extra Attack.name: Ataque Extra
Extra Attack.description: Você pode atacar duas vezes, em vez de uma, sempre que executar a ação atacar em seu turno.

Bracers of Archery.name: Bracers of Archery
Bracers of Archery.description:
Wondrous Item, Uncommon (Requires Attunement)

While wearing these bracers, you have proficiency with the Longbow and Shortbow, and you gain a +2 bonus to damage rolls made with such weapons.

Nota do Foundry

The Bonus Damage: Bows passive effect applies the damage bonus to all ranged weapon damage rolls and should be disabled before rolling damage for weapons other than a Longbow or Shortbow.

Bonus Damage: Bows.name: Bonus Damage: Bows
Bonus Damage: Bows.description: you gain a +2 bonus to damage rolls on ranged attacks made with a Longbow or Shortbow

Efficient Quiver.name: Efficient Quiver
Efficient Quiver.description:
Wondrous Item, Uncommon

Each of the quiver's three compartments connects to an extradimensional space that allows the quiver to hold numerous items while never weighing more than 2 pounds. The shortest compartment can hold up to 60 Arrows, Bolts, or similar objects. The midsize compartment holds up to 18 Javelins or similar objects. The longest compartment holds up to 6 long objects, such as bows, Quarterstaffs, or Spears.

You can draw any item the quiver contains as if doing so from a regular quiver or scabbard.

Long Compartment.name: Long Compartment
Long Compartment.description: The long compartment holds up to 6 long objects, such as bows, Quarterstaffs, or Spears.

Short Compartment.name: Short Compartment
Short Compartment.description: The short compartment can hold up to 60 Arrows, Bolts, or similar objects.

Midsize Compartment.name: Midsize Compartment
Midsize Compartment.description: The midsize compartment holds up to 18 Javelins or similar objects.

Aid.name: Aid
Aid.description:
Choose up to three creatures within range. Each target's Hit Point maximum and current Hit Points increase by 5 for the duration.

Usando Espaços de Magia de Círculo Superior. Each target's Hit Points increase by 5 for each spell slot level above 2.

Level 2: +5 Max HP.name: Level 2: +5 Max HP
Level 2: +5 Max HP.description: The target's Hit Point maximum is increased for the duration.

Level 3: +10 Max HP.name: Level 3: +10 Max HP
Level 3: +10 Max HP.description: The target's Hit Point maximum is increased for the duration.

Level 4: +15 Max HP.name: Level 4: +15 Max HP
Level 4: +15 Max HP.description: The target's Hit Point maximum is increased for the duration.

Level 5: +20 Max HP.name: Level 5: +20 Max HP
Level 5: +20 Max HP.description: The target's Hit Point maximum is increased for the duration.

Level 6: +25 Max HP.name: Level 6: +25 Max HP
Level 6: +25 Max HP.description: The target's Hit Point maximum is increased for the duration.

Level 7: +30 Max HP.name: Level 7: +30 Max HP
Level 7: +30 Max HP.description: The target's Hit Point maximum is increased for the duration.

Level 8: +35 Max HP.name: Level 8: +35 Max HP
Level 8: +35 Max HP.description: The target's Hit Point maximum is increased for the duration.

Level 9: +40 Max HP.name: Level 9: +40 Max HP
Level 9: +40 Max HP.description: The target's Hit Point maximum is increased for the duration.

Goodberry.name: Goodberry
Goodberry.description:
@UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbutlMagicalBer]{Ten berries} appear in your hand and are infused with magic for the duration. A creature can take a Bonus Action to eat one berry. Eating a berry restores 1 Hit Point, and the berry provides enough nourishment to sustain a creature for one day.

Uneaten berries disappear when the spell ends.

Magic Weapon.name: Magic Weapon
Magic Weapon.description:
You touch a nonmagical weapon. Until the spell ends, that weapon becomes a magic weapon with a +1 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls. The spell ends early if you cast it again.

Usando Espaços de Magia de Círculo Superior. The bonus increases to +2 with a level 3–5 spell slot. The bonus increases to +3 with a level 6+ spell slot.

Magic Weapon +1.name: Magic Weapon +1
Magic Weapon +1.description: Until the spell ends, that weapon becomes a magic weapon with a +1 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls.

Magic Weapon +2.name: Magic Weapon +2
Magic Weapon +2.description: Until the spell ends, that weapon becomes a magic weapon with a +2 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls.

Magic Weapon +3.name: Magic Weapon +3
Magic Weapon +3.description: Until the spell ends, that weapon becomes a magic weapon with a +3 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls.

Spike Growth.name: Spike Growth
Spike Growth.description:
The ground in a 20-foot-radius Sphere centered on a point within range sprouts hard spikes and thorns. The area becomes Difficult Terrain for the duration. When a creature moves into or within the area, it takes [[/damage 2d4 type=piercing]] damage for every 5 feet it travels.

The transformation of the ground is camouflaged to look natural. Any creature that can't see the area when the spell is cast must take a Search action and succeed on a [[/check ability=wis skill=prc dc=@attributes.spell.dc]] or [[/check ability=wis skill=sur dc=@attributes.spell.dc]] check against your spell save DC to recognize the terrain as hazardous before entering it.

Case, Map or Scroll.name: Case, Map or Scroll
Case, Map or Scroll.description: A Map or Scroll Case holds up to 10 sheets of paper or 5 sheets of parchment.

Potion of Healing.name: Potion of Healing
Potion of Healing.description: This potion is a magic item. As a Bonus Action, you can drink it or administer it to another creature within 5 feet of yourself. The creature that drinks the magical red fluid in this vial regains 2d4 + 2 Hit Points.

Favored Enemy.name: Inimigo Favorito
Favored Enemy.description:
You always have the @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplHuntersMar]{Marca do Predador} spell prepared. You can cast it twice without expending a spell slot, and you regain all expended uses of this ability when you finish a Long Rest.

The number of times you can cast the spell without a spell slot increases when you reach certain Ranger levels, as shown in the Favored Enemy column of the Ranger Features table.

Hunter's Mark.name: Hunter's Mark
Hunter's Mark.description:
You magically mark one creature you can see within range as your quarry. Until the spell ends, you deal an extra [[/damage]] damage to the target whenever you hit it with an attack roll. You also have Advantage on any [[/check ability=wis skill=prc]] or [[/check ability=wis skill=sur]] check you make to find it.

If the target drops to 0 Hit Points before this spell ends, you can take a Bonus Action to move the mark to a new creature you can see within range.

Usando Espaços de Magia de Círculo Superior. Your Concentration can last longer with a spell slot of level 3–4 (up to 8 hours) or 5+ (up to 24 hours).

Move Mark.name: Move Mark
Move Mark.condition: when the currently marked target drops to 0 Hit Points

Hunter's Mark.name: Hunter's Mark
Hunter's Mark.description: Until the spell ends, the caster deals an extra [[/damage 1d6 force]] damage to the target whenever they hit it with an attack roll.

PuyImwrTF6MASf5z.name: Hunter's Mark
PuyImwrTF6MASf5z.description:
You magically mark one creature you can see within range as your quarry. Until the spell ends, you deal an extra [[/damage]] damage to the target whenever you hit it with an attack roll. You also have Advantage on any [[/check ability=wis skill=prc]] or [[/check ability=wis skill=sur]] check you make to find it.

If the target drops to 0 Hit Points before this spell ends, you can take a Bonus Action to move the mark to a new creature you can see within range.

Usando Espaços de Magia de Círculo Superior. Your Concentration can last longer with a spell slot of level 3–4 (up to 8 hours) or 5+ (up to 24 hours).

Move Mark.name: Move Mark
Move Mark.condition: when the currently marked target drops to 0 Hit Points

Hunter's Mark.name: Hunter's Mark
Hunter's Mark.description: Until the spell ends, the caster deals an extra [[/damage 1d6 force]] damage to the target whenever they hit it with an attack roll.

Detect Poison and Disease.name: Detect Poison and Disease
Detect Poison and Disease.description:
For the duration, you sense the location of poisons, poisonous or venomous creatures, and magical contagions within 30 feet of yourself. You sense the kind of poison, creature, or contagion in each case.

The spell is blocked by 1 foot of stone, dirt, or wood; 1 inch of metal; or a thin sheet of lead.

QuillatheLv11000.name: Quillathe
QuillatheLv11000.description:
Quillathe cleanses monsters from her woods as a hobby, but now a new force menaces her land and she must band with adventurers to defeat it.

Token artwork by Forgotten Adventures.

Token artwork by Forgotten Adventures.

Monster Hunter.name: Monster Hunter
Monster Hunter.description:
Valores de Atributo: Constitution, Dexterity, Strength

Talento: Alert

Proficiências em Perícias: Investigation, Nature

Proficiência com Ferramentas: Herbalism Kit

Equipamento: Choose A or B: (A) @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbtulHerbalismK], @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagClothesTrav], @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagHuntingTrap], @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagNet00000000], [[/award 37gp]] ou (B) [[/award 50gp]]

Alert.name: Alerta
Alert.description:
Você ganha os seguintes benefícios.

Proficiência em Iniciativa. Ao rolar iniciativa, você pode adicionar seu bônus de proficiência ao resultado.

Troca de Iniciativa. Imediatamente após rolar iniciativa, você pode trocar sua iniciativa com a de um aliado disposto no mesmo combate. You can't make this swap if you or the ally has the &Reference[Incapacitated] condition.

Nota do Foundry

Essa característica adiciona automaticamente o bônus à sua Iniciativa.

Elf, Wood.name: Elf, Wood
Elf, Wood.description:
@Embed[Compendium.dnd5e.content24.JournalEntry.phbAppendixSpeci.JournalEntryPage.phbspElf00000000 inline classes="free-rules-embed"]

Wood Elves

@Embed[Compendium.dnd5e.content24.JournalEntry.phbAppendixSpeci.JournalEntryPage.phbspWoodElf0000 inline classes="free-rules-embed"]

Traços de Elfo

Tipo de Criatura: Humanoide

Tamanho: Médio (de 1,5 a 1,8 metro de altura).

Deslocamento: 9 metros

Como um elfo, você possui esses traços especiais.

Visão no Escuro. Você tem visão no escuro com distância de 18 metros.

Linhagem Élfica. Você faz parte de uma linhagem que lhe concede habilidades sobrenaturais.

Quando seu personagem atinge os níveis 3 e 5, você aprende uma magia de círculo mais alto, como indicado na tabela. Você sempre tem esta magia preparada. Você pode conjurá-la uma vez sem um espaço de magia, e recupera a habilidade de conjurá-la dessa forma ao final de um descanso longo. Você também pode conjurar a magia usando quaisquer espaços de magia do círculo apropriado que tiver. Inteligência, Sabedoria ou Carisma são seu atributo de conjuração para as magias que você conjura com este traço (escolha o atributo ao selecionar a linhagem).

Wood Elf Lineage Features
Nível 1Nível 3Nível 5
Your Speed increases to 35 feet. Você também conhece o truque @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplDruidcraft]{Druidcraft}.@UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplLongstride]{Longstrider}@UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplPasswithou]{Pass without Trace}

Ancestralidade Feérica. Você tem vantagem em salvaguardas para evitar ou encerrar a condição enfeitiçado.

Sentidos Aguçados. Você tem proficiência nas perícias Intuição, Percepção ou Sobrevivência.

Transe. Você não precisa dormir, e magia não pode fazer você dormir. Você pode concluir um descanso longo em 4 horas se passar essas horas meditando em transe, durante o qual você se mantém consciente.
