Ranger.name: Guardião
Ranger.description:
Core Ranger Traits

Atributo Primário

Dexterity and Wisdom

Dado de Vida

D10 per Ranger level

Proficiências em Salvaguardas

Strength and Dexterity

Proficiências em Perícias

Choose 3: Animal Handling, Athletics, Insight, Investigation, Nature, Perception, Stealth, or Survival

Proficiências com Armas

Armas simples e marciais

Treinamento com Armadura

Armaduras leves e médias, escudos

Equipamento Inicial

Choose A or B: (A) @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbarmStuddedLea]{Armadura de Couro Batido}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbwepScimitar00]{Cimitarra}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbwepShortsword]{Shortsword}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbwepLongbow000]{Arco Longo}, 20 @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbamoArrows0000]{Flechas}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagQuiver00000]{Aljava}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagDruidicFocu]{Druidic Focus} (@UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbdfcSprigofmis]{sprig of mistletoe}), @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagExplorersPa]{Explorer's Pack} e [[/award 7GP]]; ou (B) [[/award 150GP]]

@Embed[Compendium.dnd5e.content24.JournalEntry.phbAppendixClass.JournalEntryPage.phbrgrRanger0000 inline classes="free-rules-embed"]

Becoming a Ranger …

Como um Personagem de 1º Nível

  • Gain all the traits in the Core Ranger Traits table.
  • Gain the Ranger's level 1 features, which are listed in the Ranger Features table.

Como um Personagem Multiclasse

  • Gain the following traits from the Core Ranger Traits table: Hit Point Die, proficiency with Martial weapons, proficiency in one skill of your choice from the Ranger's skill list, and training with Light and Medium armor and Shields.
  • Gain the Ranger's level 1 features, which are listed in the Ranger Features table. Veja as regras de multiclasse no capítulo 2 para determinar seus espaços de magia disponíveis.

Druidcraft.name: Druidcraft
Druidcraft.description:
Whispering to the spirits of nature, you create one of the following effects within range.

Weather Sensor. You create a Tiny, harmless sensory effect that predicts what the weather will be at your location for the next 24 hours. The effect might manifest as a golden orb for clear skies, a cloud for rain, falling snowflakes for snow, and so on. This effect persists for 1 round.

Bloom. You instantly make a flower blossom, a seed pod open, or a leaf bud bloom.

Efeito Sensorial. You create a harmless sensory effect, such as falling leaves, spectral dancing fairies, a gentle breeze, the sound of an animal, or the faint odor of skunk. The effect must fit in a 5-foot Cube.

Brincar com Fogo. You light or snuff out a candle, a torch, or a campfire.

Spellcasting.name: Conjuração
Spellcasting.description:
As a student of arcane magic, you have learned to cast spells. See the @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.content24.JournalEntry.phbSpells0000000.JournalEntryPage.b2QVn25z2N1ykWpf]{rules on spellcasting}. The information below details how you use those rules with Wizard spells, which appear in the @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.content24.JournalEntry.phbSpells0000000.JournalEntryPage.6AnqLUowgdsqMFvz]{Lista de Magias do Mago}.

Cantrips. You know three Wizard cantrips of your choice. @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplLight00000]{Luz}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplMageHand00]{Mãos Mágicas}, and @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplRayofFrost]{Ray of Frost} are recommended. Whenever you finish a Long Rest, you can replace one of your cantrips from this feature with another Wizard cantrip of your choice.

When you reach Wizard levels 4 and 10, you learn another Wizard cantrip of your choice, as shown in the Cantrips column of the @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.content24.JournalEntry.phbWizard0000000.JournalEntryPage.g7cMRWzsgAsEF7zC#class-features]{Wizard Features table}.

Spellbook. Your wizardly apprenticeship culminated in the creation of a unique book: your spellbook. It is a Tiny object that weighs 3 pounds, contains 100 pages, and can be read only by you or someone casting @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplIdentify00]{Identify}. You determine the book's appearance and materials, such as a gilt-edged tome or a collection of vellum bound with twine.

The book contains the level 1+ spells you know. It starts with six level 1 Wizard spells of your choice. @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplDetectMagi]{Detectar Magia}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplFeatherFal]{Feather Fall}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplMageArmor0]{Mage Armor}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplMagicMissi]{Magic Missile}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplSleep00000]{Sleep}, and @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplThunderwav]{Thunderwave} are recommended.

Whenever you gain a Wizard level after 1, add two Wizard spells of your choice to your spellbook. Each of these spells must be of a level for which you have spell slots, as shown in the Wizard Features table. The spells are the culmination of arcane research you do regularly.

Espaços de Magia. The Wizard Features table shows how many spell slots you have to cast your level 1+ spells. You regain all expended slots when you finish a Long Rest.

Magias Preparadas de 1º Círculo ou Maior. Você prepara a lista de magias de 1° círculo ou maior disponíveis para conjuração com esta característica. To do so, choose four spells from your spellbook. The chosen spells must be of a level for which you have spell slots.

The number of spells on your list increases as you gain Wizard levels, as shown in the Prepared Spells column of the Wizard Features table. Whenever that number increases, choose additional Wizard spells until the number of spells on your list matches the number in the table. The chosen spells must be of a level for which you have spell slots. For example, if you're a level 3 Wizard, your list of prepared spells can include six spells of levels 1 and 2 in any combination, chosen from your spellbook.

If another Wizard feature gives you spells that you always have prepared, those spells don't count against the number of spells you can prepare with this feature, but those spells otherwise count as Wizard spells for you.

Mudando Suas Magias Preparadas. Whenever you finish a Long Rest, you can change your list of prepared spells, replacing any of the spells there with spells from your spellbook.

Spellcasting Ability. Intelligence is your spellcasting ability for your Wizard spells.

Foco de Conjuração. You can use an Arcane Focus or your spellbook as a Spellcasting Focus for your Wizard spells.

Weapon Mastery.name: Maestria com Armas
Weapon Mastery.description:
Seu treinamento com armas permite que você use as propriedades de maestria de dois tipos de armas, à sua escolha, com as quais tenha proficiência, como adagas e arcos curtos.

Sempre que você terminar um descanso longo, você poderá mudar os tipos de armas escolhidos. Por exemplo, você poderia passar a usar as propriedades de maestria de cimitarras e espadas curtas.

Cure Wounds.name: Curar Ferimentos
Cure Wounds.description:
Uma criatura tocada por você recupera um número de pontos de vida igual a 2d8 mais seu modificador de atributo de conjuração.

Usando Espaços de Magia de Círculo Superior. A cura aumenta em 2d8 para cada círculo de espaço de magia acima do 1°.

Ensnaring Strike.name: Ensnaring Strike
Ensnaring Strike.description:
As you hit the target, grasping vines appear on it, and it makes a Strength saving throw. A Large or larger creature has Advantage on this save. On a failed save, the target has the &Reference[restrained apply=false] condition until the spell ends. On a successful save, the vines shrivel away, and the spell ends.

While Restrained, the target takes 1d6 Piercing damage at the start of each of its turns. The target or a creature within reach of it can take an action to make a [[/check ability=str skill=ath dc=@attributes.spell.dc]] check against your spell save DC. On a success, the spell ends.

Usando Espaços de Magia de Círculo Superior. The damage increases by 1d6 for each spell slot level above 1.
Ensnaring Strike.condition: Immediately after hitting a creature with a weapon

Ensnared.name: Ensnared
Ensnared.description:
The target has the &Reference[restrained apply=false] condition until the spell ends.

While Restrained, the target takes [[/damage 1d6 type=piercing]] (plus 1d6 per spell slot level above 1) damage at the start of each of its turns. The target or a creature within reach of it can take an action to make a [[/check ability=str skill=ath]] check against your spell save DC. On a success, the spell ends.

Herbalism Kit.name: Herbalism Kit
Herbalism Kit.description:
Atributo: Intelligence

Usar: Identify a plant (DC 10)

Criação: @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagAntitoxin00]{Antitoxin}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagCandle00000]{Candle}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagHealersKit0]{Kit de Curandeiro}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagPotionofHea]{Potion of Healing}

Clothes, Traveler's.name: Traje de Viajante
Clothes, Traveler's.description: Traveler's Clothes are resilient garments designed for travel in various environments.

Net.name: Net
Net.description:
When you take the Attack action, you can replace one of your attacks with throwing a Net. Target a creature you can see within 15 feet of yourself. The target must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw (DC 8 plus your Dexterity modifier and Proficiency Bonus) or have the &Reference[Restrained] condition until it escapes. The target succeeds automatically if it is Huge or larger.

To escape, the target or a creature within 5 feet of it must take an action to make a [[/skill ath 10]] check, freeing the Restrained creature on a success. Destroying the Net (CA 10; 5 HP; Immunity to Bludgeoning, Poison, and Psychic damage) also frees the target, ending the effect.

Arrows.name: Flechas
Arrows.description:
Armazenamento: @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagQuiver00000]{Aljava}

Qualquer arma que possua a propriedade munição requer algum tipo de @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagAmmunitionV]{munição}. A descrição da arma especifica o tipo de munição usada por ela. A tabela Munição lista os diferentes tipos e a quantidade obtida ao comprá-las. A tabela também lista o item normalmente usado para armazenar cada tipo de munição, que é vendido separadamente.

Sprig of mistletoe.name: Sprig of mistletoe
Sprig of mistletoe.description: A @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagDruidicFocu]{Druidic Focus} takes one of the forms in the Druidic Focuses table and is carved, tied with ribbon, or painted to channel primal magic. A Druid or Ranger can use such an object as a Spellcasting Focus.

Explorer's Pack.name: Explorer's Pack
Explorer's Pack.description: An Explorer's Pack contains the following items: @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagBackpack000]{Mochila}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagBedroll0000]{Saco de Dormir}, 2 frascos de @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagOil00000000]{Óleo}, 10 dias de @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagRations0000]{Rações}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagRope0000000]{Corda}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagTinderbox00]{Caixa para Fogo}, 10 @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagTorch000000]{Tochas}, and @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagWaterskin00]{Cantil}.

Tinderbox.name: Caixa para Fogo
Tinderbox.description: A caixa para fogo é um pequeno recipiente contendo sílica, pederneira e uma acendalha (geralmente pano seco embebido em óleo) usada para atear fogo. Suas utilidades incluem, como uma ação bônus, acender vela, lamparina, lanterna ou tocha, bem como qualquer outro objeto com combustível exposto. Acender outros tipos de fogo leva 1 minuto.

Rope.name: Corda
Rope.description:
As a Utilize action, you can tie a knot with Rope if you succeed on a DC 10 Dexterity (Prestidigitação) check. The Rope can be burst with a successful DC 20 Strength (Athletics) check.

You can bind an unwilling creature with the Rope only if the creature has the &Reference[Grappled], &Reference[Incapacitated], or &Reference[Restrained] condition. If the creature's legs are bound, the creature has the Restrained condition until it escapes. Escaping the Rope requires the creature to make a successful DC 15 Dexterity (Acrobatics) check as an action.

Bedroll.name: Saco de Dormir
Bedroll.description: A Bedroll sleeps one Small or Medium creature. While in a Bedroll, you automatically succeed on saving throws against extreme cold (see @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.content24.JournalEntry.dmgDmsToolbox000]{Gameplay Toolbox}).

Waterskin.name: Cantil
Waterskin.description: A Waterskin holds up to 4 pints. If you don't drink sufficient water, you risk &Reference[dehydration].

Water (Pint).name: Água (Quartilho)
Water (Pint).description: If you don't drink sufficient water, you risk &Reference[dehydration].

Torch.name: Tocha
Torch.description: Uma tocha queima por 1 hora, emitindo luz plena em um raio de 6 metros e meia-luz por mais 6 metros. Ao executar a ação atacar, você pode atacar com a tocha, usando-a como uma arma de combate corpo a corpo simples. Em caso de acerto, o alvo sofre 1 ponto de dano ígneo.

Oil.name: Óleo
Oil.description:
You can douse a creature, object, or space with Oil or use it as fuel, as detailed below.

Dousing a Creature or an Object. When you take the Attack action, you can replace one of your attacks with throwing an Oil flask. Target one creature or object within 20 feet of yourself. The target must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw (DC 8 plus your Dexterity modifier and Proficiency Bonus) or be covered in oil. If the target takes Fire damage before the oil dries (after 1 minute), the target takes an extra [[/damage 5 type=fire]] damage from burning oil.

Dousing a Space. You can take the Utilize action to pour an Oil flask on level ground to cover a 5-foot-square area within 5 feet of yourself. If lit, the oil burns until the end of the turn 2 rounds from when the oil was lit (or 12 seconds) and deals 5 Fire damage to any creature that enters the area or ends its turn there. A creature can take this damage only once per turn.

Fuel. Oil serves as fuel for Lamps and Lanterns. Once lit, a flask of Oil burns for 6 hours in a Lamp or Lantern. That duration doesn't need to be consecutive; you can extinguish the burning Oil (as a Utilize action) and rekindle it again until it has burned for a total of 6 hours.

Rations.name: Rações
Rations.description: Rações consistem em alimentos prontos para viagem, incluindo carne seca, frutas secas, biscoito e nozes. Veja &Reference[Malnutrition] no glossário de regras em relação aos efeitos da falta de alimentação.

Deft Explorer.name: Explorador Hábil
Deft Explorer.description:
Thanks to your travels, you gain the following benefits.

Expertise. Choose one of your skill proficiencies with which you lack Expertise. You gain Expertise in that skill.

Languages. You know two languages of your choice from the language tables in chapter 2.

Nota do Foundry

You will be prompted for choices when you add the Ranger class to your character sheet.

Fighting Style.name: Estilo de Luta
Fighting Style.description:
You gain a @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.content24.JournalEntry.phbFeats00000000.JournalEntryPage.sbHImaCB8ZMEHYkb]{Fighting Style feat} of your choice. Em vez de escolher um desses talentos, você pode escolher a opção abaixo.

@Embed[Compendium.dnd5e.classes24.Item.phbfstDruidicWar caption=false]

Archery.name: Archery
Archery.description:
(pré-requisito: Característica Estílo de Luta)

You gain a +2 bonus to attack rolls you make with Ranged weapons.

Nota do Foundry

This feature includes an Active Effect which adds the bonus to Ranged weapon attack rolls.

Longstrider.name: Longstrider
Longstrider.description:
You touch a creature. The target's Speed increases by 10 feet until the spell ends.

Usando Espaços de Magia de Círculo Superior. Ao conjurar esta magia utilizando um espaço de magia de 2º círculo ou superior, você pode escolher uma criatura adicional como alvo para cada círculo do espaço acima do 1º.

Longstrider.name: Longstrider
Longstrider.description: The target’s Speed increases by 10 feet until the spell ends.

Hunter.name: Caçador
Hunter.description:
Proteja a natureza e os povos da destruição

Você persegue presas por todo lugar, usando suas habilidades como Caçador para proteger a natureza e os povos daqueles que buscam destruí-los.

Hunter's Lore.name: Sabedoria do Caçador
Hunter's Lore.description: Você pode invocar as forças da natureza para revelar pontos fortes e fracos de sua presa. Enquanto uma criatura estiver marcada por sua marca do predador, você sabe se essa criatura tem imunidades, resistências ou vulnerabilidades e, se a criatura as tiver, você sabe quais são.

Hunter's Prey.name: Presa do Caçador
Hunter's Prey.description:
Você ganha uma das características à sua escolha. Sempre que terminar um descanso curto ou longo, você poderá substituir a opção escolhida pela outra.

Assassino de Colossos. Sua tenacidade pode derrubar até mesmo os inimigos mais resiliemtes. Ao acertar uma criatura com uma arma, a arma causa 1d8 pontos de dano adicional caso os pontos de vida da criatura estejam abaixo do máximo de pontos de vida dela. Você pode causar esse dano adicional apenas uma vez por turno.

Destruidor de Hordas. Uma vez em cada um dos seus turnos quando você atacar com uma arma, você pode fazer outro ataque com a mesma arma contra uma criatura diferente que esteja a até 1,5 metro do alvo original, que esteja dentro da distância da arma e que você ainda não tenha atacado neste turno.

Nota do Foundry

Esta atividade inclui a atividade Assassino de Colossos para causar dano adicional. Você pode selecionar o tipo correto de dano na caixa de diálogo da jogada.

Para a opção Destruidor de Hordas, basta realizar outro ataque.

Colossus Slayer.name: Colossus Slayer
Colossus Slayer.condition: Ao acertar uma criatura com uma arma

Pass without Trace.name: Pass without Trace
Pass without Trace.description: You radiate a concealing aura in a 30-foot Emanation for the duration. While in the aura, you and each creature you choose have a +10 bonus to [[/check ability=dex skill=ste]] checks and leave no tracks.

Concealed.name: Concealed
Concealed.description: While in the aura, you and each creature you choose have a +10 bonus to [[/check ability=dex skill=ste]] checks and leave no tracks.

Extra Attack.name: Ataque Extra
Extra Attack.description: Você pode atacar duas vezes, em vez de uma, sempre que executar a ação atacar em seu turno.

Bracers of Archery.name: Bracers of Archery
Bracers of Archery.description:
Wondrous Item, Uncommon (Requires Attunement)

While wearing these bracers, you have proficiency with the Longbow and Shortbow, and you gain a +2 bonus to damage rolls made with such weapons.

Nota do Foundry

The Bonus Damage: Bows passive effect applies the damage bonus to all ranged weapon damage rolls and should be disabled before rolling damage for weapons other than a Longbow or Shortbow.

Bonus Damage: Bows.name: Bonus Damage: Bows
Bonus Damage: Bows.description: you gain a +2 bonus to damage rolls on ranged attacks made with a Longbow or Shortbow

Efficient Quiver.name: Efficient Quiver
Efficient Quiver.description:
Wondrous Item, Uncommon

Each of the quiver's three compartments connects to an extradimensional space that allows the quiver to hold numerous items while never weighing more than 2 pounds. The shortest compartment can hold up to 60 Arrows, Bolts, or similar objects. The midsize compartment holds up to 18 Javelins or similar objects. The longest compartment holds up to 6 long objects, such as bows, Quarterstaffs, or Spears.

You can draw any item the quiver contains as if doing so from a regular quiver or scabbard.

Long Compartment.name: Long Compartment
Long Compartment.description: The long compartment holds up to 6 long objects, such as bows, Quarterstaffs, or Spears.

Short Compartment.name: Short Compartment
Short Compartment.description: The short compartment can hold up to 60 Arrows, Bolts, or similar objects.

Midsize Compartment.name: Midsize Compartment
Midsize Compartment.description: The midsize compartment holds up to 18 Javelins or similar objects.

Aid.name: Aid
Aid.description:
Choose up to three creatures within range. Each target's Hit Point maximum and current Hit Points increase by 5 for the duration.

Usando Espaços de Magia de Círculo Superior. Each target's Hit Points increase by 5 for each spell slot level above 2.

Level 2: +5 Max HP.name: Level 2: +5 Max HP
Level 2: +5 Max HP.description: The target's Hit Point maximum is increased for the duration.

Level 3: +10 Max HP.name: Level 3: +10 Max HP
Level 3: +10 Max HP.description: The target's Hit Point maximum is increased for the duration.

Level 4: +15 Max HP.name: Level 4: +15 Max HP
Level 4: +15 Max HP.description: The target's Hit Point maximum is increased for the duration.

Level 5: +20 Max HP.name: Level 5: +20 Max HP
Level 5: +20 Max HP.description: The target's Hit Point maximum is increased for the duration.

Level 6: +25 Max HP.name: Level 6: +25 Max HP
Level 6: +25 Max HP.description: The target's Hit Point maximum is increased for the duration.

Level 7: +30 Max HP.name: Level 7: +30 Max HP
Level 7: +30 Max HP.description: The target's Hit Point maximum is increased for the duration.

Level 8: +35 Max HP.name: Level 8: +35 Max HP
Level 8: +35 Max HP.description: The target's Hit Point maximum is increased for the duration.

Level 9: +40 Max HP.name: Level 9: +40 Max HP
Level 9: +40 Max HP.description: The target's Hit Point maximum is increased for the duration.

Goodberry.name: Goodberry
Goodberry.description:
@UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbutlMagicalBer]{Ten berries} appear in your hand and are infused with magic for the duration. A creature can take a Bonus Action to eat one berry. Eating a berry restores 1 Hit Point, and the berry provides enough nourishment to sustain a creature for one day.

Uneaten berries disappear when the spell ends.

Magic Weapon.name: Magic Weapon
Magic Weapon.description:
You touch a nonmagical weapon. Until the spell ends, that weapon becomes a magic weapon with a +1 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls. The spell ends early if you cast it again.

Usando Espaços de Magia de Círculo Superior. The bonus increases to +2 with a level 3–5 spell slot. The bonus increases to +3 with a level 6+ spell slot.

Magic Weapon +1.name: Magic Weapon +1
Magic Weapon +1.description: Until the spell ends, that weapon becomes a magic weapon with a +1 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls.

Magic Weapon +2.name: Magic Weapon +2
Magic Weapon +2.description: Until the spell ends, that weapon becomes a magic weapon with a +2 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls.

Magic Weapon +3.name: Magic Weapon +3
Magic Weapon +3.description: Until the spell ends, that weapon becomes a magic weapon with a +3 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls.

Spike Growth.name: Spike Growth
Spike Growth.description:
The ground in a 20-foot-radius Sphere centered on a point within range sprouts hard spikes and thorns. The area becomes Difficult Terrain for the duration. When a creature moves into or within the area, it takes [[/damage 2d4 type=piercing]] damage for every 5 feet it travels.

The transformation of the ground is camouflaged to look natural. Any creature that can't see the area when the spell is cast must take a Search action and succeed on a [[/check ability=wis skill=prc dc=@attributes.spell.dc]] or [[/check ability=wis skill=sur dc=@attributes.spell.dc]] check against your spell save DC to recognize the terrain as hazardous before entering it.

Case, Map or Scroll.name: Case, Map or Scroll
Case, Map or Scroll.description: A Map or Scroll Case holds up to 10 sheets of paper or 5 sheets of parchment.

Detect Poison and Disease.name: Detect Poison and Disease
Detect Poison and Disease.description:
For the duration, you sense the location of poisons, poisonous or venomous creatures, and magical contagions within 30 feet of yourself. You sense the kind of poison, creature, or contagion in each case.

The spell is blocked by 1 foot of stone, dirt, or wood; 1 inch of metal; or a thin sheet of lead.

Potion of Healing.name: Potion of Healing
Potion of Healing.description: This potion is a magic item. As a Bonus Action, you can drink it or administer it to another creature within 5 feet of yourself. The creature that drinks the magical red fluid in this vial regains 2d4 + 2 Hit Points.

Roving.name: Errante
Roving.description: Seu deslocamento aumenta em 3 metros enquanto você não estiver usando armadura pesada. Você também tem deslocamento de escalada e de deslocamento de natação igual ao seu deslocamento normal.

Defensive Tactics.name: Táticas Defensivas
Defensive Tactics.description:
Você ganha uma das características à sua escolha. Sempre que terminar um descanso curto ou longo, você poderá substituir a opção escolhida pela outra.

Escapar de Hordas. Ataques de oportunidade contra você têm desvantagem.

Defesa Contra Ataques Múltiplos. Quando uma criatura atinge você com uma jogada de ataque, essa criatura tem desvantagem em todas as outras jogadas de ataque contra você neste turno.

Nota do Foundry

Essa característica inclui a atividade Defesa Contra Ataques Múltiplos com um Efeito Ativo que pode ser usado para rastrear uma criatura que tem Desvantagem contra você, mas ele não automatiza o efeito.

Multiattack Defense.name: Defesa Contra Ataques Múltiplos
Multiattack Defense.condition: Quando uma criatura te acerta em uma jogada de ataque

Expertise.name: Especialista
Expertise.description:
Escolha duas perícias em que seja proficiente, mas não seja especialista. Você passa a ser especialista nessas perícias.

Nota do Foundry

Você será chamado a fazer a escolha quando alcançar este nível.

Tireless.name: Incansável
Tireless.description:
As forças primordiais ajudam a fortalecê-lo em suas jornadas, concedendo-lhe os seguintes benefícios.

Pontos de Vida Temporários. Como uma ação mágica, você pode conceder a si mesmo um número de pontos de vida temporários igual a 1d8 + seu modificador de Sabedoria (mínimo de 1). Você pode usar esta ação uma quantidade de vezes igual ao seu modificador de Sabedoria (mínimo de 1) e recupera todos os usos ao final de um descanso longo.

Diminuir Exaustão. Sempre que terminar um descanso curto seu nível de exaustão, se houver, é reduzido em 1.

Nota do Foundry

A atividade Pontos de Vida Temporários pode aplicar os Pontos de Vida Temporários a você.

A atividade Reduzir Exaustão diminuirá sua Exaustão.

Decrease Exhaustion.name: Diminuir Exaustão
Decrease Exhaustion.condition: Sempre que terminar um descanso curto

Superior Hunter's Prey.name: Presa do Caçador Superior
Superior Hunter's Prey.description:
Uma vez por turno, ao causar dano a uma criatura marcada por sua marca do predador, você também pode causar o dano adicional daquela magia a uma criatura diferente que você possa ver e que esteja a até 9 metros da primeira criatura.

Nota do Foundry

Você pode aplicar o dano da marca do predador ou usar a atividade Dano nesta característica.

Conjure Animals.name: Conjure Animals
Conjure Animals.description:
You conjure nature spirits that appear as a Large pack of spectral, intangible animals in an unoccupied space you can see within range. The pack lasts for the duration, and you choose the spirits' animal form, such as wolves, serpents, or birds.

You have Advantage on Strength saving throws while you're within 5 feet of the pack, and when you move on your turn, you can also move the pack up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see.

Whenever the pack moves within 10 feet of a creature you can see and whenever a creature you can see enters a space within 10 feet of the pack or ends its turn there, you can force that creature to make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 3d10 Slashing damage. A creature makes this save only once per turn.

Usando Espaços de Magia de Círculo Superior. The damage increases by 1d10 for each spell slot level above 3.

Revivify.name: Revivify
Revivify.description: You touch a creature that has died within the last minute. That creature revives with 1 Hit Point. This spell can't revive a creature that has died of old age, nor does it restore any missing body parts.
Revivify.materials: a diamond worth 300+ GP, which the spell consumes

Jump.name: Salto
Jump.description:
You touch a willing creature. Uma vez a cada um de seus turnos até a magia terminar, essa criatura pode saltar até 9 metros gastando 3 metros de movimento.

Usando Espaços de Magia de Círculo Superior.Ao conjurar esta magia utilizando um espaço de magia de 2º círculo ou superior, você pode escolher uma criatura adicional como alvo para cada círculo do espaço acima do 1º.

Jump.name: Salto
Jump.description: Uma vez a cada um de seus turnos até a magia terminar, essa criatura pode saltar até 9 metros gastando 3 metros de movimento.

Plant Growth.name: Plant Growth
Plant Growth.description:
Casting Time: Action (Overgrowth) or 8 hours (Enrichment)

This spell channels vitality into plants. The casting time you use determines whether the spell has the Overgrowth or the Enrichment effect below.

Overgrowth. Choose a point within range. All normal plants in a 100-foot-radius Sphere centered on that point become thick and overgrown. A creature moving through that area must spend 4 feet of movement for every 1 foot it moves. You can exclude one or more areas of any size within the spell's area from being affected.

Enrichment. All plants in a half-mile radius centered on a point within range become enriched for 365 days. The plants yield twice the normal amount of food when harvested. They can benefit from only one Plant Growth per year.

Cloak of Protection.name: Cloak of Protection
Cloak of Protection.description:
Wondrous Item, Uncommon (Requires Attunement)

You gain a +1 bonus to Armor Class and saving throws while you wear this cloak.

Daylight.name: Daylight
Daylight.description:
For the duration, sunlight spreads from a point within range and fills a 60-foot-radius Sphere. The sunlight's area is Bright Light and sheds Dim Light for an additional 60 feet.

Alternatively, you cast the spell on an object that isn't being worn or carried, causing the sunlight to fill a 60-foot Emanation originating from that object. Covering that object with something opaque, such as a bowl or helm, blocks the sunlight.

If any of this spell's area overlaps with an area of Darkness created by a spell of level 3 or lower, that other spell is dispelled.

Silence.name: Silence
Silence.description: For the duration, no sound can be created within or pass through a 20-foot-radius Sphere centered on a point you choose within range. Any creature or object entirely inside the Sphere has Immunity to Thunder damage, and creatures have the &Reference[deafened apply=false] condition while entirely inside it. Casting a spell that includes a Verbal component is impossible there.

Silenced.name: Silenced
Silenced.description: Any creature or object entirely inside the Sphere has Immunity to Thunder damage, and creatures have the Deafened condition while entirely inside it. Casting a spell that includes a Verbal component is impossible there.

Potion of Growth.name: Potion of Growth
Potion of Growth.description:
Potion, Uncommon

When you drink this potion, you gain the "enlarge" effect of the @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplEnlargeRed]{Enlarge/Reduce} spell for 10 minutes (no Concentration required).

The red in the potion's liquid continuously expands from a tiny bead to color the clear liquid around it and then contracts. Shaking the bottle fails to interrupt this process.

Potion of Resistance.name: Potion of Resistance
Potion of Resistance.description:
Potion, Uncommon

When you drink this potion, you have Resistance to one type of damage for 1 hour. The GM chooses the type or determines it randomly by rolling on the following table.

@Embed[Compendium.dnd5e.tables24.RollTable.dmgPotionOfResis caption=false rollable]

Nota do Foundry

This item includes Active Effects for each type of resistance. Use the AE for the type of damage chosen by your DM.

Relentless Hunter.name: Caçador Implacável
Relentless Hunter.description: Sofrer dano não quebra sua concentração na marca do predador.

Nature's Veil.name: Véu da Natureza
Nature's Veil.description:
Você invoca espíritos da natureza para esconder-se magicamente. Como uma ação bônus, você pode conceder a si mesmo a condição invisível até o fim do seu próximo turno.

Você pode usar esta característica uma quantidade de vezes igual ao seu modificador de Sabedoria (mínimo de 1) e recupera todos os usos ao final de um descanso longo.

Nota do Foundry

Esta característica inclui um Efeito Ativo que aplica a condição invisível.

Superior Hunter's Defense.name: Defesa do Caçador Superior
Superior Hunter's Defense.description:
Ao sofrer dano, você pode usar uma reação para ganhar resistência àquele dano e a qualquer outro dano do mesmo tipo até o fim do turno atual.

Nota do Foundry

Esse recurso inclui um Efeito Ativo para resistir a cada tipo de dano, que pode ser aplicado para obter a resistência correspondente. Certifique-se de desativar/excluir o Efeito Ativo anterior na aba Efeitos da sua ficha ao alterar as Resistências.

Precise Hunter.name: Caçador Preciso
Precise Hunter.description: Você tem vantagem nas jogadas de ataque contra a criatura atualmente marcada por sua marca do predador.

Conjure Woodland Beings.name: Conjure Woodland Beings
Conjure Woodland Beings.description:
You conjure nature spirits that flit around you in a 10-foot Emanation for the duration. Whenever the Emanation enters the space of a creature you can see and whenever a creature you can see enters the Emanation or ends its turn there, you can force that creature to make a Wisdom saving throw. The creature takes 5d8 Force damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature makes this save only once per turn.

In addition, you can take the &Reference[Disengage] action as a Bonus Action for the spell's duration.

Usando Espaços de Magia de Círculo Superior. The damage increases by 1d8 for each spell slot level above 4.

Freedom of Movement.name: Freedom of Movement
Freedom of Movement.description:
You touch a willing creature. For the duration, the target's movement is unaffected by &Reference[DifficultTerrain], and spells and other magical effects can neither reduce the target's Speed nor cause the target to have the &Reference[Paralyzed apply=false] or &Reference[Restrained apply=false] conditions. The target also has a Swim Speed equal to its Speed.

In addition, the target can spend 5 feet of movement to automatically escape from nonmagical restraints, such as manacles or a creature imposing the &Reference[Grappled apply=false] condition on it.

Usando Espaços de Magia de Círculo Superior. You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 4.

Commune with Nature.name: Commune with Nature
Commune with Nature.description:
You commune with nature spirits and gain knowledge of the surrounding area. In the outdoors, the spell gives you knowledge of the area within 3 miles of you. In caves and other natural underground settings, the radius is limited to 300 feet. The spell doesn't function where nature has been replaced by construction, such as in castles and settlements.

Choose three of the following facts; you learn those facts as they pertain to the spell's area:

  • Locations of settlements
  • Locations of portals to other planes of existence
  • Location of one Challenge Rating 10+ creature (DM's choice) that is a Celestial, an Elemental, a Fey, a Fiend, or an Undead
  • The most prevalent kind of plant, mineral, or Beast (you choose which to learn)
  • Locations of bodies of water

For example, you could determine the location of a powerful monster in the area, the locations of bodies of water, and the locations of any towns.

Greater Restoration.name: Greater Restoration
Greater Restoration.description:
You touch a creature and magically remove one of the following effects from it:

  • 1 &Reference[Exhaustion] level
  • The &Reference[Charmed] or &Reference[Petrified] condition
  • A curse, including the target's Attunement to a cursed magic item
  • Any reduction to one of the target's ability scores
  • Any reduction to the target's Hit Point maximum
Greater Restoration.materials: diamond dust worth 100+ GP, which the spell consumes

Scimitar of Speed.name: Scimitar of Speed
Scimitar of Speed.description:
Weapon (@UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbwepScimitar00]{Cimitarra}), Very Rare (Requires Attunement)

You gain a +2 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. In addition, you can make one attack with it as a Bonus Action on each of your turns.

changes.name: Ring of Resistance (jet)
changes.system.description.value:
{}

See: @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.dmgRingOfResista]

You have Resistance to one damage type while wearing this ring. The gemstone in the ring indicates the type.

Brazier of Commanding Fire Elementals.name: Brazier of Commanding Fire Elementals
Brazier of Commanding Fire Elementals.description:
Wondrous Item, Rare

While you are within 5 feet of this brazier, you can take a Magic action to summon a @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.actors24.Actor.mmFireElemental0]{Fire Elemental}. The elemental appears in an unoccupied space as close to the brazier as possible, understands your languages, obeys your commands, and takes its turn immediately after you on your Initiative count. The elemental disappears after 1 hour, when it dies, or when you dismiss it as a Bonus Action. The brazier can't be used this way again until the next dawn.

summon.target: unoccupied space as close to the brazier as possible

Bag of Holding.name: Bag of Holding
Bag of Holding.description:
This bag has an interior space considerably larger than its outside dimensions—roughly 2 feet square and 4 feet deep on the inside. The bag can hold up to 500 pounds, not exceeding a volume of 64 cubic feet. The bag weighs 5 pounds, regardless of its contents. Retrieving an item from the bag requires a Utilize action.

If the bag is overloaded, pierced, or torn, it is destroyed, and its contents are scattered in the Astral Plane. If the bag is turned inside out, its contents spill forth unharmed, but the bag must be put right before it can be used again. The bag holds enough air for 10 minutes of breathing, divided by the number of breathing creatures inside.

Placing a Bag of Holding inside an extradimensional space created by a @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.dmgHewardsHandyH]{Handy Haversack}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.dmgPortableHole0]{Portable Hole}, or similar item instantly destroys both items and opens a gate to the Astral Plane. The gate originates where the one item was placed inside the other. Any creature within a 10-foot-radius Sphere centered on the gate is sucked through it to a random location on the Astral Plane. The gate then closes. The gate is one-way and can't be reopened.

gFkeCeFDSffdlH3p.name: Flechas
gFkeCeFDSffdlH3p.description:
Armazenamento: @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagQuiver00000]{Aljava}

Qualquer arma que possua a propriedade munição requer algum tipo de @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagAmmunitionV]{munição}. A descrição da arma especifica o tipo de munição usada por ela. A tabela Munição lista os diferentes tipos e a quantidade obtida ao comprá-las. A tabela também lista o item normalmente usado para armazenar cada tipo de munição, que é vendido separadamente.

Potion of Heroism.name: Potion of Heroism
Potion of Heroism.description:
Potion, Rare

When you drink this potion, you gain 10 Temporary Hit Points that last for 1 hour. For the same duration, you are under the effect of the @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplBless00000]{Benção} spell (no Concentration required).

This potion's blue liquid bubbles and steams as if boiling.

Blessed.name: Abençoado
Blessed.description: Whenever a target makes an attack roll or a saving throw before the effect ends, the target adds 1d4 to the attack roll or save.

Potion of Water Breathing.name: Potion of Water Breathing
Potion of Water Breathing.description:
Potion, Uncommon

You can breathe underwater for 24 hours after drinking this potion.

This potion's cloudy green fluid smells of the sea and has a jellyfish-like bubble floating in it.

Nota do Foundry

The Water Breather Active Effect can be used for tracking.

Favored Enemy.name: Inimigo Favorito
Favored Enemy.description:
You always have the @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplHuntersMar]{Marca do Predador} spell prepared. You can cast it twice without expending a spell slot, and you regain all expended uses of this ability when you finish a Long Rest.

The number of times you can cast the spell without a spell slot increases when you reach certain Ranger levels, as shown in the Favored Enemy column of the Ranger Features table.

Hunter's Mark.name: Hunter's Mark
Hunter's Mark.description:
You magically mark one creature you can see within range as your quarry. Until the spell ends, you deal an extra [[/damage]] damage to the target whenever you hit it with an attack roll. You also have Advantage on any [[/check ability=wis skill=prc]] or [[/check ability=wis skill=sur]] check you make to find it.

If the target drops to 0 Hit Points before this spell ends, you can take a Bonus Action to move the mark to a new creature you can see within range.

Usando Espaços de Magia de Círculo Superior. Your Concentration can last longer with a spell slot of level 3–4 (up to 8 hours) or 5+ (up to 24 hours).

Move Mark.name: Move Mark
Move Mark.condition: when the currently marked target drops to 0 Hit Points

Hunter's Mark.description: Until the spell ends, the caster deals an extra [[/damage 1d6 force]] damage to the target whenever they hit it with an attack roll.

Tornando-se um guerreiro…

Como um Personagem de 1º Nível

  • Ganhe todos os traços da tabela Traços Principais do Guerreiro.
  • Ganhe as características de 1º nível de guerreiro, que estão listadas na Tabela Características de Guerreiro.

Como um Personagem Multiclasse

  • Ganhe as seguintes características da tabela Traços Principais do Guerreiro: Dado de vida, proficiência com armas marciais e treinamento com armaduras leves, médias e escudos.
  • Ganhe as características de 1º nível de guerreiro, que estão listadas na Tabela Características de Guerreiro.

Fighting Style.name: Estilo de Luta
Fighting Style.description:
You gain a @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.content24.JournalEntry.phbFeats00000000.JournalEntryPage.sbHImaCB8ZMEHYkb]{Fighting Style feat} of your choice. Em vez de escolher um desses talentos, você pode escolher a opção abaixo.

@Embed[Compendium.dnd5e.classes24.Item.phbfstDruidicWar caption=false]

Second Wind.name: Recuperar Fôlego
Second Wind.description:
You have a limited well of physical and mental stamina that you can draw on. As a Bonus Action, you can use it to regain Hit Points equal to 1d10 plus your Fighter level.

You can use this feature twice. You regain one expended use when you finish a Short Rest, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest.

When you reach certain Fighter levels, you gain more uses of this feature, as shown in the Second Wind column of the @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.content24.JournalEntry.phbFighter000000.JournalEntryPage.wDELe3k25FQvYdrq#class-features]{Fighter Features} table.

Nota do Foundry

This feature automatically scales in usage and recovers the correct number of uses on a Short and Long Rest.

Weapon Mastery.name: Maestria com Armas
Weapon Mastery.description:
Seu treinamento com armas permite que você use as propriedades de maestria de dois tipos de armas, à sua escolha, com as quais tenha proficiência, como adagas e arcos curtos.

Sempre que você terminar um descanso longo, você poderá mudar os tipos de armas escolhidos. Por exemplo, você poderia passar a usar as propriedades de maestria de cimitarras e espadas curtas.

Defense.name: Defense
Defense.description:
(pré-requisito: Característica Estílo de Luta)

While you're wearing Light, Medium, or Heavy armor, you gain a +1 bonus to Armor Class.

Nota do Foundry

This feature includes an Active Effect which provides the Armor Class bonus. Disable it when you are not wearing armor.

Arrows.name: Flechas
Arrows.description:
Armazenamento: @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagQuiver00000]{Aljava}

Qualquer arma que possua a propriedade munição requer algum tipo de @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagAmmunitionV]{munição}. A descrição da arma especifica o tipo de munição usada por ela. A tabela Munição lista os diferentes tipos e a quantidade obtida ao comprá-las. A tabela também lista o item normalmente usado para armazenar cada tipo de munição, que é vendido separadamente.

Dice.name: Dados
Dice.description:
Atributo: Sabedoria

Usar: Discernir se alguém está trapaceando (CD 10) ou ganhar o jogo (CD 20).

Healer's Kit.name: Healer's Kit
Healer's Kit.description: A Healer's Kit has ten uses. As a Utilize action, you can expend one of its uses to stabilize an Unconscious creature that has 0 Hit Points without needing to make a Wisdom (Medicine) check.

Dungeoneer's Pack.name: Kit de Aventureiro
Dungeoneer's Pack.description: Um kit de aventureiro contém os seguintes itens: @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagBackpack000]{Mochila}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagCaltrops000]{Estrepes}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagCrowbar0000]{Pé de Cabra}, 2 frascos de @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagOil00000000]{Óleo}, 10 dias de @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagRations0000]{Rações}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagRope0000000]{Corda}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagTinderbox00]{Caixa para Fogo}, 10 @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagTorch000000]{Tochas}, and @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagWaterskin00]{Cantil}.

Waterskin.name: Cantil
Waterskin.description: A Waterskin holds up to 4 pints. If you don't drink sufficient water, you risk &Reference[dehydration].

Water (Pint).name: Água (Quartilho)
Water (Pint).description: If you don't drink sufficient water, you risk &Reference[dehydration].

Tinderbox.name: Caixa para Fogo
Tinderbox.description: A caixa para fogo é um pequeno recipiente contendo sílica, pederneira e uma acendalha (geralmente pano seco embebido em óleo) usada para atear fogo. Suas utilidades incluem, como uma ação bônus, acender vela, lamparina, lanterna ou tocha, bem como qualquer outro objeto com combustível exposto. Acender outros tipos de fogo leva 1 minuto.

Rope.name: Corda
Rope.description:
As a Utilize action, you can tie a knot with Rope if you succeed on a DC 10 Dexterity (Prestidigitação) check. The Rope can be burst with a successful DC 20 Strength (Athletics) check.

You can bind an unwilling creature with the Rope only if the creature has the &Reference[Grappled], &Reference[Incapacitated], or &Reference[Restrained] condition. If the creature's legs are bound, the creature has the Restrained condition until it escapes. Escaping the Rope requires the creature to make a successful DC 15 Dexterity (Acrobatics) check as an action.

Crowbar.name: Pé de Cabra
Crowbar.description: Using a Crowbar gives you Advantage on Strength checks where the Crowbar's leverage can be applied.

Rations.name: Rações
Rations.description: Rações consistem em alimentos prontos para viagem, incluindo carne seca, frutas secas, biscoito e nozes. Veja &Reference[Malnutrition] no glossário de regras em relação aos efeitos da falta de alimentação.

Torch.name: Tocha
Torch.description: Uma tocha queima por 1 hora, emitindo luz plena em um raio de 6 metros e meia-luz por mais 6 metros. Ao executar a ação atacar, você pode atacar com a tocha, usando-a como uma arma de combate corpo a corpo simples. Em caso de acerto, o alvo sofre 1 ponto de dano ígneo.

Caltrops.name: Estrepes
Caltrops.description: Como uma ação usar, você pode retirar estrepes da bolsa e espalhá-los, cobrindo uma área de 1,5 metro quadrado a até 1,5 metro de você. Uma criatura que entra nessa área pela primeira vez em um turno deve ser bem-sucedida em uma salvaguarda de Destreza CD 15 ou sofrerá 1 ponto de dano perfurante e terá seu deslocamento reduzido a 0 até o início de seu próximo turno. São necessários 10 minutos para recuperar os estrepes.

Oil.name: Óleo
Oil.description:
You can douse a creature, object, or space with Oil or use it as fuel, as detailed below.

Dousing a Creature or an Object. When you take the Attack action, you can replace one of your attacks with throwing an Oil flask. Target one creature or object within 20 feet of yourself. The target must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw (DC 8 plus your Dexterity modifier and Proficiency Bonus) or be covered in oil. If the target takes Fire damage before the oil dries (after 1 minute), the target takes an extra [[/damage 5 type=fire]] damage from burning oil.

Dousing a Space. You can take the Utilize action to pour an Oil flask on level ground to cover a 5-foot-square area within 5 feet of yourself. If lit, the oil burns until the end of the turn 2 rounds from when the oil was lit (or 12 seconds) and deals 5 Fire damage to any creature that enters the area or ends its turn there. A creature can take this damage only once per turn.

Fuel. Oil serves as fuel for Lamps and Lanterns. Once lit, a flask of Oil burns for 6 hours in a Lamp or Lantern. That duration doesn't need to be consecutive; you can extinguish the burning Oil (as a Utilize action) and rekindle it again until it has burned for a total of 6 hours.

Clothes, Traveler's.name: Traje de Viajante
Clothes, Traveler's.description: Traveler's Clothes are resilient garments designed for travel in various environments.

When you reach certain Fighter levels, you gain more uses of this feature, as shown in the Second Wind column of the @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.content24.JournalEntry.phbFighter000000.JournalEntryPage.wDELe3k25FQvYdrq#class-features]{Fighter Features} table.

Nota do Foundry

This feature automatically scales in usage and recovers the correct number of uses on a Short and Long Rest.

Weapon Mastery.name: Maestria com Armas
Weapon Mastery.description:
Seu treinamento com armas permite que você use as propriedades de maestria de dois tipos de armas, à sua escolha, com as quais tenha proficiência, como adagas e arcos curtos.

Sempre que você terminar um descanso longo, você poderá mudar os tipos de armas escolhidos. Por exemplo, você poderia passar a usar as propriedades de maestria de cimitarras e espadas curtas.

Defense.name: Defense
Defense.description:
(pré-requisito: Característica Estílo de Luta)

While you're wearing Light, Medium, or Heavy armor, you gain a +1 bonus to Armor Class.

Nota do Foundry

This feature includes an Active Effect which provides the Armor Class bonus. Disable it when you are not wearing armor.

Dice.name: Dados
Dice.description:
Atributo: Sabedoria

Usar: Discernir se alguém está trapaceando (CD 10) ou ganhar o jogo (CD 20).

Healer's Kit.name: Healer's Kit
Healer's Kit.description: A Healer's Kit has ten uses. As a Utilize action, you can expend one of its uses to stabilize an Unconscious creature that has 0 Hit Points without needing to make a Wisdom (Medicine) check.

Dungeoneer's Pack.name: Kit de Aventureiro
Dungeoneer's Pack.description: Um kit de aventureiro contém os seguintes itens: @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagBackpack000]{Mochila}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagCaltrops000]{Estrepes}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagCrowbar0000]{Pé de Cabra}, 2 frascos de @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagOil00000000]{Óleo}, 10 dias de @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagRations0000]{Rações}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagRope0000000]{Corda}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagTinderbox00]{Caixa para Fogo}, 10 @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagTorch000000]{Tochas}, and @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagWaterskin00]{Cantil}.

Waterskin.name: Cantil
Waterskin.description: A Waterskin holds up to 4 pints. If you don't drink sufficient water, you risk &Reference[dehydration].

Water (Pint).name: Água (Quartilho)
Water (Pint).description: If you don't drink sufficient water, you risk &Reference[dehydration].

Tinderbox.name: Caixa para Fogo
Tinderbox.description: A caixa para fogo é um pequeno recipiente contendo sílica, pederneira e uma acendalha (geralmente pano seco embebido em óleo) usada para atear fogo. Suas utilidades incluem, como uma ação bônus, acender vela, lamparina, lanterna ou tocha, bem como qualquer outro objeto com combustível exposto. Acender outros tipos de fogo leva 1 minuto.

Rope.name: Corda
Rope.description:
As a Utilize action, you can tie a knot with Rope if you succeed on a DC 10 Dexterity (Prestidigitação) check. The Rope can be burst with a successful DC 20 Strength (Athletics) check.

You can bind an unwilling creature with the Rope only if the creature has the &Reference[Grappled], &Reference[Incapacitated], or &Reference[Restrained] condition. If the creature's legs are bound, the creature has the Restrained condition until it escapes. Escaping the Rope requires the creature to make a successful DC 15 Dexterity (Acrobatics) check as an action.

Crowbar.name: Pé de Cabra
Crowbar.description: Using a Crowbar gives you Advantage on Strength checks where the Crowbar's leverage can be applied.

Rations.name: Rações
Rations.description: Rações consistem em alimentos prontos para viagem, incluindo carne seca, frutas secas, biscoito e nozes. Veja &Reference[Malnutrition] no glossário de regras em relação aos efeitos da falta de alimentação.

Torch.name: Tocha
Torch.description: Uma tocha queima por 1 hora, emitindo luz plena em um raio de 6 metros e meia-luz por mais 6 metros. Ao executar a ação atacar, você pode atacar com a tocha, usando-a como uma arma de combate corpo a corpo simples. Em caso de acerto, o alvo sofre 1 ponto de dano ígneo.

Caltrops.name: Estrepes
Caltrops.description: Como uma ação usar, você pode retirar estrepes da bolsa e espalhá-los, cobrindo uma área de 1,5 metro quadrado a até 1,5 metro de você. Uma criatura que entra nessa área pela primeira vez em um turno deve ser bem-sucedida em uma salvaguarda de Destreza CD 15 ou sofrerá 1 ponto de dano perfurante e terá seu deslocamento reduzido a 0 até o início de seu próximo turno. São necessários 10 minutos para recuperar os estrepes.

Oil.name: Óleo
Oil.description:
You can douse a creature, object, or space with Oil or use it as fuel, as detailed below.

Dousing a Creature or an Object. When you take the Attack action, you can replace one of your attacks with throwing an Oil flask. Target one creature or object within 20 feet of yourself. The target must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw (DC 8 plus your Dexterity modifier and Proficiency Bonus) or be covered in oil. If the target takes Fire damage before the oil dries (after 1 minute), the target takes an extra [[/damage 5 type=fire]] damage from burning oil.

Dousing a Space. You can take the Utilize action to pour an Oil flask on level ground to cover a 5-foot-square area within 5 feet of yourself. If lit, the oil burns until the end of the turn 2 rounds from when the oil was lit (or 12 seconds) and deals 5 Fire damage to any creature that enters the area or ends its turn there. A creature can take this damage only once per turn.

Fuel. Oil serves as fuel for Lamps and Lanterns. Once lit, a flask of Oil burns for 6 hours in a Lamp or Lantern. That duration doesn't need to be consecutive; you can extinguish the burning Oil (as a Utilize action) and rekindle it again until it has burned for a total of 6 hours.

Clothes, Traveler's.name: Traje de Viajante
Clothes, Traveler's.description: Traveler's Clothes are resilient garments designed for travel in various environments.

Action Surge.name: Surto de Ação
Action Surge.description:
Você é capaz de superar seus limites normais momentaneamente. No seu turno, você pode executar uma ação adicional que não seja a ação mágica.

Uma vez que usar esta característica, você não poderá fazê-lo novamente até terminar um descanso curto ou longo. A partir do nível 17, você pode usá-la duas vezes antes de um descanso, mas apenas uma vez no mesmo turno.

Nota do Foundry

Essa característica inclui uma limitação de uso que aumenta automaticamente no nível 17.

Tactical Mind.name: Engenhosidade Tática
Tactical Mind.description: Você é perspicaz com táticas dentro e fora do campo de batalha. Ao falhar em um teste de atributo, você pode gastar um uso de Recuperar Fôlego para se colocar de novo no caminho do sucesso. Em vez de recuperar pontos de vida, você joga 1d10 e adiciona o resultado ao teste de atributo, podendo transformá-lo em um sucesso. Se o teste falhar ainda assim, esse uso de Recuperar Fôlego não será gasto.

Expend Second Wind.name: Gastar Recuperar Fôlego
Expend Second Wind.condition: Ao falhar em um teste de atributo

Champion.name: Campeão
Champion.description:
Busque a excelência físíca em combate.

Um Campeão se concentra no desenvolvimento de proezas marciais em uma busca incessante pela vitória, combinando treinamento rigoroso e excelência física para desferir golpes devastadores, resistir ao perigo e conquistar a glória. Seja em competições atléticas ou batalhas sangrentas, Campeões lutam pelo título de vencedor.

Improved Critical.name: Crítico Superior
Improved Critical.description:
As suas jogadas de ataque com armas ou ataques desarmados obtêm acertos críticos com resultados 18, 19 ou 20 no d20.

Nota do Foundry

Esse recurso aumenta automaticamente o limite de acerto crítico para 19.

Remarkable Athlete.name: Atleta Extraordinário
Remarkable Athlete.description:
Graças ao seu porte atlético, você tem vantagem em jogadas de Iniciativa e testes de Força (Atletismo).

Além disso, imediatamente após obter um acerto crítico, você pode se mover até a metade de seu deslocamento sem provocar ataques de oportunidade.

Nota do Foundry

Essa característica automaticamente concede vantagem nas jogadas de Iniciativa.

Extra Attack.name: Ataque Extra
Extra Attack.description: Você pode atacar duas vezes, em vez de uma, sempre que executar a ação atacar em seu turno.

Tactical Shift.name: Movimento Tático
Tactical Shift.description: Sempre que ativar Recuperar Fôlego com uma ação bônus, você pode se mover até a metade de seu deslocamento sem provocar ataques de oportunidade.

Potion of Healing.name: Potion of Healing
Potion of Healing.description: This potion is a magic item. As a Bonus Action, you can drink it or administer it to another creature within 5 feet of yourself. The creature that drinks the magical red fluid in this vial regains 2d4 + 2 Hit Points.

Winged Boots.name: Winged Boots
Winged Boots.description:
Wondrous Item, Uncommon (Requires Attunement)

These boots have 4 charges and regain 1d4 expended charges daily at dawn. While wearing the boots, you can take a Magic action to expend 1 charge, gaining a Fly Speed of 30 feet for 1 hour. If you are flying when the duration expires, you descend at a rate of 30 feet per round until you land.

Winged.name: Alado
Winged.description: The wings lasts for 1 hour or until you end the effect early as a Magic action. The wings give you a Fly Speed of 60 feet.

RandalLv11000000.name: Randal
RandalLv11000000.description:
Randal worked his way through the ranks of his hometown's guard, ultimately growing restless with city life and wandering off in search of adventure.

Token artwork by Forgotten Adventures.

Token artwork by Forgotten Adventures.

Soldier.name: Soldado
Soldier.description:
Valores de Atributo: Força, Destreza, Constituição

Talento: @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.feats24.Item.phbftSavageAttac]{Atacante Selvagem}

Proficiências em Perícias: Atletismo e Intimidação

Proficiência com Ferramentas: Escolha um tipo de Kit de Jogos (veja o @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.content24.JournalEntry.phbEquipment0000.JournalEntryPage.GCvg8n7Q7ltSPRxe#gaming-set-(varies)]{capítulo 6})

Equipamento: Escolha A ou B: (A) @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbwepSpear00000]{Lança}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbwepShortbow00]{Arco Curto}, 20 @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbamoArrows0000]{Flechas}, Kit de Jogos (como acima), @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagHealersKit0]{Kit de Curandeiro}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagQuiver00000]{Aljava}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.items.Item.SsAmWV6YBqeOFihT]{Traje de Viajante}, 14 PO; ou (B) 50 PO

@Embed[Compendium.dnd5e.content24.JournalEntry.phbAppendixBackg.JournalEntryPage.phbbgSoldier0000 inline classes="free-rules-embed"]

Background Ability Score Improvement.title: Aumento de Atributo de Antecedente
Background Ability Score Improvement.hint: Seu antecedente permite que você aumente seus valores de Força, Destreza e Constituição; aumente um em 2 e outro em 1, ou aumente os três em 1 cada. Nenhum desses aumentos pode elevar um valor acima de 2

Background Proficiencies.title: Proficiências do Antecedente
Background Proficiencies.hint: Seu antecedente lhe concede proficiência em Atletismo e Intimidação. Ele também lhe concede proficiência em qualquer Kit de Jogos.

Background Feat.title: Talento do Antecedente
Background Feat.hint: Seu antecedente te concede o talento Atacante Selvagem.

Choose Languages.title: Escolha Idiomas
Choose Languages.hint: Seu personagem conhece pelo menos três idiomas: Comum e mais dois que você pode escolher na tabela Idiomas Padrão.

Savage Attacker.name: Savage Attacker
Savage Attacker.description: You've trained to deal particularly damaging strikes. Once per turn when you hit a target with a weapon, you can roll the weapon's damage dice twice and use either roll against the target.

Human.name: Human
Human.description:
@Embed[Compendium.dnd5e.content24.JournalEntry.phbAppendixSpeci.JournalEntryPage.phbspHuman000000 inline classes="free-rules-embed"]

Human Traits

Tipo de Criatura: Humanoide

Tamanho: Médio (de 1,2 a 2 metros de altura) ou Pequeno (de 0,5 a 1,2 metro de altura), escolhido ao selecionar esta espécie

Speed: 30 feet

Como alguém desta espécie, você tem os seguintes traços especiais.

Resourceful. You gain Heroic Inspiration whenever you finish a Long Rest.

Skillful. You gain proficiency in one skill of your choice.

Versatile. You gain an Origin feat of your choice (see chapter 5). Skilled is recommended.

dLxv96vt2B2KOEe2.hint: Médio (about 4-7 feet tall) ou Pequeno (about 2-4 feet tall), escolhido ao selecionar esta espécie

Skillful.title: Skillful
Skillful.hint: You gain proficiency in one skill of your choice.

Versatile.title: Versatile
Versatile.hint: You gain an Origin feat of your choice. Skillful is recommended.

Resourceful.name: Resourceful
Resourceful.description: You gain Heroic Inspiration whenever you finish a Long Rest.

Skillful.name: Skillful
Skillful.description:
You gain proficiency in one skill of your choice.

Nota do Foundry

You will be prompted for this choice when you select this Species.

Versatile.name: Versatile
Versatile.description:
You gain an @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.content24.JournalEntry.phbFeats00000000.JournalEntryPage.otAeQs0TLHYIBNuj]{Origin feat} of your choice. @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.feats24.Item.phbftSkilled0000]{Skilled} is recommended.

Nota do Foundry

You will be prompted for your choice when you select this Species.

Skilled.name: Habilidoso
Skilled.description:
Você ganha proficiência em qualquer combinação de três perícias ou ferramentas à sua escolha.

Repetível. Você pode obter este talento mais de uma vez.

Fighter.name: Guerreiro
Fighter.description:
Traços Principais do Guerreiro

Atributo Primário

Força ou Destreza

Dado de Vida

D10 por nível de guerreiro

Proficiências em Salvaguardas

Força e Constituição

Proficiências em Perícias

Escolha 2: Acrobacia, Atletismo, História, Intimidação, Intuição, Lidar com Animais, Percepção, Persuasão ou Sobrevivência

Proficiências com Armas

Armas simples e marciais

Treinamento com Armadura

Armaduras leves, médias e pesadas, escudos

Equipamento Inicial

Escolha A, B ou C: (A) @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbarmChainMail0]{Cota de Malha}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbwepGreatsword]{Espada Grande}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbwepFlail00000]{Mangual}, 8 @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbwepJavelin000]{Azagaias}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagDungeoneers]{Kit de Aventureiro} e [[/award 4GP]]; (B) @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbarmStuddedLea]{Armadura de Couro Batido}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbwepScimitar00]{Cimitarra}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbwepShortsword]{Espada Curta}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbwepLongbow000]{Arco Longo}, 20 @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbamoArrows0000]{Flechas}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagQuiver00000]{Aljava}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagDungeoneers]{Kit de Aventureiro} e [[/award 11GP]]; ou (C) [[/award 155GP]]

@Embed[Compendium.dnd5e.content24.JournalEntry.phbAppendixClass.JournalEntryPage.phbftrFighter000 inline classes="free-rules-embed"]

Tornando-se um guerreiro…

Como um Personagem de 1º Nível

  • Ganhe todos os traços da tabela Traços Principais do Guerreiro.
  • Ganhe as características de 1º nível de guerreiro, que estão listadas na Tabela Características de Guerreiro.

Como um Personagem Multiclasse

  • Ganhe as seguintes características da tabela Traços Principais do Guerreiro: Dado de vida, proficiência com armas marciais e treinamento com armaduras leves, médias e escudos.
  • Ganhe as características de 1º nível de guerreiro, que estão listadas na Tabela Características de Guerreiro.

Fighting Style.name: Estilo de Luta
Fighting Style.description:
You gain a @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.content24.JournalEntry.phbFeats00000000.JournalEntryPage.sbHImaCB8ZMEHYkb]{Fighting Style feat} of your choice. Em vez de escolher um desses talentos, você pode escolher a opção abaixo.
