Regaining Charges. The wand regains 1d6 + 1 expended charges daily at dawn. If you expend the wand's last charge, roll [[/r 1d20]]. On a 1, the wand crumbles into ashes and is destroyed.

Fireball.name: Fireball
Fireball.description:
A bright streak flashes from you to a point you choose within range and then blossoms with a low roar into a fiery explosion. [[lookup @labels.description.affects capitalize]] in a [[lookup @labels.description.template]] centered on that point makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking 8d6 Fire damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

Flammable objects in the area that aren't being worn or carried start burning.

Usando Espaços de Magia de Círculo Superior. The damage increases by 1d6 for each spell slot level above 3.
Fireball.materials: a ball of bat guano and sulfur

Ring of Mind Shielding.name: Ring of Mind Shielding
Ring of Mind Shielding.description:
Ring, Uncommon (Requires Attunement)

While wearing this ring, you are immune to magic that allows other creatures to read your thoughts, determine whether you are lying, know your alignment, or know your creature type. Creatures can telepathically communicate with you only if you allow it.

You can take a Magic action to cause the ring to become imperceptible until you take another Magic action to make it perceptible, until you remove the ring, or until you die.

If you die while wearing the ring, your soul enters it, unless it already houses a soul. You can remain in the ring or depart for the afterlife. As long as your soul is in the ring, you can telepathically communicate with any creature wearing it. A wearer can't prevent this telepathic communication.

Efficient Quiver.name: Efficient Quiver
Efficient Quiver.description:
Wondrous Item, Uncommon

Each of the quiver's three compartments connects to an extradimensional space that allows the quiver to hold numerous items while never weighing more than 2 pounds. The shortest compartment can hold up to 60 Arrows, Bolts, or similar objects. The midsize compartment holds up to 18 Javelins or similar objects. The longest compartment holds up to 6 long objects, such as bows, Quarterstaffs, or Spears.

You can draw any item the quiver contains as if doing so from a regular quiver or scabbard.

Long Compartment.name: Long Compartment
Long Compartment.description: The long compartment holds up to 6 long objects, such as bows, Quarterstaffs, or Spears.

Short Compartment.name: Short Compartment
Short Compartment.description: The short compartment can hold up to 60 Arrows, Bolts, or similar objects.

Midsize Compartment.name: Midsize Compartment
Midsize Compartment.description: The midsize compartment holds up to 18 Javelins or similar objects.

Pipes of Haunting.name: Pipes of Haunting
Pipes of Haunting.description:
Wondrous Item, Uncommon

These pipes have 3 charges and regain 1d3 expended charges daily at dawn. You can take a Magic action to play them and expend 1 charge to create an eerie, spellbinding tune. Each creature of your choice within 30 feet of you must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or have the &Reference[Frightened apply=false] condition for 1 minute. A creature that fails the save repeats it at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. A creature that succeeds on its save is immune to the effect of these pipes for 24 hours.

Bag of Holding.name: Bag of Holding
Bag of Holding.description:
This bag has an interior space considerably larger than its outside dimensions—roughly 2 feet square and 4 feet deep on the inside. The bag can hold up to 500 pounds, not exceeding a volume of 64 cubic feet. The bag weighs 5 pounds, regardless of its contents. Retrieving an item from the bag requires a Utilize action.

If the bag is overloaded, pierced, or torn, it is destroyed, and its contents are scattered in the Astral Plane. If the bag is turned inside out, its contents spill forth unharmed, but the bag must be put right before it can be used again. The bag holds enough air for 10 minutes of breathing, divided by the number of breathing creatures inside.

Placing a Bag of Holding inside an extradimensional space created by a @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.dmgHewardsHandyH]{Handy Haversack}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.dmgPortableHole0]{Portable Hole}, or similar item instantly destroys both items and opens a gate to the Astral Plane. The gate originates where the one item was placed inside the other. Any creature within a 10-foot-radius Sphere centered on the gate is sucked through it to a random location on the Astral Plane. The gate then closes. The gate is one-way and can't be reopened.

Oil of Slipperiness.name: Oil of Slipperiness
Oil of Slipperiness.description:
Potion, Uncommon

One vial of this oil can cover one Medium or smaller creature, along with the equipment it's wearing and carrying (one additional vial is required for each size category above Medium). Applying the oil takes 10 minutes. The affected creature then gains the effect of the @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplFreedomofM]{Movimentação Livre} spell for 8 hours.

Alternatively, the oil can be poured on the ground as a Magic action, where it covers a 10-foot square, duplicating the effect of the @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplGrease0000]{Grease} spell in that area for 8 hours.

This sticky, black unguent is thick and heavy, but it flows quickly when poured.

Freedom of Movement.name: Freedom of Movement
Freedom of Movement.description:
You touch a willing creature. For the duration, the target's movement is unaffected by &Reference[DifficultTerrain], and spells and other magical effects can neither reduce the target's Speed nor cause the target to have the &Reference[Paralyzed apply=false] or &Reference[Restrained apply=false] conditions. The target also has a Swim Speed equal to its Speed.

In addition, the target can spend 5 feet of movement to automatically escape from nonmagical restraints, such as manacles or a creature imposing the &Reference[Grappled apply=false] condition on it.

Usando Espaços de Magia de Círculo Superior. You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 4.

Grease.name: Grease
Grease.description:
Nonflammable grease covers the ground in a 10-foot square centered on a point within range and turns it into &Reference[difficultterrain] for the duration.

When the grease appears, each creature standing in its area must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or have the &Reference[prone] condition. A creature that enters the area or ends its turn there must also succeed on that save or fall Prone.
Grease.materials: a bit of pork rind or butter

Potion of Water Breathing.name: Potion of Water Breathing
Potion of Water Breathing.description:
Potion, Uncommon

You can breathe underwater for 24 hours after drinking this potion.

This potion's cloudy green fluid smells of the sea and has a jellyfish-like bubble floating in it.

Nota do Foundry

The Water Breather Active Effect can be used for tracking.

RiswynnLv1700000.name: Riswynn
RiswynnLv1700000.description:
Once a well-respected bureaucrat at the dwarven halls, Riswynn dabbled in intrigue, picked up a few tricks, and ran intro trouble with some nobles. She looks to make a name for herself and regain her social status.

Token artwork by Forgotten Adventures.

Token artwork by Forgotten Adventures.

Dwarf.name: Anão
Dwarf.description:
@Embed[Compendium.dnd5e.content24.JournalEntry.phbAppendixSpeci.JournalEntryPage.phbspDwarf000000 inline classes="free-rules-embed"]

Traços de Anão

Tipo de Criatura: Humanoide

Tamanho: Médio (de 1,2 a 1,5 metro de altura)

Deslocamento: 9 metros

Como alguém desta espécie, você tem os seguintes traços especiais.

Visão no Escuro. Você tem visão no escuro com distância de 36 metros.

Resiliência Anã. Você tem resistência a dano venenoso. Você também tem vantagem em salvaguar das para evitar ou encerrar a condição envenenado.

Tenacidade Anã. Seus pontos de vida máximos aumentam em 1, e mais 1 toda vez que você ganha um nível.

Conhecimento de Pedras. Como uma ação bônus, você ganha sismicons ciência com distância de 18 metros por 10 minutos. Você deve estar em uma superfície de pedra ou tocando uma para usar sismiconsciência. A pedra pode ser natural ou trabalhada. Você pode usar esta ação bônus um número de vezes igual ao seu bônus de proficiência e recupera todos os usos gastos ao acabar um descanso longo.

Dwarven Resilience.title: Resiliência Anã
Dwarven Resilience.hint: Você tem resistência a dano venenoso.

Dwarven Resilience.name: Resiliência Anã
Dwarven Resilience.description:
Você tem resistência a dano venenoso. Você também tem vantagem em salvaguar das para evitar ou encerrar a condição envenenado.

Nota do Foundry

You will automatically be granted Resistance to Poison damage but not Advantage on saving throws to avoid/end the Poisoned condition.

Dwarven Toughness.name: Dwarven Toughness
Dwarven Toughness.description:
Seus pontos de vida máximos aumentam em 1, e mais 1 toda vez que você ganha um nível.

Nota do Foundry

The Hit Point maximum increase is handled automatically each level.

Stonecunning.name: Stonecunning
Stonecunning.description:
As a Bonus Action, you gain &Reference[Tremorsense] with a range of 60 feet for 10 minutes. Você deve estar em uma superfície de pedra ou tocando uma para usar sismiconsciência. A pedra pode ser natural ou trabalhada. You can use this Bonus Action a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest.

Nota do Foundry

This feature includes the limited uses and an Active Effect that grants you the 60 feet of Tremorsense. It does not automatically update your Token's vision settings.

Rogue.name: Rogue
Rogue.description:
Traços Principais do Ladino

Atributo Primário

Destreza

Dado de Vida

D8 por nível de ladino

Proficiências em Salvaguardas

Destreza e Inteligência

Proficiências em Perícias

Escolha 4: Acrobacia, Atletismo, Enganação, Furtividade, Intimidação, Intuição, Investigação, Percepção, Persuasão ou Prestidigitação

Proficiências com Armas

Armas simples e armas marciais que tenham a propriedade leve ou acuidade

Proficiências com Ferramentas

Thieves' Tools

Treinamento com Armadura

Armaduras leves

Equipamento Inicial

Escolha A ou B: (A) @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbarmLeatherArm]{Armadura de Couro}, 2 @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbwepDagger0000]{Adagas}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbwepShortsword]{Espada Curta}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbwepShortbow00]{Arco Curto}, 20 @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbamoArrows0000]{Flechas}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagQuiver00000]{Aljava}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbtulThievesToo]{Ferramentas de Ladrão}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagBurglarsPac]{Burglar's Pack} e [[/award 8GP]]; ou (B) [[/award 100GP]]

@Embed[Compendium.dnd5e.content24.JournalEntry.phbAppendixClass.JournalEntryPage.phbrgeRogue00000 inline classes="free-rules-embed"]

Tornando-se um ladino...

Como um Personagem de 1º Nível

  • Ganhe todos os traços da tabela Traços Principais do Ladino.
  • Gain the Rogue's level 1 features, which are listed in the Rogue Features table.

Como um Personagem Multiclasse

  • Ganhe as seguintes características da tabela Traços Principais do Ladino: Hit Point Die, proficiency in one skill of your choice from the Rogue's skill list, proficiency with Thieves' Tools, and training with Light armor.
  • Gain the Rogue's level 1 features, which are listed in the @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.content24.JournalEntry.phbRogue00000000.JournalEntryPage.gJV8iDqdNhRMLi5r#class-features]{Rogue Features table}.

Expertise.title: Especialista
Expertise.hint: Você se torna Especialista em duas perícias nas quais tenha proficiência, à sua escolha. Furtividade e Prestidigitação são recomendadas, caso tenha proficiência nelas.

Thieves' Cant.title: Gíria do Ladrão
Thieves' Cant.hint: Você aprendeu vários dialetos pelas comunidades em que atuou com seus talentos clandestinos. Você conhece a Gíria do Ladrão e um outro idioma à sua escolha dentre os idiomas abaixo.

FiaNLovfP6tnY4tD.hint: Sua mente perspicaz é excepcionalmente difícil de controlar. Você ganha proficiência nas salvaguardas de Sabedoria e Carisma.

Expertise.name: Especialista
Expertise.description:
Escolha duas perícias em que seja proficiente, mas não seja especialista. Você passa a ser especialista nessas perícias.

Nota do Foundry

Você será chamado a fazer a escolha quando alcançar este nível.

Sneak Attack.name: Ataque Furtivo
Sneak Attack.description:
You know how to strike subtly and exploit a foe's distraction. Once per turn, you can deal an extra 1d6 damage to one creature you hit with an attack roll if you have Advantage on the roll and the attack uses a Finesse or a Ranged weapon. The extra damage's type is the same as the weapon's type.

You don't need Advantage on the attack roll if at least one of your allies is within 5 feet of the target, the ally doesn't have the Incapacitated condition, and you don't have Disadvantage on the attack roll.

The extra damage increases as you gain Rogue levels, as shown in the Sneak Attack column of the Rogue Features table.

Current Sneak Attack Damage: [[lookup @scale.rogue.sneak-attack]]

Nota do Foundry

Your sneak attack damage will automatically scale as you level up. You can select the damage type in the damage roll's dialog box.

Thieves' Cant.name: Gíria do Ladrão
Thieves' Cant.description:
You picked up various languages in the communities where you plied your roguish talents. You know Thieves' Cant and one other language of your choice, which you choose from the language tables in @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.content24.JournalEntry.phbCreatingAChar.JournalEntryPage.t1WP9VEevo4TOTXw#choose-languages]{Character Creation}.

Nota do Foundry

Thieves' Cant will be added to your sheet automatically and you will be prompted to choose the additional language.

Weapon Mastery.name: Maestria com Armas
Weapon Mastery.description:
Seu treinamento com armas permite que você use as propriedades de maestria de dois tipos de armas, à sua escolha, com as quais tenha proficiência, como adagas e arcos curtos.

Sempre que você terminar um descanso longo, você poderá mudar os tipos de armas escolhidos. Por exemplo, você poderia passar a usar as propriedades de maestria de cimitarras e espadas curtas.

Thieves' Tools.name: Ferramentas de Ladrão
Thieves' Tools.description:
Atributo: Destreza

Usar: Arrombar uma fechadura (CD 15), ou desarmar uma armadilha (CD 15)

Arrows.name: Flechas
Arrows.description:
Armazenamento: @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagQuiver00000]{Aljava}

Qualquer arma que possua a propriedade munição requer algum tipo de @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagAmmunitionV]{munição}. A descrição da arma especifica o tipo de munição usada por ela. A tabela Munição lista os diferentes tipos e a quantidade obtida ao comprá-las. A tabela também lista o item normalmente usado para armazenar cada tipo de munição, que é vendido separadamente.

Burglar's Pack.name: Kit de Assaltante
Burglar's Pack.description: A Burglar's Pack contains the following items: @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagBackpack000]{Mochila}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagBallBearing]{Ball Bearings}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagBell0000000]{Bell}, 10 @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagCandle00000]{Candles}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagCrowbar0000]{Pé de Cabra}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.items.Item.wjHtGnd05SPdURqE]{Lanterna Coberta}, 7 @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagOil00000000]{flasks of Oil}, 5 days of @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagRations0000]{Rações}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagRope0000000]{Corda}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagTinderbox00]{Caixa para Fogo}, and @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagWaterskin00]{Cantil}.

Bell.name: Sino
Bell.description: Quando tocado como uma ação usar, o sino produz um som audível a até 18 metros de distância.

Oil.name: Óleo
Oil.description:
You can douse a creature, object, or space with Oil or use it as fuel, as detailed below.

Dousing a Creature or an Object. When you take the Attack action, you can replace one of your attacks with throwing an Oil flask. Target one creature or object within 20 feet of yourself. The target must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw (DC 8 plus your Dexterity modifier and Proficiency Bonus) or be covered in oil. If the target takes Fire damage before the oil dries (after 1 minute), the target takes an extra [[/damage 5 type=fire]] damage from burning oil.

Dousing a Space. You can take the Utilize action to pour an Oil flask on level ground to cover a 5-foot-square area within 5 feet of yourself. If lit, the oil burns until the end of the turn 2 rounds from when the oil was lit (or 12 seconds) and deals 5 Fire damage to any creature that enters the area or ends its turn there. A creature can take this damage only once per turn.

Fuel. Oil serves as fuel for Lamps and Lanterns. Once lit, a flask of Oil burns for 6 hours in a Lamp or Lantern. That duration doesn't need to be consecutive; you can extinguish the burning Oil (as a Utilize action) and rekindle it again until it has burned for a total of 6 hours.

Ball Bearings.name: Esferas de Metal
Ball Bearings.description:
Como uma ação Usar Objeto, você pode derramar Esferas de Metal de sua algibeira. Elas se espalham para cobrir uma área nivelada quadrada de 3 metros de lados a até 3 metros de você. Uma criatura que entra nesta área pela primeira vez em um turno deve ser bem-sucedida em uma salvaguarda de Destreza CD 10 ou tem a condição &Reference[Prone]. Leva 10 minutos para recolher as Esferas de Metal.

Nota do Foundry

A atividade Recuperar Esferas de Metal concede mais uma utilização deste item.

Tinderbox.name: Caixa para Fogo
Tinderbox.description: A caixa para fogo é um pequeno recipiente contendo sílica, pederneira e uma acendalha (geralmente pano seco embebido em óleo) usada para atear fogo. Suas utilidades incluem, como uma ação bônus, acender vela, lamparina, lanterna ou tocha, bem como qualquer outro objeto com combustível exposto. Acender outros tipos de fogo leva 1 minuto.

Waterskin.name: Cantil
Waterskin.description: A Waterskin holds up to 4 pints. If you don't drink sufficient water, you risk &Reference[dehydration].

Water (Pint).name: Água (Quartilho)
Water (Pint).description: If you don't drink sufficient water, you risk &Reference[dehydration].

Rations.name: Rações
Rations.description: Rações consistem em alimentos prontos para viagem, incluindo carne seca, frutas secas, biscoito e nozes. Veja &Reference[Malnutrition] no glossário de regras em relação aos efeitos da falta de alimentação.

Crowbar.name: Pé de Cabra
Crowbar.description: Using a Crowbar gives you Advantage on Strength checks where the Crowbar's leverage can be applied.

Candle.name: Vela
Candle.description: Por 1 hora, uma Vela acesa emite Luz Plena em um raio de 1,5 metro e Meia-luz por mais 1,5 metro.

Rope.name: Corda
Rope.description:
As a Utilize action, you can tie a knot with Rope if you succeed on a DC 10 Dexterity (Prestidigitação) check. The Rope can be burst with a successful DC 20 Strength (Athletics) check.

You can bind an unwilling creature with the Rope only if the creature has the &Reference[Grappled], &Reference[Incapacitated], or &Reference[Restrained] condition. If the creature's legs are bound, the creature has the Restrained condition until it escapes. Escaping the Rope requires the creature to make a successful DC 15 Dexterity (Acrobatics) check as an action.

Suprimentos de Calígrafo.name: Suprimentos de Calígrafo
Suprimentos de Calígrafo.description:
Atributo: Destreza

Usar: Escrever textos com floreados impressionantes que protegem contra falsificação (CD 15).

Criação: @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagInk00000000]{Tinta}, Pergaminho de Magia

Clothes, Fine.name: Roupas Finas
Clothes, Fine.description: Roupas finas são feitas de tecidos caros e adornadas com detalhes habilmente trabalhados. Alguns eventos e locais admitem apenas pessoas com essas roupas.

Lantern, Hooded.name: Lantern, Hooded
Lantern, Hooded.description: A Hooded Lantern burns Oil as fuel to cast Bright Light in a 30-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 30 feet. As a Bonus Action, you can lower the hood, reducing the light to Dim Light in a 5-foot radius, or raise it again.

Cunning Action.name: Ação Ardilosa
Cunning Action.description: Seu pensamento rápido e sua agilidade permitem que você se movimente e aja com rapidez. No seu turno, você pode realizar uma das seguintes ações como uma ação bônus: &Reference[Dash], &Reference[Disengage] ou &Reference[Hide].

Steady Aim.name: Mira Firme
Steady Aim.description: Como uma ação bônus, você se concede vantagem na sua próxima jogada de ataque no turno atual. Você só pode usar essa ação bônus se não tiver se movido nesse turno e, após usar essa ação bônus, seu deslocamento se torna 0 até o final do turno atual.

Thief.name: Ladrão
Thief.description:
Cace tesouros como um aventureiro clássico.

Uma mistura de assaltante, caçador de tesouros e explorador, você é a epítome de um aventureiro. Além de melhorar sua agilidade e furtividade, você ganha habilidades úteis para imergir em ruínas e tirar proveito dos itens mágicos que lá encontrar.

Fast Hands.name: Mão Leve
Fast Hands.description:
Como uma ação bônus, você pode fazer uma das seguintes ações.

Prestidigitação. Make a Dexterity (Prestidigitação) check to pick a lock or disarm a trap with Thieves' Tools or to pick a pocket.

Usar Objeto. Execute uma ação usar ou uma ação mágica para usar um item mágico que requeira tal ação.

Nota do Foundry

The Prestidigitação and Thieves' Tools activities include the relevant checks.

A atividade Usar Objeto pode ser utilizada para rastrear o uso de Ação Bônus.

Second-Story Work.name: Andarilho de Telhados
Second-Story Work.description:
Você é treinado para alcançar lugares difíceis, obtendo os seguintes benefícios.

Escalador. Você ganha deslocamento de escalada igual ao seu deslocamento.

Saltador. Você pode determinar a distância dos seus &Reference[Jumping]{saltos} usando a Destreza em vez da Força.

Nota do Foundry

Essa característica não adiciona automaticamente o deslocamento de escalada e ele terá que ser adicionado manualmente.

Cunning Strike.name: Golpe Ardiloso
Cunning Strike.description:
Você desenvolveu maneiras ardilosas de utilizar seu Ataque Furtivo. Ao causar dano de Ataque Furtivo, você pode adicionar um dos seguintes efeitos de Golpe Ardiloso. Cada efeito tem um custo em dados, que é o número de dados de dano de Ataque Furtivo dos quais você deve abrir mão para adicionar o efeito. Você remove os dados antes de jogar o dano, e o efeito ocorre imediatamente após o dano do ataque ser causado. Por exemplo, se você adicionar o efeito Envenenar, remova 1d6 do dano do Ataque Furtivo antes de jogar o dano.

Se um efeito de Golpe Ardiloso exigir uma salvaguarda, a CD será igual a 8 mais seu modificador de Destreza e o bônus de proficiência.

Envenenar (custo: 1d6). Você adiciona uma toxina ao seu ataque, forçando o alvo a fazer uma salvaguarda de Constituição. Se falhar, o alvo fica sob a condição &Reference[Poisoned] por 1 minuto. Ao final de cada turno dele, o alvo envenenado repete a salvaguarda, encerrando o efeito sobre si em caso de sucesso.

Para usar esse efeito, você deve ter um kit de venefício consigo.

Tropeçar (custo: 1d6). Se o alvo for Grande ou menor, deve ser bem-sucedido em uma salvaguarda de Destreza ou fica sob a condição &Reference[Prone].

Retirada (custo: 1d6). Imediatamente após o ataque, você se move até a metade de seu deslocamento sem provocar ataques de oportunidade.

Nota do Foundry

Depois de usar os efeitos de Golpe Ardiloso use a atividade Ataque Furtivo Ardiloso nesta característica. Isso irá pedir que você selecione quantos dados você gastou nos efeitos e deduz eles do seu Ataque Furtivo automaticamente.

Você pode selecionar o tipo de dano na caixa de diálogo da jogada de dano.

A atividade Envenenar inclui um Efeito Ativo que aplica a condição Envenenado.

A atividade Tropeçar inclui um Efeito Ativo que aplica a condição Caído ou você pode usar a condição inserida no texto acima.

Poison.name: Venenoso
Poison.condition: Ao causar dano de Ataque Furtivo

Trip.name: Trip
Trip.condition: When you deal Snack Attack damage

Cunning Sneak Attack.name: Cunning Sneak Attack
Cunning Sneak Attack.condition: Ao causar dano de Ataque Furtivo

Withdraw.name: Withdraw
Withdraw.condition: Ao causar dano de Ataque Furtivo

Cunning Strike: Poisoned.name: Golpe Ardiloso: Envenenado
Cunning Strike: Poisoned.description: Se falhar, o alvo fica sob a condição &Reference[Poisoned] por 1 minuto.

Uncanny Dodge.name: Esquiva Sobrenatural
Uncanny Dodge.description:
Quando um atacante que você possa ver o acerta com uma jogada de ataque, você pode executar uma reação para diminuir o dano causado a você pela metade (arredondar para baixo).

Nota do Foundry

Com seu token selecionado, você pode tanto clicar com o botão direito no cartão do dano e selecionar  Aplicar Metade do Dano ou clicar no botão "1/2" e então no botão Aplicar.

Uncanny Dodge.name: Esquiva Sobrenatural
Uncanny Dodge.condition: Quando um atacante que você possa ver o acerta com uma jogada de ataque

Gem of Brightness.name: Gem of Brightness
Gem of Brightness.description:
Wondrous Item, Uncommon

This prism has 50 charges. While you are holding it, you can take a Magic action and use one of three command words to cause one of the following effects:

First Command Word. The gem sheds Bright Light in a 30-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 30 feet. This effect doesn't expend a charge. It lasts until you take a Bonus Action to repeat the command word or until you use another function of the gem.

Second Command Word. You expend 1 charge and cause the gem to fire a brilliant beam of light at one creature you can see within 60 feet of yourself. The creature must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or have the &Reference[Blinded apply=false] condition for 1 minute. The creature repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

Third Command Word. You expend 5 charges and cause the gem to flare with intense light in a 30-foot Cone. Each creature in the Cone makes a saving throw as if struck by the beam created with the second command word.

When all of the gem's charges are expended, the gem becomes a nonmagical jewel worth 50 GP.

Wand of Magic Missiles.name: Wand of Magic Missiles
Wand of Magic Missiles.description:
Wand, Uncommon

This wand has 7 charges. While holding it, you can expend no more than 3 charges to cast @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplMagicMissi]{Magic Missile} from it. For 1 charge, you cast the level 1 version of the spell. You can increase the spell's level by 1 for each additional charge you expend.

Regaining Charges. The wand regains 1d6 + 1 expended charges daily at dawn. If you expend the wand's last charge, roll [[/r 1d20]]. On a 1, the wand crumbles into ashes and is destroyed.

Magic Missile.name: Magic Missile
Magic Missile.description:
You create three glowing darts of magical force. Each dart strikes a creature of your choice that you can see within range. A dart deals 1d4 + 1 Force damage to its target. The darts all strike simultaneously, and you can direct them to hit one creature or several.

Usando Espaços de Magia de Círculo Superior. The spell creates one more dart for each spell slot level above 1.

[[2 + @item.level]]{Level [[lookup @item.level]] darts}

Potion of Healing.name: Potion of Healing
Potion of Healing.description: This potion is a magic item. As a Bonus Action, you can drink it or administer it to another creature within 5 feet of yourself. The creature that drinks the magical red fluid in this vial regains 2d4 + 2 Hit Points.

Bureaucrat.name: Bureaucrat
Bureaucrat.description:
Valores de Atributo: Dexterity, Intelligence, Wisdom

Talento: Skilled

Proficiências em Perícias: Insight, Persuasion

Proficiência com Ferramentas: Suprimentos de Calígrafo

Equipamento: Choose A or B: (A) @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbtulCalligraph], @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagClothesFine], [[/award 25gp]] ou (B) [[/award 50gp]]

Skilled.name: Habilidoso
Skilled.description:
Você ganha proficiência em qualquer combinação de três perícias ou ferramentas à sua escolha.

Repetível. Você pode obter este talento mais de uma vez.

Evasion.name: Evasão
Evasion.description:
Você pode se esquivar agilmente de certos perigos. Ao ser submetido a um efeito que lhe permita fazer uma salvaguarda de Destreza para reduzir o dano à metade, você não sofre dano se for bem-sucedido na salvaguarda, e sofre apenas a metade do dano se falhar. Não é possível usar essa característica caso você esteja com a condição incapacitado.

Nota do Foundry

Com seu token selecionado, você pode tanto clicar com o botão direito no cartão do dano e selecionar  Aplicar Metade do Dano ou clicar no botão "1/2" e então no botão Aplicar.

Reliable Talent.name: Talento Confiável
Reliable Talent.description:
Sempre que fizer um teste de atributo que usa uma perícia ou ferramenta na qual tenha proficiência, você pode tratar um resultado igual ou inferior a 9 no d20 como um 10.

Nota do Foundry

Essa característica inclui um Efeito Ativo que automatiza a jogada mínima de 10 nas suas proficiências em perícias e ferramentas.

Supreme Sneak.name: Furtividade Suprema
Supreme Sneak.description:
Você ganha a seguinte opção de Golpe Ardiloso.

Ataque Discreto (custo: 1d6). Se você tiver a condição invisível da ação &Reference[Hide], esse ataque não encerra essa condição se você terminar o turno com &Reference[Three-Quarters Cover] ou &Reference[Total Cover].

Improved Cunning Strike.name: Golpe Ardiloso Aprimorado
Improved Cunning Strike.description:
Você pode usar até dois efeitos de Golpe Ardiloso ao causar dano de Ataque Furtivo, pagando o custo em dados para cada efeito.

Nota do Foundry

Depois de usar os efeitos do Golpe Ardiloso, use a atividade [[/item Cunning Strike activity=Cunning Sneak Attack]]{Ataque Furtivo Ardiloso}. Isso irá pedir que você selecione quantos dados você gastou nos efeitos e deduz eles do seu Ataque Furtivo automaticamente.

Você pode controlar o tipo de dano na caixa de diálogo da jogada de dano.

Wand of Fireballs.name: Wand of Fireballs
Wand of Fireballs.description:
Wand, Rare (Requires Attunement by a Spellcaster)

This wand has 7 charges. While holding it, you can expend no more than 3 charges to cast @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplFireball00]{Bola de Fogo} (save DC 15) from it. For 1 charge, you cast the level 3 version of the spell. You can increase the spell's level by 1 for each additional charge you expend.

Regaining Charges. The wand regains 1d6 + 1 expended charges daily at dawn. If you expend the wand's last charge, roll [[/r 1d20]]. On a 1, the wand crumbles into ashes and is destroyed.

Fireball.name: Fireball
Fireball.description:
A bright streak flashes from you to a point you choose within range and then blossoms with a low roar into a fiery explosion. [[lookup @labels.description.affects capitalize]] in a [[lookup @labels.description.template]] centered on that point makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking 8d6 Fire damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

Flammable objects in the area that aren't being worn or carried start burning.

Usando Espaços de Magia de Círculo Superior. The damage increases by 1d6 for each spell slot level above 3.
Fireball.materials: a ball of bat guano and sulfur

Ring of Mind Shielding.name: Ring of Mind Shielding
Ring of Mind Shielding.description:
Ring, Uncommon (Requires Attunement)

While wearing this ring, you are immune to magic that allows other creatures to read your thoughts, determine whether you are lying, know your alignment, or know your creature type. Creatures can telepathically communicate with you only if you allow it.

You can take a Magic action to cause the ring to become imperceptible until you take another Magic action to make it perceptible, until you remove the ring, or until you die.

If you die while wearing the ring, your soul enters it, unless it already houses a soul. You can remain in the ring or depart for the afterlife. As long as your soul is in the ring, you can telepathically communicate with any creature wearing it. A wearer can't prevent this telepathic communication.

Efficient Quiver.name: Efficient Quiver
Efficient Quiver.description:
Wondrous Item, Uncommon

Each of the quiver's three compartments connects to an extradimensional space that allows the quiver to hold numerous items while never weighing more than 2 pounds. The shortest compartment can hold up to 60 Arrows, Bolts, or similar objects. The midsize compartment holds up to 18 Javelins or similar objects. The longest compartment holds up to 6 long objects, such as bows, Quarterstaffs, or Spears.

You can draw any item the quiver contains as if doing so from a regular quiver or scabbard.

Long Compartment.name: Long Compartment
Long Compartment.description: The long compartment holds up to 6 long objects, such as bows, Quarterstaffs, or Spears.

Short Compartment.name: Short Compartment
Short Compartment.description: The short compartment can hold up to 60 Arrows, Bolts, or similar objects.

Midsize Compartment.name: Midsize Compartment
Midsize Compartment.description: The midsize compartment holds up to 18 Javelins or similar objects.

Pipes of Haunting.name: Pipes of Haunting
Pipes of Haunting.description:
Wondrous Item, Uncommon

These pipes have 3 charges and regain 1d3 expended charges daily at dawn. You can take a Magic action to play them and expend 1 charge to create an eerie, spellbinding tune. Each creature of your choice within 30 feet of you must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or have the &Reference[Frightened apply=false] condition for 1 minute. A creature that fails the save repeats it at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. A creature that succeeds on its save is immune to the effect of these pipes for 24 hours.

Bag of Holding.name: Bag of Holding
Bag of Holding.description:
This bag has an interior space considerably larger than its outside dimensions—roughly 2 feet square and 4 feet deep on the inside. The bag can hold up to 500 pounds, not exceeding a volume of 64 cubic feet. The bag weighs 5 pounds, regardless of its contents. Retrieving an item from the bag requires a Utilize action.

If the bag is overloaded, pierced, or torn, it is destroyed, and its contents are scattered in the Astral Plane. If the bag is turned inside out, its contents spill forth unharmed, but the bag must be put right before it can be used again. The bag holds enough air for 10 minutes of breathing, divided by the number of breathing creatures inside.

Placing a Bag of Holding inside an extradimensional space created by a @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.dmgHewardsHandyH]{Handy Haversack}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.dmgPortableHole0]{Portable Hole}, or similar item instantly destroys both items and opens a gate to the Astral Plane. The gate originates where the one item was placed inside the other. Any creature within a 10-foot-radius Sphere centered on the gate is sucked through it to a random location on the Astral Plane. The gate then closes. The gate is one-way and can't be reopened.

Oil of Slipperiness.name: Oil of Slipperiness
Oil of Slipperiness.description:
Potion, Uncommon

One vial of this oil can cover one Medium or smaller creature, along with the equipment it's wearing and carrying (one additional vial is required for each size category above Medium). Applying the oil takes 10 minutes. The affected creature then gains the effect of the @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplFreedomofM]{Movimentação Livre} spell for 8 hours.

Alternatively, the oil can be poured on the ground as a Magic action, where it covers a 10-foot square, duplicating the effect of the @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplGrease0000]{Grease} spell in that area for 8 hours.

This sticky, black unguent is thick and heavy, but it flows quickly when poured.

Freedom of Movement.name: Freedom of Movement
Freedom of Movement.description:
You touch a willing creature. For the duration, the target's movement is unaffected by &Reference[DifficultTerrain], and spells and other magical effects can neither reduce the target's Speed nor cause the target to have the &Reference[Paralyzed apply=false] or &Reference[Restrained apply=false] conditions. The target also has a Swim Speed equal to its Speed.

In addition, the target can spend 5 feet of movement to automatically escape from nonmagical restraints, such as manacles or a creature imposing the &Reference[Grappled apply=false] condition on it.

Usando Espaços de Magia de Círculo Superior. You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 4.

Grease.name: Grease
Grease.description:
Nonflammable grease covers the ground in a 10-foot square centered on a point within range and turns it into &Reference[difficultterrain] for the duration.

When the grease appears, each creature standing in its area must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or have the &Reference[prone] condition. A creature that enters the area or ends its turn there must also succeed on that save or fall Prone.
Grease.materials: a bit of pork rind or butter

Potion of Water Breathing.name: Potion of Water Breathing
Potion of Water Breathing.description:
Potion, Uncommon

You can breathe underwater for 24 hours after drinking this potion.

This potion's cloudy green fluid smells of the sea and has a jellyfish-like bubble floating in it.

Nota do Foundry

The Water Breather Active Effect can be used for tracking.

Use Magic Device.name: Usar Dispositivo Mágico
Use Magic Device.description:
Você aprendeu a maximizar o uso de itens mágicos, que lhe concede os seguintes ben efícios.

Sintonização. Você pode sintonizar até quatro itens mágicos de uma vez.

Cargas. Sempre que você usar uma propriedade de item mágico que gaste cargas, jogue [[/r 1d6]. Se o resultado for 6, você usa a propriedade sem gastar cargas.

Pergaminhos. Você pode usar qualquer pergaminho de magia usando Inteligência como seu atributo de conjuração para a magia. Se a magia for um truque ou magia de 1° círculo, você pode conjurá-la de forma confiável. Se o pergaminho contiver uma magia de círculo superior, você deve primeiro ser bem-sucedido em um [[/skill arc]] (CD 10 mais nível da magia). Em um teste bem- sucedido, você conjura a magia do pergaminho. Em caso de falha, pergaminho se desintegra.

Nota do Foundry

Esta característica inclui um Efeito Ativo que automaticamente aumenta o seu máximo de sintonização.

Quando usar a propriedade que gasta cargas, jogue o d6 e desmarque a opção de consumo para usar sem gastar.

Attunement Bonus.name: Bônus de Sintonização
Attunement Bonus.description: A característica Usar Dispositivo Mágico permite você sintonizar até quatro itens ao mesmo tempo.

Devious Strikes.name: Golpes Desleais
Devious Strikes.description:
Você praticou novas maneiras de usar seu Ataque Furtivo de forma desonesta. Os seguintes efeitos passam a fazer parte das suas opções de Golpe Ardiloso.

Tontear (custo: 2d6). O alvo deve ser bem-sucedido uma salvaguarda de Constituição ou, em seu próximo turno só poderá agir de uma das seguintes formas: mover-se, executar uma ação ou uma ação bônus.

Nocautear (custo: 6d6). O alvo deve ser bem-sucedido em uma salvaguarda de Constituição ou ficará sob condição inconsciente por 1 minuto ou até sofrer qualquer dano. O alvo inconsciente repete a salvaguarda ao final de cada um dos seus turnos, encerrando o efeito sobre si em caso de sucesso.

Obscurecer (custo: 3d6). O alvo deve ser bem-sucedido em uma salvaguarda de Destreza ou ficará sob condição &Reference[Blinded] até o fim do próximo turno.

Nota do Foundry

Depois de usar os efeitos do Golpe Ardiloso, use a atividade [[/item Cunning Strike activity=Cunning Sneak Attack]]{Ataque Furtivo Ardiloso}. Isso irá pedir que você selecione quantos dados você gastou nos efeitos e deduz eles do seu Ataque Furtivo automaticamente.

Você pode controlar o tipo de dano na caixa de diálogo da jogada de dano.

A atividade Tontear inclui um Efeito Ativo para rastrear o alvo tonteado, mas ele não automatiza o seu efeito.

A atividade Nocautear inclui um Efeito Ativo que aplica a condição Inconsciente.

A atividade Obscurecer inclui um Efeito Ativo que aplica a condição Cego.

Daze.name: Tontear
Daze.condition: Ao causar dano de Ataque Furtivo

Knock Out.name: Nocautear
Knock Out.condition: Ao causar dano de Ataque Furtivo

Obscure.name: Obscure
Obscure.condition: Ao causar dano de Ataque Furtivo

Devious Strikes: Dazed.name: Golpes Desleais: Tonteado
Devious Strikes: Dazed.description: Em seu próximo turno, o alvo só poderá agir de uma das seguintes formas: mover-se, executar uma ação ou uma ação bônus.

Devious Strikes: Knocked Out.name: Golpes Desleais: Nocauteado
Devious Strikes: Knocked Out.description: O alvo tem a condição inconsciente por 1 minuto ou até sofrer qualquer dano. O alvo inconsciente repete a salvaguarda ao final de cada um dos seus turnos, encerrando o efeito sobre si em caso de sucesso.

Devious Strikes: Blinded.name: Golpes Desleais: Cego
Devious Strikes: Blinded.description: O alvo tem a condição Cego até o fim do próximo turno

Slippery Mind.name: Mente Escorregadia
Slippery Mind.description:
Sua mente perspicaz é excepcionalmente difícil de controlar. Você ganha proficiência nas salvaguardas de Sabedoria e Carisma.

Nota do Foundry

Essas proficiências são concedidas automaticamente quando você passa de nível.

Thief's Reflexes.name: Reflexos de Ladrão
Thief's Reflexes.description: Você é perito em preparar emboscadas e escapar rapidamente do perigo. Você pode agir por dois turnos durante a primeira rodada de qualquer combate. Você age no seu primeiro turno com sua iniciativa normal e no segundo turno com sua iniciativa reduzida em 10.

Robe of Stars.name: Robe of Stars
Robe of Stars.description:
Wondrous Item, Very Rare (Requires Attunement)

This black or dark-blue robe is embroidered with small white or silver stars. You gain a +1 bonus to saving throws while you wear it.

Six stars, located on the robe's upper-front portion, are particularly large. While wearing this robe, you can take a Magic action to remove one of the stars and expend it to cast the level 5 version of @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplMagicMissi]{Magic Missile}. Daily at dusk, 1d6 removed stars reappear on the robe.

While you wear the robe, you can take a Magic action to enter the Astral Plane along with everything you are wearing and carrying. You remain there until you take a Magic action to return to the plane you were on. You reappear in the last space you occupied or, if that space is occupied, the nearest unoccupied space.

Nota do Foundry

The Enter/Exit Astral Plane activity includes a 5 foot measured template that can be used to mark where you exited the Astral Plane for tracking.

Cube of Force.name: Cube of Force
Cube of Force.description:
Wondrous Item, Rare (Requires Attunement)

This cube is about an inch across. Each face has a distinct marking on it. You can press one of those faces, expend the number of charges required for it, and thereby cast the spell associated with it (save DC 17), as shown in the Cube of Force Faces table.

The cube starts with 10 charges, and it regains 1d6 expended charges daily at dawn.

Cube of Force Faces
SpellCharge Cost
@UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplMageArmor0]{Mage Armor}1
@UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplShield0000]{Shield}1
@UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplLeomundsTi]{Tiny Hut}3
@UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbPrivateSanctu]{Private Sanctum}4
@UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplOtilukesRe]{Resilient Sphere}4
@UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplWallofForc]{Wall of Force}5

Mage Armor.name: Armadura Arcana
Mage Armor.description: You touch a willing creature who isn't wearing armor. Until the spell ends, the target's base AC becomes 13 plus its Dexterity modifier. The spell ends early if the target dons armor.

Mage Armor.name: Armadura Arcana
Mage Armor.description: The target's base AC becomes 13 + its Dexterity modifier.

Shield.name: Escudo
Shield.description: An imperceptible barrier of magical force protects you. Until the start of your next turn, you have a +5 bonus to AC, including against the triggering attack, and you take no damage from @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplMagicMissi]{Magic Missile}.
Shield.condition: when you are hit by an attack roll or targeted by the Magic Missile spell

Imperceptible Barrier.name: Imperceptible Barrier
Imperceptible Barrier.description: Until the start of your next turn, you have a +5 bonus to AC, including against the triggering attack, and you take no damage from Magic Missile.

Tiny Hut.name: Tiny Hut
Tiny Hut.description:
A 10-foot Emanation springs into existence around you and remains stationary for the duration. The spell fails when you cast it if the Emanation isn't big enough to fully encapsulate all creatures in its area.

Creatures and objects within the Emanation when you cast the spell can move through it freely. All other creatures and objects are barred from passing through it. Spells of level 3 or lower can't be cast through it, and the effects of such spells can't extend into it.

The atmosphere inside the Emanation is comfortable and dry, regardless of the weather outside. Until the spell ends, you can command the interior to have &Reference[dimlight] or &Reference[darkness] (no action required). The Emanation is opaque from the outside and of any color you choose, but it's transparent from the inside.

The spell ends early if you leave the Emanation or if you cast it again.

Private Sanctum.name: Private Sanctum
Private Sanctum.description:
You make an area within range magically secure. The area is a Cube that can be as small as 5 feet to as large as 100 feet on each side. The spell lasts for the duration.

When you cast the spell, you decide what sort of security the spell provides, choosing any of the following properties:

  • Sound can't pass through the barrier at the edge of the warded area.
  • The barrier of the warded area appears dark and foggy, preventing vision (including &Reference[Darkvision]) through it.
  • Sensors created by Divination spells can't appear inside the protected area or pass through the barrier at its perimeter.
  • Creatures in the area can't be targeted by Divination spells.
  • Nothing can teleport into or out of the warded area.
  • Planar travel is blocked within the warded area.

Casting this spell on the same spot every day for 365 days makes the spell last until dispelled.

Usando Espaços de Magia de Círculo Superior. You can increase the size of the Cube by 100 feet for each spell slot level above 4.

Resilient Sphere.name: Resilient Sphere
Resilient Sphere.description:
A shimmering sphere encloses a Large or smaller creature or object within range. An unwilling creature must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or be enclosed for the duration.

Nothing—not physical objects, energy, or other spell effects—can pass through the barrier, in or out, though a creature in the sphere can breathe there. The sphere is immune to all damage, and a creature or object inside can't be damaged by attacks or effects originating from outside, nor can a creature inside the sphere damage anything outside it.

The sphere is weightless and just large enough to contain the creature or object inside. An enclosed creature can take an action to push against the sphere's walls and thus roll the sphere at up to half the creature's Speed. Similarly, the globe can be picked up and moved by other creatures.

A @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplDisintegra]{Disintegrate} spell targeting the globe destroys it without harming anything inside.

Enclosed in Sphere.name: Enclosed in Sphere
Enclosed in Sphere.description: An enclosed creature can take an action to push against the sphere’s walls and thus roll the sphere at up to half the creature’s Speed.

Wall of Force.name: Wall of Force
Wall of Force.description:
An Invisible wall of force springs into existence at a point you choose within range. The wall appears in any orientation you choose, as a horizontal or vertical barrier or at an angle. It can be free floating or resting on a solid surface. You can form it into a hemispherical dome or a globe with a radius of up to 10 feet, or you can shape a flat surface made up of ten 10-foot-by-10-foot panels. Each panel must be contiguous with another panel. In any form, the wall is 1/4 inch thick and lasts for the duration. If the wall cuts through a creature's space when it appears, the creature is pushed to one side of the wall (you choose which side).

Nothing can physically pass through the wall. It is immune to all damage and can't be dispelled by @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplDispelMagi]{Dissipar Magia}. A @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplDisintegra]{Disintegrate} spell destroys the wall instantly, however. The wall also extends into the Ethereal Plane and blocks ethereal travel through the wall.

Decanter of Endless Water.name: Decanter of Endless Water
Decanter of Endless Water.description:
Wondrous Item, Uncommon

This stoppered flask sloshes when shaken, as if it contains water. The decanter weighs 2 pounds.

You can take a Magic action to remove the stopper and issue one of three command words, whereupon an amount of @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.dmgspWaterfresh0]{fresh water} or @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.dmgspWatersalt00]{salt water} (your choice) pours out of the flask. The water stops pouring out at the start of your next turn. Choose from the following command words:

Splash. The decanter produces 1 gallon of water.

Fountain. The decanter produces 5 gallons of water.

Geyser. The decanter produces 30 gallons of water that gushes forth in a Line 30 feet long and 1 foot wide. If you're holding the decanter, you can aim the geyser in one direction (no action required). One creature of your choice in the Line must succeed on a DC 13 Strength saving throw or take 1d4 Bludgeoning damage and have the &Reference[Prone] condition. Instead of a creature, you can target one object in the Line that isn't being worn or carried and that weighs no more than 200 pounds. The object is knocked over by the geyser.

Geyser.name: Geyser
Geyser.target: One creature or object of your choice in the Line

Bead of Force.name: Bead of Force
Bead of Force.description:
Wondrous Item, Rare

This small black sphere measures 3/4 of an inch in diameter and weighs an ounce. Typically, [[/r 1d4 + 4#Beads of Force]] Beads of Force are found together.

You can take a Magic action to throw the bead up to 60 feet. The bead explodes in a 10-foot-radius Sphere on impact and is destroyed. Each creature in the Sphere must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or take 5d4 Force damage. A sphere of transparent force then encloses the area for 1 minute. Any creature that failed the save and is completely within the area is trapped inside this sphere. Creatures that succeeded on the save or are partially within the area are pushed away from the center of the sphere until they are no longer inside it. Only breathable air can pass through the sphere's wall. No attack or other effect can pass through.

An enclosed creature can take a Utilize action to push against the sphere's wall, moving the sphere up to half the creature's Speed. The sphere can be picked up, and its magic causes it to weigh only 1 pound, regardless of the weight of creatures inside.

Cape of the Mountebank.name: Cape of the Mountebank
Cape of the Mountebank.description:
Wondrous Item, Rare

This cape smells faintly of brimstone. While wearing it, you can use it to cast @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplDimensionD]{Dimension Door} as a Magic action. This property can't be used again until the next dawn.

When you teleport with that spell, you leave behind a cloud of smoke. The space you left is &Reference[LightlyObscured] by that smoke until the end of your next turn.

qsuojT0nn8ZkAY19.chatFlavor: The space you left is &Reference[LightlyObscured] by smoke until the end of your next turn.

Dimension Door.name: Dimension Door
Dimension Door.description:
You teleport to a location within range. You arrive at exactly the spot desired. It can be a place you can see, one you can visualize, or one you can describe by stating distance and direction, such as "200 feet straight downward" or "300 feet upward to the northwest at a 45-degree angle."

You can also teleport one willing creature. The creature must be within 5 feet of you when you teleport, and it teleports to a space within 5 feet of your destination space.

If you, the other creature, or both would arrive in a space occupied by a creature or completely filled by one or more objects, you and any creature traveling with you each take 4d6 Force damage, and the teleportation fails.

Iron Bands.name: Iron Bands
Iron Bands.description:
Wondrous Item, Rare

This rusty iron sphere measures 3 inches in diameter and weighs 1 pound. You can take a Magic action to throw the sphere at a Huge or smaller creature you can see within 60 feet of yourself. As the sphere moves through the air, it opens into a tangle of metal bands.

Make a ranged attack roll with an attack bonus equal to your Dexterity modifier plus your Proficiency Bonus. On a hit, the target has the &Reference[Restrained apply=false] condition until you take a Bonus Action to issue a command that releases it. Doing so or missing with the attack causes the bands to contract and become a sphere once more.

A creature that can touch the bands, including the one Restrained, can take an action to make a DC 20 Strength (Athletics) check to break the iron bands. On a successful check, the item is destroyed, and the Restrained creature is freed. On a failed check, any further attempts made by that creature automatically fail until 24 hours have elapsed.

Once the bands are used, they can't be used again until the next dawn.

Throw Bands.name: Throw Bands
Throw Bands.target: Huge or smaller you can see

Comprehend Languages.name: Comprehend Languages
Comprehend Languages.description: For the duration, you understand the literal meaning of any language that you hear or see signed. You also understand any written language that you see, but you must be touching the surface on which the words are written. It takes about 1 minute to read one page of text. This spell doesn't decode symbols or secret messages.
Comprehend Languages.materials: a pinch of soot and salt

Create or Destroy Water.name: Create or Destroy Water
Create or Destroy Water.description:
You do one of the following:

Create Water. You create up to 10 gallons of clean water within range in an open container. Alternatively, the water falls as rain in a 30-foot Cube within range, extinguishing exposed flames there.

Destroy Water. You destroy up to 10 gallons of water in an open container within range. Alternatively, you destroy fog in a 30-foot Cube within range.

Usando Espaços de Magia de Círculo Superior. You create or destroy 10 additional gallons of water, or the size of the Cube increases by 5 feet, for each spell slot level above 1.
Create or Destroy Water.materials: a mix of water and sand

Detect Magic.name: Detect Magic
Detect Magic.description:
For the duration, you sense the presence of magical effects within 30 feet of yourself. If you sense such effects, you can take the Magic action to see a faint aura around any visible creature or object in the area that bears the magic, and if an effect was created by a spell, you learn the spell's school of magic.

The spell is blocked by 1 foot of stone, dirt, or wood; 1 inch of metal; or a thin sheet of lead.

Disguise Self.name: Disguise Self
Disguise Self.description:
You make yourself—including your clothing, armor, weapons, and other belongings on your person—look different until the spell ends. You can seem 1 foot shorter or taller and can appear heavier or lighter. You must adopt a form that has the same basic arrangement of limbs as you have. Otherwise, the extent of the illusion is up to you.

The changes wrought by this spell fail to hold up to physical inspection. For example, if you use this spell to add a hat to your outfit, objects pass through the hat, and anyone who touches it would feel nothing.

To discern that you are disguised, a creature must take the Study action to inspect your appearance and succeed on an [[/check ability=int skill=inv dc=@attributes.spell.dc]] check against your spell save DC.

Disguised.name: Disfarçado
Disguised.description: Para descobrir que você está disfarçado, uma criatura pode usar uma ação estudar para inspecionar sua aparência, devendo ser bem-sucedida em um [[/check ability=int skill=inv]]{teste de Inteligência (Investigação)} contra sua CD para evitar magia.

Find Familiar.name: Convocar Familiar
Find Familiar.description:
Você passa a contar com os serviços de um familiar, um espírito que assume a forma de um animal à sua escolha: aranha, coruja, corvo, doninha, falcão, gato, lagarto, morcego, polvo, rato, rã, ou outra fera de nível de desafio 0. Aparecendo em um espaço desocupado dentro da distância, o familiar tem as estatísticas da forma escolhida (veja o apêndice B), embora seja um celestial, feérico ou ínfero (à sua escolha) em vez de uma fera. Seu familiar age independentemente de você, mas obedece a seus comandos.

Conexão Telepática. Enquanto seu familiar estiver a até 30 metros de você, você pode se comunicar com ele telepaticamente. Além disso, como uma ação bônus, você pode ver através dos olhos dele e ouvir o que ele ouve até o início do seu próximo turno, ganhando os benefícios de quaisquer sentidos especiais que ele possua.

Por fim, quando conjurar uma magia com distância de toque, seu familiar pode executar o toque por você. Seu familiar deve estar a até 30 metros de você, e deve usar uma reação para executar o toque quando você conjurar a magia.

Combate. O familiar é aliado a você e a seus companheiros. Ele rola sua própria iniciativa e age em seu próprio turno. Um familiar não pode atacar, mas pode usar outras ações normalmente.

Desaparecimento do Familiar. Quando o familiar é reduzido a 0 ponto de vida, ele desaparece. Ele reaparece quando você conjura a magia novamente. Como uma ação mágica, você pode dispensar o familiar temporariamente, para uma dimensão paralela. Alternativamente, você pode dispensá-lo para sempre. Como uma ação mágica, enquanto ele estiver temporariamente dispensado, você pode fazer com que ele reapareça em um espaço desocupado a até 9 metros de você. Sempre que o familiar é reduzido a 0 ponto de vida ou desaparece para a dimensão paralela, ele deixa para trás, no espaço que ocupava, tudo o que estava usando ou carregando.

Apenas um Familiar. Você não pode ter mais de um familiar por vez. Se conjurar esta magia quando já tiver um familiar, você apenas fará com que o familiar adote uma nova forma elegível.
Find Familiar.materials: incenso aceso no valor de 10 PO ou mais, que a magia consome

Fog Cloud.name: Fog Cloud
Fog Cloud.description:
You create a 20-foot-radius Sphere of fog centered on a point within range. The Sphere is &Reference[heavilyobscured]. It lasts for the duration or until a strong wind (such as one created by @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplGustofWind]{Gust of Wind}) disperses it.

Usando Espaços de Magia de Círculo Superior. The fog's radius increases by 20 feet for each spell slot level above 1.

Goodberry.name: Goodberry
Goodberry.description:
@UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbutlMagicalBer]{Ten berries} appear in your hand and are infused with magic for the duration. A creature can take a Bonus Action to eat one berry. Eating a berry restores 1 Hit Point, and the berry provides enough nourishment to sustain a creature for one day.

Uneaten berries disappear when the spell ends.

Heroism.name: Heroísmo
Heroism.description:
Você toca uma criatura voluntária que torna-se imbuída de bravura. Enquanto a magia durar, o alvo está imune a ser amedrontado e ganha uma quantidade de pontos de vida temporários igual ao seu modificador do atributo de conjuração, no início de cada um dos turnos dela. Quando a magia terminar, o alvo perde quaisquer pontos de vida temporários remanescentes derivados desta magia.

Usando Espaços de Magia de Círculo Superior. Ao conjurar esta magia utilizando um espaço de magia de 2º círculo ou superior, você pode escolher uma criatura adicional como alvo para cada círculo do espaço acima do 1º.

Bravery.name: Com Bravura
Bravery.description: A criatura está imune a ser amedrontado e ganha uma quantidade de pontos de vida temporários igual ao seu modificador do atributo de conjuração, no início de cada um dos turnos dela.

Jump.name: Salto
Jump.description:
You touch a willing creature. Uma vez a cada um de seus turnos até a magia terminar, essa criatura pode saltar até 9 metros gastando 3 metros de movimento.

Usando Espaços de Magia de Círculo Superior.Ao conjurar esta magia utilizando um espaço de magia de 2º círculo ou superior, você pode escolher uma criatura adicional como alvo para cada círculo do espaço acima do 1º.

Jump.name: Salto
Jump.description: Uma vez a cada um de seus turnos até a magia terminar, essa criatura pode saltar até 9 metros gastando 3 metros de movimento.

Longstrider.name: Longstrider
Longstrider.description:
You touch a creature. The target's Speed increases by 10 feet until the spell ends.

Usando Espaços de Magia de Círculo Superior. Ao conjurar esta magia utilizando um espaço de magia de 2º círculo ou superior, você pode escolher uma criatura adicional como alvo para cada círculo do espaço acima do 1º.

Longstrider.name: Longstrider
Longstrider.description: The target’s Speed increases by 10 feet until the spell ends.

Protection from Evil and Good.name: Protection from Evil and Good
Protection from Evil and Good.description: Until the spell ends, one willing creature you touch is protected against creatures that are Aberrations, Celestials, Elementals, Fey, Fiends, or Undead. The protection grants several benefits. Creatures of those types have Disadvantage on attack rolls against the target. The target also can't be possessed by or gain the &Reference[Charmed apply=false] or &Reference[Frightened apply=false] conditions from them. If the target is already possessed, Charmed, or Frightened by such a creature, the target has Advantage on any new saving throw against the relevant effect.
Protection from Evil and Good.materials: a flask of Holy Water worth 25+ GP, which the spell consumes

Protected.name: Protegido
Protected.description: Creatures of those types have Disadvantage on attack rolls against the target. The target also can’t be possessed by or gain the &Reference[Charmed apply=false] or &Reference[Frightened apply=false] conditions from them.

Unseen Servant.name: Unseen Servant
Unseen Servant.description:
This spell creates an Invisible, mindless, shapeless, Medium force that performs simple tasks at your command until the spell ends. The servant springs into existence in an unoccupied space on the ground within range. It has AC 10, 1 Hit Point, and a Strength of 2, and it can't attack. If it drops to 0 Hit Points, the spell ends.

Once on each of your turns as a Bonus Action, you can mentally command the servant to move up to 15 feet and interact with an object. The servant can perform simple tasks that a human could do, such as fetching things, cleaning, mending, folding clothes, lighting fires, serving food, and pouring drinks. Once you give the command, the servant performs the task to the best of its ability until it completes the task, then waits for your next command.

If you command the servant to perform a task that would move it more than 60 feet away from you, the spell ends.
Unseen Servant.materials: a bit of string and of wood

Detect Thoughts.name: Detect Thoughts
Detect Thoughts.description:
You activate one of the effects below. Until the spell ends, you can activate either effect as a Magic action on your later turns.

Sense Thoughts. You sense the presence of thoughts within 30 feet of yourself that belong to creatures that know languages or are telepathic. You don't read the thoughts, but you know that a thinking creature is present.

The spell is blocked by 1 foot of stone, dirt, or wood; 1 inch of metal; or a thin sheet of lead.

Read Thoughts. Target one creature you can see within 30 feet of yourself or one creature within 30 feet of yourself that you detected with the Sense Thoughts option. You learn what is most on the target's mind right now. If the target doesn't know any languages and isn't telepathic, you learn nothing.

As a Magic action on your next turn, you can try to probe deeper into the target's mind. If you probe deeper, the target makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, you discern the target's reasoning, emotions, and something that looms large in its mind (such as a worry, love, or hate). On a successful save, the spell ends. Either way, the target knows that you are probing into its mind, and until you shift your attention away from the target's mind, the target can take an action on its turn to make an [[/check ability=int skill=arc dc=@attributes.spell.dc]] check against your spell save DC, ending the spell on a success.

Enlarge/Reduce.name: Enlarge/Reduce
Enlarge/Reduce.description:
For the duration, the spell enlarges or reduces a creature or an object you can see within range (see the chosen effect below). A targeted object must be neither worn nor carried. If the target is an unwilling creature, it can make a Constitution saving throw. On a successful save, the spell has no effect.

Everything that a targeted creature is wearing and carrying changes size with it. Any item it drops returns to normal size at once. A thrown weapon or piece of ammunition returns to normal size immediately after it hits or misses a target.

Enlarge. The target's size increases by one category—from Medium to Large, for example. The target also has Advantage on Strength checks and Strength saving throws. The target's attacks with its enlarged weapons or Unarmed Strikes deal an extra 1d4 damage on a hit.

Reduce. The target's size decreases by one category—from Medium to Small, for example. The target also has Disadvantage on Strength checks and Strength saving throws. The target's attacks with its reduced weapons or Unarmed Strikes deal 1d4 less damage on a hit (this can't reduce the damage below 1).

Enlarged.name: Enlarged
Enlarged.description: The target’s size increases by one category—from Medium to Large, for example. The target also has Advantage on Strength checks and Strength saving throws. The target’s attacks with its enlarged weapons or Unarmed Strikes deal an extra 1d4 damage on a hit.

Reduced.name: Reduced
Reduced.description: The target’s size decreases by one category—from Medium to Small, for example. The target also has Disadvantage on Strength checks and Strength saving throws. The target’s attacks with its reduced weapons or Unarmed Strikes deal 1d4 less damage on a hit (this can’t reduce the damage below 1).

Locate Object.name: Locate Object
Locate Object.description:
Describe or name an object that is familiar to you. You sense the direction to the object's location if that object is within 1,000 feet of you. If the object is in motion, you know the direction of its movement.

The spell can locate a specific object known to you if you have seen it up close—within 30 feet—at least once. Alternatively, the spell can locate the nearest object of a particular kind, such as a certain kind of apparel, jewelry, furniture, tool, or weapon.

This spell can't locate an object if any thickness of lead blocks a direct path between you and the object.

Mirror Image.name: Mirror Image
Mirror Image.description:
Three illusory duplicates of yourself appear in your space. Until the spell ends, the duplicates move with you and mimic your actions, shifting position so it's impossible to track which image is real.

Each time a creature hits you with an attack roll during the spell's duration, roll a [[/r (@flags.dnd-players-handbook.mirrorImages)d6kh1cs>2#Duplicate destroyed]]{d6 for each} of your remaining duplicates. If any of the d6s rolls a 3 or higher, one of the duplicates is hit instead of you, and the duplicate is destroyed. The duplicates otherwise ignore all other damage and effects. The spell ends when all three duplicates are destroyed.

A creature is unaffected by this spell if it has the &Reference[blinded apply=false] condition, &Reference[blindsight], or &Reference[truesight].

Prayer of Healing.name: Prayer of Healing
Prayer of Healing.description:
Up to five creatures of your choice who remain within range for the spell's entire casting gain the benefits of a &Reference[shortrest] and also regain 2d8 Hit Points. A creature can't be affected by this spell again until that creature finishes a Long Rest.

Usando Espaços de Magia de Círculo Superior. The healing increases by 1d8 for each spell slot level above 2.

Healed by Prayer.name: Healed by Prayer
Healed by Prayer.description: A creature can’t be affected by the @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplPrayerofHe] spell again until that creature finishes a Long Rest.

See Invisibility.name: See Invisibility
See Invisibility.description: For the duration, you see creatures and objects that have the &Reference[invisible apply=false] condition as if they were visible, and you can see into the Ethereal Plane. Creatures and objects there appear ghostly.

Suggestion.name: Suggestion
Suggestion.description:
You suggest a course of activity—described in no more than 25 words—to one creature you can see within range that can hear and understand you. The suggestion must sound achievable and not involve anything that would obviously deal damage to the target or its allies. For example, you could say, "Fetch the key to the cult's treasure vault, and give the key to me." Or you could say, "Stop fighting, leave this library peacefully, and don't return."

The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or have the Charmed condition for the duration or until you or your allies deal damage to the target. The Charmed target pursues the suggestion to the best of its ability. The suggested activity can continue for the entire duration, but if the suggested activity can be completed in a shorter time, the spell ends for the target upon completing it.

Pursuing Suggestion.name: Pursuing Suggestion
Pursuing Suggestion.description: The Charmed target pursues the suggestion to the best of its ability. The suggested activity can continue for the entire duration, but if the suggested activity can be completed in a shorter time, the spell ends for the target upon completing it.

Web.name: Teia
Web.description:
You conjure a mass of sticky webbing at a point within range. The webs fill a 20-foot Cube there for the duration. The webs are &Reference[difficultterrain], and the area within them is &Reference[lightlyobscured].

If the webs aren't anchored between two solid masses (such as walls or trees) or layered across a floor, wall, or ceiling, the web collapses on itself, and the spell ends at the start of your next turn. Webs layered over a flat surface have a depth of 5 feet.

The first time a creature enters the webs on a turn or starts its turn there, it must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or have the &Reference[restrained] condition while in the webs or until it breaks free.

A creature Restrained by the webs can take an action to make a [[/check ability=str skill=ath dc=@attributes.spell.dc]] check against your spell save DC. If it succeeds, it is no longer Restrained.

The webs are flammable. Any 5-foot Cube of webs exposed to fire burns away in 1 round, dealing [[/damage 2d4 type=fire]] damage to any creature that starts its turn in the fire.

Fly.name: Fly
Fly.description:
You touch a willing creature. For the duration, the target gains a Fly Speed of 60 feet and can hover. When the spell ends, the target falls if it is still aloft unless it can stop the fall.

Usando Espaços de Magia de Círculo Superior. You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 3.

Revivify.name: Revivify
Revivify.description: You touch a creature that has died within the last minute. That creature revives with 1 Hit Point. This spell can't revive a creature that has died of old age, nor does it restore any missing body parts.
Revivify.materials: a diamond worth 300+ GP, which the spell consumes

Gaseous Form.name: Gaseous Form
Gaseous Form.description:
A willing creature you touch shape-shifts, along with everything it's wearing and carrying, into a misty cloud for the duration. The spell ends on the target if it drops to 0 Hit Points or if it takes a Magic action to end the spell on itself.

While in this form, the target's only method of movement is a Fly Speed of 10 feet, and it can hover. The target can enter and occupy the space of another creature. The target has Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage; it has Immunity to the &Reference[prone apply=false] condition; and it has Advantage on Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution saving throws. The target can pass through narrow openings, but it treats liquids as though they were solid surfaces.

The target can't talk or manipulate objects, and any objects it was carrying or holding can't be dropped, used, or otherwise interacted with. Finally, the target can't attack or cast spells.

Usando Espaços de Magia de Círculo Superior. You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 3.

Gaseous Form.name: Gaseous Form
Gaseous Form.description:
The target’s only method of movement is a Fly Speed of 10 feet, and it can hover. The target can enter and occupy the space of another creature. The target has Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage; it has Immunity to the &Reference[prone apply=false] condition; and it has Advantage on Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution saving throws. The target can pass through narrow openings, but it treats liquids as though they were solid surfaces.

The target can’t talk or manipulate objects, and any objects it was carrying or holding can’t be dropped, used, or otherwise interacted with. Finally, the target can’t attack or cast spells.

SefrisLv01000000.name: Sefris
SefrisLv01000000.description:
Sefris's pickpocketing as a child grew into small burglaries and eventually complex heists, using the dark bond with his fiend to aid his exploits. He'll work for anyone who can throw some coin his way.

Troca de Iniciativa. Imediatamente após rolar iniciativa, você pode trocar sua iniciativa com a de um aliado disposto no mesmo combate. You can't make this swap if you or the ally has the &Reference[Incapacitated] condition.

Traços de Elfo

Tipo de Criatura: Humanoide

Tamanho: Médio (de 1,5 a 1,8 metro de altura).

Deslocamento: 9 metros

Como um elfo, você possui esses traços especiais.

Visão no Escuro. Você tem visão no escuro com distância de 18 metros.

Linhagem Élfica. Você faz parte de uma linhagem que lhe concede habilidades sobrenaturais.

Quando seu personagem atinge os níveis 3 e 5, você aprende uma magia de círculo mais alto, como indicado na tabela. Você sempre tem esta magia preparada. Você pode conjurá-la uma vez sem um espaço de magia, e recupera a habilidade de conjurá-la dessa forma ao final de um descanso longo. Você também pode conjurar a magia usando quaisquer espaços de magia do círculo apropriado que tiver. Inteligência, Sabedoria ou Carisma são seu atributo de conjuração para as magias que você conjura com este traço (escolha o atributo ao selecionar a linhagem).

Becoming a Warlock …

Como um Personagem de 1º Nível

  • Gain all the traits in the Core Warlock Traits table.
  • Gain the Warlock's level 1 features, which are listed in the @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.content24.JournalEntry.phbWarlock000000.JournalEntryPage.znue6EaGDDXgeQb0#class-features]{Warlock Features table}.

Como um Personagem Multiclasse

  • Gain the following traits from the Core Warlock Traits table: Hit Point Die and training with Light armor.
  • Gain the Warlock's level 1 features, which are listed in the Warlock Features table. See the @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.content24.JournalEntry.phbCreatingAChar.JournalEntryPage.vcs4jfEKRxPCsgXm]{multiclassing rules} to determine your available spell slots.
