Mage Hand.name: Mage Hand
Mage Hand.description:
A spectral, floating hand appears at a point you choose within range. The hand lasts for the duration. The hand vanishes if it is ever more than 30 feet away from you or if you cast this spell again.

When you cast the spell, you can use the hand to manipulate an object, open an unlocked door or container, stow or retrieve an item from an open container, or pour the contents out of a vial.

As a Magic action on your later turns, you can control the hand thus again. As part of that action, you can move the hand up to 30 feet.

The hand can't attack, activate magic items, or carry more than 10 pounds.

Otherworldly Leap.name: Salto Sobrenatural
Otherworldly Leap.description:
Pré-requisitos: bruxo de 2º nível ou superior

Você pode conjurar @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplJump000000]{salto} em si mesmo sem gastar um espaço de magia.

Nota do Foundry

Essa característica pode ser usada no lugar da magia salto e inclui um efeito ativo para monitorar.

Jump.name: Salto
Jump.description: Uma vez a cada um de seus turnos até a magia terminar, essa criatura pode saltar até 9 metros gastando 3 metros de movimento.

Dark One's Own Luck.name: A Sorte do Próprio Tenebroso
Dark One's Own Luck.description:
Você pode apelar a seu patrono ínfero para que ele altere o destino a seu favor. Ao fazer um teste de atributo ou salvaguarda, você pode usar esta característica para adicionar 1d10 à sua jogada. Isso pode ser feito após a jogada inicial, porém antes de ela surtir efeito.

Você pode usar esta característica um número de vezes igual ao seu modificador de Carisma (mínimo de 1 vez), mas não pode usá-la mais de uma vez por jogada. Você recupera todos os usos ao final de um descanso longo.

Luck.name: Sorte
Luck.condition: Ao fazer um teste de atributo ou salvaguarda

Devil's Sight.name: Visão Diabólica
Devil's Sight.description:
Pré-requisitos: bruxo de 2º nível ou superior

Você pode ver normalmente em meia-luz e na escuridão, tanto mágica quanto não mágica, a uma distância de até 36 metros de você.

Nota do Foundry

Essa habilidade inclui um Efeito Ativo que lhe concede visão no escuro até 36 metros.

Fire Shield.name: Fire Shield
Fire Shield.description:
Wispy flames wreathe your body for the duration, shedding Bright Light in a 10-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 10 feet.

The flames provide you with a warm shield or a chill shield, as you choose. The warm shield grants you Resistance to Cold damage, and the chill shield grants you Resistance to Fire damage.

In addition, whenever a creature within 5 feet of you hits you with a melee attack roll, the shield erupts with flame. The attacker takes [[/damage 2d8 type=fire]] damage from a warm shield or [[/damage 2d8 type=cold]] damage from a chill shield.
Fire Shield.materials: a bit of phosphorus or a firefly

Warm Shield.name: Warm Shield
Warm Shield.description: Whenever a creature within 5 feet of you hits you with a melee attack roll, the attacker takes [[/damage 2d8 type=fire]] damage.

Chill Shield.name: Chill Shield
Chill Shield.description: Whenever a creature within 5 feet of you hits you with a melee attack roll, the attacker takes [[/damage 2d8 type=cold]] damage.

Wall of Fire.name: Wall of Fire
Wall of Fire.description:
You create a wall of fire on a solid surface within range. You can make the wall up to 60 feet long, 20 feet high, and 1 foot thick, or a ringed wall up to 20 feet in diameter, 20 feet high, and 1 foot thick. The wall is opaque and lasts for the duration.

When the wall appears, each creature in its area makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking 5d8 Fire damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

One side of the wall, selected by you when you cast this spell, deals 5d8 Fire damage to each creature that ends its turn within 10 feet of that side or inside the wall. A creature takes the same damage when it enters the wall for the first time on a turn or ends its turn there. The other side of the wall deals no damage.

Usando Espaços de Magia de Círculo Superior. The damage increases by 1d8 for each spell slot level above 4.

Contact Patron.name: Contatar Patrono
Contact Patron.description:
No passado, você costumava contatar seu patrono por meio de intermediários. Agora você pode se comunicar diretamente; você sempre tem a magia @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplContactOth]{contato extra-planar} preparada. Com essa característica você pode conjurar a magia sem gastar um espaço de magia para contatar seu patrono e, além disso, é automaticamente bem-sucedido na salvaguarda da magia.

Uma vez que conjurar a magia dessa forma, você não poderá fazê-lo novamente até que termine um descanso longo.

Nota do Foundry

A magia é concedida a você automaticamente neste nível, com utilização gratuita.

Contact Other Plane.name: Contact Other Plane
Contact Other Plane.description:
You mentally contact a demigod, the spirit of a long-dead sage, or some other knowledgeable entity from another plane. Contacting this otherworldly intelligence can break your mind. When you cast this spell, make a DC 15 Intelligence saving throw. On a successful save, you can ask the entity up to five questions. You must ask your questions before the spell ends. The DM answers each question with one word, such as "yes," "no," "maybe," "never," "irrelevant," or "unclear" (if the entity doesn't know the answer to the question). If a one-word answer would be misleading, the DM might instead offer a short phrase as an answer.

On a failed save, you take 6d6 Psychic damage and have the &Reference[Incapacitated] condition until you finish a Long Rest. A @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplGreaterRes]{Restauração Maior} spell cast on you ends this effect.

Repelling Blast.name: Explosão Repulsiva
Repelling Blast.description:
Pré-requisitos: bruxo de 2º nível ou superior, um truque de bruxo que cause dano com uma jogada de ataque

Escolha um dos truques de bruxo que exija uma jogada de ataque e que você conheça. Ao atingir uma criatura Grande ou menor com esse truque, você pode empurrar a criatura até 3 metros de distância em linha reta para longe de você.

Repetível. Você pode escolher essa Invocação mais de uma vez. Cada vez que o fizer, escolha um truque elegível diferente.

Nota do Foundry

A atividade Tornar Repulsivo pode ser usada para encantar um truque adicionando Repulsivo como um lembrete.
Repelling Blast.requirements: Truque de bruxo que cause dano com uma jogada de ataque

Repelling Blast.name: Explosão Repulsiva
Repelling Blast.description: Escolha um dos truques de bruxo que exija uma jogada de ataque e que você conheça. Ao atingir uma criatura Grande ou menor com esse truque, você pode empurrar a criatura até 3 metros de distância em linha reta para longe de você.

Geas.name: Geas
Geas.description:
You give a verbal command to a creature that you can see within range, ordering it to carry out some service or refrain from an action or a course of activity as you decide. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or have the &Reference[Charmed apply=false] condition for the duration. The target automatically succeeds if it can't understand your command.

While Charmed, the creature takes [[/damage 5d10 type=psychic]] damage if it acts in a manner directly counter to your command. It takes this damage no more than once each day.

You can issue any command you choose, short of an activity that would result in certain death. Should you issue a suicidal command, the spell ends.

A @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplRemoveCurs]{Remove Curse}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplGreaterRes]{Restauração Maior}, or @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplWish000000]{Wish} spell ends this spell.

Usando Espaços de Magia de Círculo Superior. If you use a level 7 or 8 spell slot, the duration is 365 days. If you use a level 9 spell slot, the spell lasts until it is ended by one of the spells mentioned above.

Under Orders.name: Under Orders
Under Orders.description: While &Reference[Charmed apply=false], the creature takes [[/damage 5d10 type=psyhic]] damage if it acts in a manner directly counter to your command. It takes this damage no more than once each day.

Insect Plague.name: Insect Plague
Insect Plague.description:
Swarming locusts fill a 20-foot-radius Sphere centered on a point you choose within range. The Sphere remains for the duration, and its area is &Reference[LightlyObscured] and &Reference[DifficultTerrain].

When the swarm appears, each creature in it makes a Constitution saving throw, taking 4d10 Piercing damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature also makes this save when it enters the spell's area for the first time on a turn or ends its turn there. A creature makes this save only once per turn.

Usando Espaços de Magia de Círculo Superior.The damage increases by 1d10 for each spell slot level above 5.

Fiendish Resilience.name: Resistência Ínfera
Fiendish Resilience.description:
Escolha um tipo de dano além de energético sempre que terminar um descanso curto ou longo. Você tem Resistência a esse tipo de dano até escolher um tipo diferente com esta característica.

Nota do Foundry

Essa característica inclui um Efeito Ativo para cada tipo de dano, que lhe concederá a Resistência adequada. Aplique e desative os efeitos conforme necessário ao mudar de tipo.

Mystic Arcanum.name: Mystic Arcanum
Mystic Arcanum.description:
Your patron grants you a magical secret called an arcanum. Choose one level 6 Warlock spell as this arcanum.

You can cast your arcanum spell once without expending a spell slot, and you must finish a Long Rest before you can cast it in this way again.

You gain another Warlock spell of your choice that can be cast in this way when you reach Warlock levels 13 (level 7 spell), 15 (level 8 spell), and 17 (level 9 spell). You regain all uses of your Mystic Arcanum when you finish a Long Rest.

Whenever you gain a Warlock level, you can replace one of your arcanum spells with another Warlock spell of the same level.

Mystic Arcanum (6th level).title: Mystic Arcanum (6th level)
Mystic Arcanum (6th level).hint: Choose one level 6 Warlock spell as this arcanum. You can cast your arcanum spell without expending a spell slot, and you must finish a Long Rest before you can cast it this way again.

Mystic Arcanum (7th level).title: Mystic Arcanum (7th level)
Mystic Arcanum (7th level).hint: Choose one level 7 Warlock spell as this arcanum. You can cast your arcanum spell without expending a spell slot, and you must finish a Long Rest before you can cast it this way again.

Mystic Arcanum (8th level).title: Mystic Arcanum (8th level)
Mystic Arcanum (8th level).hint: Choose one level 8 Warlock spell as this arcanum. You can cast your arcanum spell without expending a spell slot, and you must finish a Long Rest before you can cast it this way again.

Mystic Arcanum (9th level).title: Mystic Arcanum (9th level)
Mystic Arcanum (9th level).hint: Choose one level 9 Warlock spell as this arcanum. You can cast your arcanum spell without expending a spell slot, and you must finish a Long Rest before you can cast it this way again.

Create Undead.name: Create Undead
Create Undead.description:
You can cast this spell only at night. Choose up to three corpses of Medium or Small Humanoids within range. Each one becomes a @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.monsters.Actor.OBujQLLPSmlJiZnL]{Ghoul} under your control (see the Livro dos Monstros for its stat block).

As a Bonus Action on each of your turns, you can mentally command any creature you animated with this spell if the creature is within 120 feet of you (if you control multiple creatures, you can command any of them at the same time, issuing the same command to them). You decide what action the creature will take and where it will move on its next turn, or you can issue a general command, such as to guard a particular place. If you issue no commands, the creature takes the &Reference[Dodge] action and moves only to avoid harm. Once given an order, the creature continues to follow the order until its task is complete.

The creature is under your control for 24 hours, after which it stops obeying any command you've given it. To maintain control of the creature for another 24 hours, you must cast this spell on the creature before the current 24-hour period ends. This use of the spell reasserts your control over up to three creatures you have animated with this spell rather than animating new ones.

Usando Espaços de Magia de Círculo Superior.If you use a level 7 spell slot, you can animate or reassert control over four Ghouls. If you use a level 8 spell slot, you can animate or reassert control over five Ghouls or two @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.monsters.Actor.IyIybE5t2adMEVUM]{Ghasts} or @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.monsters.Actor.rbyp54px2D0ql4QK]{Wights}. If you use a level 9 spell slot, you can animate or reassert control over six Ghouls, three Ghasts or Wights, or two @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.monsters.Actor.t8WYD7ak07X7xpx8]{Mummies}. See the Livro dos Monstros for these stat blocks.
Create Undead.materials: one 150+ GP black onyx stone for each corpse

Minor Illusion.name: Minor Illusion
Minor Illusion.description:
You create a sound or an image of an object within range that lasts for the duration. See the descriptions below for the effects of each. The illusion ends if you cast this spell again.

If a creature takes a Study action to examine the sound or image, the creature can determine that it is an illusion with a successful [[/check ability=int skill=inv dc=@attributes.spell.dc]] check against your spell save DC. If a creature discerns the illusion for what it is, the illusion becomes faint to the creature.

Sound. If you create a sound, its volume can range from a whisper to a scream. It can be your voice, someone else's voice, a lion's roar, a beating of drums, or any other sound you choose. The sound continues unabated throughout the duration, or you can make discrete sounds at different times before the spell ends.

Image. If you create an image of an object—such as a chair, muddy footprints, or a small chest—it must be no larger than a 5-foot Cube. The image can't create sound, light, smell, or any other sensory effect. Physical interaction with the image reveals it to be an illusion, since things can pass through it.

Invisibility.name: Invisibility
Invisibility.description:
A creature you touch has the &Reference[invisible apply=false] condition until the spell ends. Esta magia termina mais cedo imediatamente após o alvo fazer uma jogada de ataque, causar dano ou conjurar uma magia.

Usando Espaços de Magia de Círculo Superior. You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 2.

Invisible.name: Invisível
Invisible.description: Esta magia termina mais cedo imediatamente após o alvo fazer uma jogada de ataque, causar dano ou conjurar uma magia.

Hypnotic Pattern.name: Hypnotic Pattern
Hypnotic Pattern.description:
You create a twisting pattern of colors in a 30-foot Cube within range. The pattern appears for a moment and vanishes. Each creature in the area who can see the pattern must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or have the &Reference[charmed apply=false] condition for the duration. While Charmed, the creature has the &Reference[incapacitated apply=false] condition and a Speed of 0.

The spell ends for an affected creature if it takes any damage or if someone else uses an action to shake the creature out of its stupor.

Hypnotized.name: Hypnotized
Hypnotized.description:
While &Reference[charmed apply=false], the creature has the &Reference[incapacitated apply=false] condition and a Speed of 0.

The spell ends for an affected creature if it takes any damage or if someone else uses an action to shake the creature out of its stupor.

Banishment.name: Banishment
Banishment.description:
One creature that you can see within range must succeed on a Charisma saving throw or be transported to a harmless demiplane for the duration. While there, the target has the &Reference[Incapacitated apply=false] condition. When the spell ends, the target reappears in the space it left or in the nearest unoccupied space if that space is occupied.

If the target is an Aberration, a Celestial, an Elemental, a Fey, or a Fiend, the target doesn't return if the spell lasts for 1 minute. The target is instead transported to a random location on a plane (DM's choice) associated with its creature type.

Usando Espaços de Magia de Círculo Superior. You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 4.

Banished.name: Banished
Banished.description:
While there, the target has the &Reference[Incapacitated apply=false] condition. When the spell ends, the target reappears in the space it left or in the nearest unoccupied space if that space is occupied.

If the target is an Aberration, a Celestial, an Elemental, a Fey, or a Fiend, the target doesn’t return if the spell lasts for 1 minute. The target is instead transported to a random location on a plane (DM’s choice) associated with its creature type.

Hold Monster.name: Hold Monster
Hold Monster.description:
Choose a creature that you can see within range. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or have the Paralyzed condition for the duration. At the end of each of its turns, the target repeats the save, ending the spell on itself on a success.

Usando Espaços de Magia de Círculo Superior. You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 5.

Paralyzed.name: Paralisado
Paralyzed.description: At the end of each of its turns, the target repeats the [[/save ability=wis]] save, ending the spell on itself on a success.

Dimension Door.name: Dimension Door
Dimension Door.description:
You teleport to a location within range. You arrive at exactly the spot desired. It can be a place you can see, one you can visualize, or one you can describe by stating distance and direction, such as "200 feet straight downward" or "300 feet upward to the northwest at a 45-degree angle."

You can also teleport one willing creature. The creature must be within 5 feet of you when you teleport, and it teleports to a space within 5 feet of your destination space.

If you, the other creature, or both would arrive in a space occupied by a creature or completely filled by one or more objects, you and any creature traveling with you each take 4d6 Force damage, and the teleportation fails.

Pipes of Haunting.name: Pipes of Haunting
Pipes of Haunting.description:
Wondrous Item, Uncommon

These pipes have 3 charges and regain 1d3 expended charges daily at dawn. You can take a Magic action to play them and expend 1 charge to create an eerie, spellbinding tune. Each creature of your choice within 30 feet of you must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or have the &Reference[Frightened apply=false] condition for 1 minute. A creature that fails the save repeats it at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. A creature that succeeds on its save is immune to the effect of these pipes for 24 hours.

Cloak of Protection.name: Cloak of Protection
Cloak of Protection.description:
Wondrous Item, Uncommon (Requires Attunement)

You gain a +1 bonus to Armor Class and saving throws while you wear this cloak.

Dispel Magic.name: Dispel Magic
Dispel Magic.description:
Choose one creature, object, or magical effect within range. Any ongoing spell of level 3 or lower on the target ends. For each ongoing spell of level 4 or higher on the target, make an ability check using your spellcasting ability (DC 10 plus that spell's level). On a successful check, the spell ends.

Usando Espaços de Magia de Círculo Superior. You automatically end a spell on the target if the spell's level is equal to or less than the level of the spell slot you use.

Remove Curse.name: Remove Curse
Remove Curse.description: At your touch, all curses affecting one creature or object end. If the object is a cursed magic item, its curse remains, but the spell breaks its owner's Attunement to the object so it can be removed or discarded.

Tongues.name: Tongues
Tongues.description: This spell grants the creature you touch the ability to understand any spoken or signed language that it hears or sees. Moreover, when the target communicates by speaking or signing, any creature that knows at least one language can understand it if that creature can hear the speech or see the signing.

SefrisLv17000000.name: Sefris
SefrisLv17000000.description:
Sefris's pickpocketing as a child grew into small burglaries and eventually complex heists, using the dark bond with his fiend to aid his exploits. He'll work for anyone who can throw some coin his way.

Token artwork by Forgotten Adventures.

Background Ability Score Improvement.hint: Seu antecedente permite que você aumente seus valores de Destreza, Constituição e Carisma; aumente um em 2 e outro em 1, ou aumente os três em 1 cada. Nenhum desses aumentos pode elevar um valor acima de 2

Choose Languages.hint: Seu personagem conhece pelo menos três idiomas: Comum e mais dois que você pode escolher na tabela Idiomas Padrão.

Alert.name: Alerta
Alert.description:
Você ganha os seguintes benefícios.

Proficiência em Iniciativa. Ao rolar iniciativa, você pode adicionar seu bônus de proficiência ao resultado.

Troca de Iniciativa. Imediatamente após rolar iniciativa, você pode trocar sua iniciativa com a de um aliado disposto no mesmo combate. You can't make this swap if you or the ally has the &Reference[Incapacitated] condition.

Nota do Foundry

Essa característica adiciona automaticamente o bônus à sua Iniciativa.

Elf, Drow.description:

@Embed[Compendium.dnd5e.content24.JournalEntry.phbAppendixSpeci.JournalEntryPage.phbspDrow0000000 inline classes="free-rules-embed"]

Traços de Elfo

Tipo de Criatura: Humanoide

Tamanho: Médio (de 1,5 a 1,8 metro de altura).

Deslocamento: 9 metros

Como um elfo, você possui esses traços especiais.

Visão no Escuro. Você tem visão no escuro com distância de 18 metros.

Linhagem Élfica. Você faz parte de uma linhagem que lhe concede habilidades sobrenaturais.

Quando seu personagem atinge os níveis 3 e 5, você aprende uma magia de círculo mais alto, como indicado na tabela. Você sempre tem esta magia preparada. Você pode conjurá-la uma vez sem um espaço de magia, e recupera a habilidade de conjurá-la dessa forma ao final de um descanso longo. Você também pode conjurar a magia usando quaisquer espaços de magia do círculo apropriado que tiver. Inteligência, Sabedoria ou Carisma são seu atributo de conjuração para as magias que você conjura com este traço (escolha o atributo ao selecionar a linhagem).

Características de Linhagem Drow
Nível 1Nível 3Nível 5

Transe. Você não precisa dormir, e magia não pode fazer você dormir. Você pode concluir um descanso longo em 4 horas se passar essas horas meditando em transe, durante o qual você se mantém consciente.

Becoming a Warlock …

Como um Personagem de 1º Nível

  • Gain all the traits in the Core Warlock Traits table.
  • Gain the Warlock's level 1 features, which are listed in the @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.content24.JournalEntry.phbWarlock000000.JournalEntryPage.znue6EaGDDXgeQb0#class-features]{Warlock Features table}.

Como um Personagem Multiclasse

  • Gain the following traits from the Core Warlock Traits table: Hit Point Die and training with Light armor.
  • Gain the Warlock's level 1 features, which are listed in the Warlock Features table. See the @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.content24.JournalEntry.phbCreatingAChar.JournalEntryPage.vcs4jfEKRxPCsgXm]{multiclassing rules} to determine your available spell slots.

KTLPtUpPuGbXWiap.hint: Você ganha uma subclasse de bruxo à sua escolha. Uma subclasse é uma especialização que fornece algumas características em certos níveis de bruxo. Pelo resto de sua carreira, você ganha cada característica de sua subclasse que seja de seu nível de bruxo ou inferior.

Eldritch Invocations.title: Invocações Místicas
Eldritch Invocations.hint: Você descobriu Invocações Místicas, fragmentos de conhecimento proibido que lhe conferem uma habilidade mágica permanente ou outros ensinamentos.

Contact Patron.title: Contatar Patrono
Contact Patron.hint: No passado, você costumava contatar seu patrono por meio de intermediários. Agora você pode se comunicar diretamente; você sempre tem a magia contato extra-planar preparada.

Dancing Lights.name: Dancing Lights
Dancing Lights.description:
You create up to four torch-size lights within range, making them appear as torches, lanterns, or glowing orbs that hover for the duration. Alternatively, you combine the four lights into one glowing Medium form that is vaguely humanlike. Whichever form you choose, each light sheds Dim Light in a 10-foot radius.

As a Bonus Action, you can move the lights up to 60 feet to a space within range. A light must be within 20 feet of another light created by this spell, and a light vanishes if it exceeds the spell's range.

Eldritch Invocations.name: Invocações Místicas
Eldritch Invocations.description:
Você descobriu Invocações Místicas, fragmentos de conhecimento proibido que lhe conferem uma habilidade mágica permanente ou outros ensinamentos. You gain one invocation of your choice, such as @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.classes24.Item.phbinvPactTome00]{Pact of the Tome}. Invocations are described in the @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.content24.JournalEntry.phbWarlock000000.JournalEntryPage.FA4hxx49eazhISIt]{Eldritch Invocation Options} section.

Prerequisites. If an invocation has a prerequisite, you must meet it to learn that invocation. For example, if an invocation requires you to be a level 5+ Warlock, you can select the invocation once you reach Warlock level 5.

Replacing and Gaining Invocations. Whenever you gain a Warlock level, you can replace one of your invocations with another one for which you qualify. You can't replace an invocation if it's a prerequisite for another invocation that you have.

When you gain certain Warlock levels, you gain more invocations of your choice, as shown in the Invocations column of the Warlock Features table.

Current Max Eldritch Invocations: [[lookup @scale.warlock.invocations-known]]

You can't pick the same invocation more than once unless its description says otherwise.

Nota do Foundry

You will be prompted for your choices as you level up. The advancement system does not prevent you from taking any invocations so be sure that you meet the requirements before selecting one.

Pact Magic.name: Pact Magic
Pact Magic.description:
Through occult ceremony, you have formed a pact with a mysterious entity to gain magical powers. The entity is a voice in the shadows—its identity unclear—but its boon to you is concrete: the ability to cast spells. See the @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.content24.JournalEntry.phbSpells0000000.JournalEntryPage.mh3akteBDiLegqFK]{rules on spellcasting}. The information below details how you use those rules with Warlock spells, which appear in the @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.content24.JournalEntry.phbSpells0000000.JournalEntryPage.sSzagq8GvYXpfmfs]{Warlock spell list}.

Cantrips. You know two Warlock cantrips of your choice. @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplEldritchBl]{Eldritch Blast} and @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplPrestidigi]{Prestidigitação Arcana} are recommended. Whenever you gain a Warlock level, you can replace one of your cantrips from this feature with another Warlock cantrip of your choice.

When you reach Warlock levels 4 and 10, you learn another Warlock cantrip of your choice, as shown in the Cantrips column of the Warlock Features table.

Current Max Cantrips Known: [[lookup @scale.warlock.cantrips-known]]

Espaços de Magia. The @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.content24.JournalEntry.phbWarlock000000.JournalEntryPage.znue6EaGDDXgeQb0#class-features]{Warlock Features table} shows how many spell slots you have to cast your Warlock spells of levels 1–5. The table also shows the level of those slots, all of which are the same level. You regain all expended Pact Magic spell slots when you finish a Short or Long Rest.

For example, when you're a level 5 Warlock, you have two level 3 spell slots. To cast the level 1 spell Witch Bolt, you must spend one of those slots, and you cast it as a level 3 spell.

Magias Preparadas de 1º Círculo ou Maior. Você prepara a lista de magias de 1° círculo ou maior disponíveis para conjuração com esta característica. To start, choose two level 1 Warlock spells. @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplCharmPerso]{Charm Person} and @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplHex0000000]{Hex} are recommended.

Current Max Prepared Spells: [[lookup @scale.warlock.max-prepared]]

The number of spells on your list increases as you gain Warlock levels, as shown in the Prepared Spells column of the Warlock Features table. Whenever that number increases, choose additional Warlock spells until the number of spells on your list matches the number in the table. The chosen spells must be of a level no higher than what's shown in the table's Slot Level column for your level. When you reach level 6, for example, you learn a new Warlock spell, which can be of levels 1–3.

If another Warlock feature gives you spells that you always have prepared, those spells don't count against the number of spells you can prepare with this feature, but those spells otherwise count as Warlock spells for you.

Mudando Suas Magias Preparadas. Whenever you gain a Warlock level, you can replace one spell on your list with another Warlock spell of an eligible level.

Spellcasting Ability. Charisma is the spellcasting ability for your Warlock spells.

Spellcasting Focus. You can use an Arcane Focus as a Spellcasting Focus for your Warlock spells.

Pact of the Chain.name: Pact of the Chain
Pact of the Chain.description:
You learn the @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplFindFamili]{Find Familiar} spell and can cast it as a Magic action without expending a spell slot.

When you cast the spell, you choose one of the normal forms for your familiar or one of the following special forms: @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.actors24.Actor.mmImp00000000000]{Imp}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.actors24.Actor.mmPseudodragon00]{Pseudodragon}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.actors24.Actor.mmQuasit00000000]{Quasit}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.actors24.Actor.mmSkeleton000000]{Skeleton}, Slaad Tadpole, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.actors24.Actor.mmSphinxOfWonder]{Sphinx of Wonder}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.actors24.Actor.mmSprite00000000]{Sprite}, or @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.actors24.Actor.mmVenomousSnake0]{Venomous Snake}.

Additionally, when you take the Attack action, you can forgo one of your own attacks to allow your familiar to make one attack of its own with its Reaction.

Nota do Foundry

The Summon Familiar activity includes the normal summoning options and the Summon Familiar (Expanded Options) activity includes the additional options.

Thieves' Tools.name: Ferramentas de Ladrão
Thieves' Tools.description:
Atributo: Destreza

Usar: Arrombar uma fechadura (CD 15), ou desarmar uma armadilha (CD 15)

Crowbar.name: Pé de Cabra
Crowbar.description: Using a Crowbar gives you Advantage on Strength checks where the Crowbar's leverage can be applied.

Orb.name: Orb
Orb.description: An @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagArcaneFocus]{Arcane Focus} is bejeweled or carved to channel arcane magic. A Sorcerer, Warlock, or Wizard can use such an item as a Spellcasting Focus.

Book.name: Book
Book.description: A Book contains fiction or nonfiction. If you consult an accurate nonfiction Book about its topic, you gain a +5 bonus to Intelligence (Arcana, History, Nature, or Religion) checks you make about that topic.

Scholar's Pack.name: Scholar's Pack
Scholar's Pack.description: A Scholar's Pack contains the following items: @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagBackpack000]{Mochila}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagBook0000000]{Livro}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagInk00000000]{Tinta}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagInkPen00000]{Ink Pen}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagLamp0000000]{Lamparina}, 10 flasks of @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagOil00000000]{Óleo}, 10 sheets of @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagParchment00]{Pergaminho}, and @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagTinderbox00]{Caixa para Fogo}.

Parchment.name: Parchment
Parchment.description: One sheet of Parchment can hold about 250 handwritten words.

Lamp.name: Lamparina
Lamp.description: A Lamp burns @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagOil00000000]{Óleo} as fuel to cast Bright Light in a 15-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 30 feet.

Ink.name: Ink
Ink.description: Ink comes in a 1-ounce bottle, which provides enough ink to write about 500 pages.

Oil.name: Óleo
Oil.description:
You can douse a creature, object, or space with Oil or use it as fuel, as detailed below.

Dousing a Creature or an Object. When you take the Attack action, you can replace one of your attacks with throwing an Oil flask. Target one creature or object within 20 feet of yourself. The target must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw (DC 8 plus your Dexterity modifier and Proficiency Bonus) or be covered in oil. If the target takes Fire damage before the oil dries (after 1 minute), the target takes an extra [[/damage 5 type=fire]] damage from burning oil.

Dousing a Space. You can take the Utilize action to pour an Oil flask on level ground to cover a 5-foot-square area within 5 feet of yourself. If lit, the oil burns until the end of the turn 2 rounds from when the oil was lit (or 12 seconds) and deals 5 Fire damage to any creature that enters the area or ends its turn there. A creature can take this damage only once per turn.

Fuel. Oil serves as fuel for Lamps and Lanterns. Once lit, a flask of Oil burns for 6 hours in a Lamp or Lantern. That duration doesn't need to be consecutive; you can extinguish the burning Oil (as a Utilize action) and rekindle it again until it has burned for a total of 6 hours.

Tinderbox.name: Caixa para Fogo
Tinderbox.description: A caixa para fogo é um pequeno recipiente contendo sílica, pederneira e uma acendalha (geralmente pano seco embebido em óleo) usada para atear fogo. Suas utilidades incluem, como uma ação bônus, acender vela, lamparina, lanterna ou tocha, bem como qualquer outro objeto com combustível exposto. Acender outros tipos de fogo leva 1 minuto.

Ink Pen.name: Ink Pen
Ink Pen.description: Using Ink, an Ink Pen is used to write or draw.

Eldritch Blast.name: Eldritch Blast
Eldritch Blast.description:
You hurl a beam of crackling energy. Make a ranged spell attack against one creature or object in range. On a hit, the target takes 1d10 Force damage.

Aprimoramento de Truque. The spell creates two beams at level 5, three beams at level 11, and four beams at level 17. You can direct the beams at the same target or at different ones. Make a separate attack roll for each beam.

[[(floor((@details.level+1)/6)+1)]]{Total Beams}

Prestidigitation.name: Sleight of Hand
Prestidigitation.description:
Você cria um efeito mágico dentro da distância da magia. Escolha o efeito dentre as opções abaixo. Se você conjurar esta magia várias vezes, é possível ter três de seus efeitos não instantâneos ativos ao mesmo tempo.

Efeito Sensorial. Você cria um efeito sensorial instantâneo e inofensivo, como uma chuva de faíscas, uma rajada de vento, notas musicais fracas ou um odor característico.

Brincar com Fogo. Você faz com que uma vela, tocha ou pequena fogueira seja imediatamente acesa ou apagada.

Limpo ou Sujo. Você instantaneamente limpa ou suja um objeto que não seja maior que um cubo de 30 centímetros de lado.

Sensação Menor. Você resfria, esquenta ou tempera um cubo de até 30 centímetros de lado feito de material não vivo por 1 hora.

Marca Mágica. Você colore, faz uma pequena marca ou um símbolo aparecer em um objeto ou superfície por 1 hora.

Criação Menor. Você cria uma bugiganga não mágica ou uma imagem ilusória que caiba em sua mão. Ela dura até o fim do seu próximo turno. Uma bugiganga não pode causar dano e não tem valor monetário.

Hex.name: Hex
Hex.description:
You place a curse on a creature that you can see within range. Until the spell ends, you deal an extra 1d6 Necrotic damage to the target whenever you hit it with an attack roll. Also, choose one ability when you cast the spell. The target has Disadvantage on ability checks made with the chosen ability.

If the target drops to 0 Hit Points before this spell ends, you can take a Bonus Action on a later turn to curse a new creature.

Usando Espaços de Magia de Círculo Superior. Your Concentration can last longer with a spell slot of level 2 (up to 4 hours), 3–4 (up to 8 hours), or 5+ (24 hours).
Hex.materials: the petrified eye of a newt

Bonus Hex Damage.name: Bonus Hex Damage
Bonus Hex Damage.condition: whenever you hit the target with an attack roll

Hexed Strength.name: Hexed Strength
Hexed Strength.description: The target has Disadvantage on ability checks made with the chosen ability.

Hexed Dexterity.name: Hexed Dexterity
Hexed Dexterity.description: The target has Disadvantage on ability checks made with the chosen ability.

Hexed Constitution.name: Hexed Constitution
Hexed Constitution.description: The target has Disadvantage on ability checks made with the chosen ability.

Hexed Intelligence.name: Hexed Intelligence
Hexed Intelligence.description: The target has Disadvantage on ability checks made with the chosen ability.

Hexed Wisdom.name: Hexed Wisdom
Hexed Wisdom.description: The target has Disadvantage on ability checks made with the chosen ability.

Hexed Charisma.name: Hexed Charisma
Hexed Charisma.description: The target has Disadvantage on ability checks made with the chosen ability.

Clothes, Traveler's.name: Traje de Viajante
Clothes, Traveler's.description: Traveler's Clothes are resilient garments designed for travel in various environments.

Magical Cunning.name: Astúcia Mágica
Magical Cunning.description:
Você pode executar um rito esotérico por 1 minuto. Ao final dele, você recupera espaços de magia gastos de Magia de Pacto, mas não mais do que um número igual à metade do seu máximo (arredondar para cima). Uma vez que use esta característica, você não poderá fazê-lo no vamente até terminar um descanso longo.

Nota do Foundry

Essa característica inclui um uso gratuito e restaurará o número correto de espaços de magia de Magia do Pacto.

Regain Pact Spell Slots.name: Reganhar Espaços de Magia de Pacto

Agonizing Blast.name: Explosão Agonizante
Agonizing Blast.description:
Pré-requisitos: bruxo de 2º nível ou superior, um truque de bruxo que cause dano

Escolha um dos truques de bruxo que cause dano e que você conheça. Você pode adicionar seu modificador de Carisma às jogadas de dano daquele truque.

Repetível. Você pode escolher essa Invocação mais de uma vez. Cada vez que o fizer, escolha um truque elegível diferente.

Nota do Foundry

A alteração no seu truque terá que ser feita manualmente, adicionando “@abilities.cha.mod” ao campo “Bônus” do dano da sua magia.
Agonizing Blast.requirements: um truque de bruxo que cause dano

Faerie Fire.name: Faerie Fire
Faerie Fire.description:
Objects in a 20-foot Cube within range are outlined in blue, green, or violet light (your choice). Each creature in the Cube is also outlined if it fails a Dexterity saving throw. For the duration, objects and affected creatures shed &Reference[dimlight] in a 10-foot radius and can't benefit from the Invisible condition.

Attack rolls against an affected creature or object have Advantage if the attacker can see it.

Outlined.name: Outlined
Outlined.description:
For the duration, objects and affected creatures shed &Reference[dimlight] in a 10-foot radius and can’t benefit from the Invisible condition.

Attack rolls against an affected creature or object have Advantage if the attacker can see it.

Fiend Patron.name: Patrono Ínfero
Fiend Patron.description:
Faça um acordo com os Planos Inferiores.

Seu pacto extrai os poderes dos Planos Inferiores, os reinos da perdição. Você pode fazer uma barganha com um lorde demônio, como Demogorgon ou Orcus; com um arquidiabo como Asmodeus, com um diabo do fosso, balor, yugoloth ou uma megera da noite muito poderosa. Os objetivos desse patrono são malignos: corromper e destruir todas as coisas, incluindo, em última análise, você, e seu caminho é definido pelo quanto você se esforça para evitar estes objetivos.

Fiend Spells.title: Magias Ínferas
Fiend Spells.hint: A mágica do seu patrono garante que você sempre tenha certas magias preparadas; ao atingir o nível de bruxo especificado na tabela Magias Ínferas, você sempre terá as magias listadas preparadas.

Burning Hands.name: Burning Hands
Burning Hands.description:
A thin sheet of flames shoots forth from you. Each creature in a 15-foot Cone makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking 3d6 Fire damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

Flammable objects in the Cone that aren't being worn or carried start burning.

Usando Espaços de Magia de Círculo Superior. The damage increases by 1d6 for each spell slot level above 1.

Command.name: Command
Command.description:
You speak a one-word command to a creature you can see within range. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or follow the command on its next turn. Choose the command from these options:

Approach. The target moves toward you by the shortest and most direct route, ending its turn if it moves within 5 feet of you.

Drop. The target drops whatever it is holding and then ends its turn.

Flee. The target spends its turn moving away from you by the fastest available means.

Grovel. The target has the Prone condition and then ends its turn.

Halt. On its turn, the target doesn't move and takes no action or Bonus Action.

Usando Espaços de Magia de Círculo Superior. You can affect one additional creature for each spell slot level above 1.

Scorching Ray.name: Scorching Ray
Scorching Ray.description:
You hurl three fiery rays. You can hurl them at one target within range or at several. Make a ranged spell attack for each ray. On a hit, the target takes 2d6 Fire damage.

Usando Espaços de Magia de Círculo Superior. You create one additional ray for each spell slot level above 2.

[[@item.level + 1]]{Total Rays}

Suggestion.name: Suggestion
Suggestion.description:
You suggest a course of activity—described in no more than 25 words—to one creature you can see within range that can hear and understand you. The suggestion must sound achievable and not involve anything that would obviously deal damage to the target or its allies. For example, you could say, "Fetch the key to the cult's treasure vault, and give the key to me." Or you could say, "Stop fighting, leave this library peacefully, and don't return."

The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or have the Charmed condition for the duration or until you or your allies deal damage to the target. The Charmed target pursues the suggestion to the best of its ability. The suggested activity can continue for the entire duration, but if the suggested activity can be completed in a shorter time, the spell ends for the target upon completing it.

Pursuing Suggestion.name: Pursuing Suggestion
Pursuing Suggestion.description: The Charmed target pursues the suggestion to the best of its ability. The suggested activity can continue for the entire duration, but if the suggested activity can be completed in a shorter time, the spell ends for the target upon completing it.

Dark One's Blessing.name: Bênção do Tenebroso
Dark One's Blessing.description: Ao reduzir um inimigo a 0 ponto de vida, você ganha pontos de vida temporários iguais ao seu modificador de Carisma mais seu nível de bruxo (mínimo de 1 ponto de vida temporário). Você também recebe esse benefício se outra criatura reduzir um inimigo a até 3 metros de você a 0 ponto de vida.

heal.condition: Ao reduzir um inimigo a 0 ponto de vida ou outra criatura reduzir um inimigo a até 3 metros de você a 0 ponto de vida

Fiend Spells.name: Magias Ínferas
Fiend Spells.description:
A mágica do seu patrono garante que você sempre tenha certas magias preparadas; ao atingir o nível de bruxo especificado na tabela Magias Ínferas, você sempre terá as magias listadas preparadas.

Magias Ínferas
Nível de BruxoMagias

Nota do Foundry

À medida que você subir de nível, essas magias serão concedidas a você automaticamente.

Darkness.name: Escuridão
Darkness.description:
For the duration, magical &Reference[darkness] spreads from a point within range and fills a 15-foot-radius Sphere. Darkvision can't see through it, and nonmagical light can't illuminate it.

Alternatively, you cast the spell on an object that isn't being worn or carried, causing the Darkness to fill a 15-foot Emanation originating from that object. Covering that object with something opaque, such as a bowl or helm, blocks the Darkness.

If any of this spell's area overlaps with an area of Bright Light or Dim Light created by a spell of level 2 or lower, that other spell is dispelled.
Darkness.materials: bat fur and a piece of coal

Eldritch Mind.name: Mente Mística
Eldritch Mind.description: Você tem vantagem em salvaguardas de Constituição que fizer para manter sua concentração.

Investment of the Chain Master.name: Investimento do Mestre da Corrente
Investment of the Chain Master.description:
Pré-requisitos: bruxo de 5º nível ou superior, Invocação @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.classes24.Item.phbinvPactChain0]{Pacto da Corrente}

When you cast @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplFindFamili]{Find Familiar}, you infuse the summoned familiar with a measure of your eldritch power, granting the creature the following benefits.

Aerial or Aquatic. The familiar gains either a Fly Speed or a Swim Speed (your choice) of 40 feet.

Quick Attack. As a Bonus Action, you can command the familiar to take the Attack action.

Necrotic or Dano Radiante. Whenever the familiar deals Bludgeoning, Piercing, or Slashing damage, you can make it deal Necrotic or Radiant damage instead.

Your Save DC. If the familiar forces a creature to make a saving throw, it uses your spell save DC.

Resistance. When the familiar takes damage, you can take a Reaction to grant it Resistance against that damage.

Nota do Foundry

As atividades Convocar Familiar com Voo e com Natação permitem que você invoque um familiar com o bônus de deslocamento correspondente. Ambas as atividades consomem um espaço de magia de Magia de Pacto.

A atividade Investir em Resistência inclui um Efeito Ativo para resistir a cada tipo de dano, que pode ser aplicado para obter a resistência correspondente. Certifique-se de desativar/excluir o Efeito Ativo anterior na aba “Efeitos” da sua ficha ao alterar as Resistências.

O familiar usa automaticamente sua CD de Salvamento.

Fireball.name: Fireball
Fireball.description:
A bright streak flashes from you to a point you choose within range and then blossoms with a low roar into a fiery explosion. [[lookup @labels.description.affects capitalize]] in a [[lookup @labels.description.template]] centered on that point makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking 8d6 Fire damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

Flammable objects in the area that aren't being worn or carried start burning.

Usando Espaços de Magia de Círculo Superior. The damage increases by 1d6 for each spell slot level above 3.
Fireball.materials: a ball of bat guano and sulfur

Stinking Cloud.name: Stinking Cloud
Stinking Cloud.description:
You create a 20-foot-radius Sphere of yellow, nauseating gas centered on a point within range. The cloud is &Reference[heavilyobscured]. The cloud lingers in the air for the duration or until a strong wind (such as the one created by @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplGustofWind]{Gust of Wind}) disperses it.

Each creature that starts its turn in the Sphere must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or have the &Reference[poisoned apply=false] condition until the end of the current turn. While Poisoned in this way, the creature can't take an action or a Bonus Action.

Stinking Poison.name: Stinking Poison
Stinking Poison.description: While &Reference[poisoned apply=false] in this way, the creature can’t take an action or a Bonus Action.

Bane.name: Bane
Bane.description:
Up to three creatures of your choice that you can see within range must each make a Charisma saving throw. Whenever a target that fails this save makes an attack roll or a saving throw before the spell ends, the target must subtract 1d4 from the attack roll or save.

Usando Espaços de Magia de Círculo Superior. Ao conjurar esta magia utilizando um espaço de magia de 2º círculo ou superior, você pode escolher uma criatura adicional como alvo para cada círculo do espaço acima do 1º.

Bane.name: Bane
Bane.description: Whenever a target makes an attack roll or a saving throw before the spell ends, the target must subtract 1d4 from the attack roll or save.

Fear.name: Fear
Fear.description:
Each creature in a 30-foot Cone must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or drop whatever it is holding and have the &Reference[frightened apply=false] condition for the duration.

A Frightened creature takes the &Reference[dash] action and moves away from you by the safest route on each of its turns unless there is nowhere to move. If the creature ends its turn in a space where it doesn't have line of sight to you, the creature makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a successful save, the spell ends on that creature.

Fear.name: Fear
Fear.description: A &Reference[frightened apply=false] creature takes the &Reference[dash] action and moves away from you by the safest route on each of its turns unless there is nowhere to move. If the creature ends its turn in a space where it doesn’t have line of sight to you, the creature makes a [[/save ability=wis]] saving throw. On a successful save, the spell ends on that creature.

Fly.name: Fly
Fly.description:
You touch a willing creature. For the duration, the target gains a Fly Speed of 60 feet and can hover. When the spell ends, the target falls if it is still aloft unless it can stop the fall.

Usando Espaços de Magia de Círculo Superior. You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 3.

Hideous Laughter.name: Hideous Laughter
Hideous Laughter.description:
One creature of your choice that you can see within range makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, it has the &Reference[prone apply=false] and &Reference[incapacitated apply=false] conditions for the duration. During that time, it laughs uncontrollably if it's capable of laughter, and it can't end the Prone condition on itself.

At the end of each of its turns and each time it takes damage, it makes another [[/save ability=wis dc=@attributes.spell.dc]] saving throw. The target has Advantage on the save if the save is triggered by damage. On a successful save, the spell ends.

Usando Espaços de Magia de Círculo Superior. You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level about 1.

Uncontrollable Laughter.description:
has the &Reference[prone apply=false] and &Reference[incapacitated apply=false] conditions for the duration. During that time, it laughs uncontrollably if it’s capable of laughter, and it can’t end the Prone condition on itself.

At the end of each of its turns and each time it takes damage, it makes another [[/save ability=wis dc=@attributes.spell.dc]] saving throw. The target has Advantage on the save if the save is triggered by damage. On a successful save, the spell ends.

Hold Person.name: Hold Person
Hold Person.description:
Choose a Humanoid that you can see within range. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or have the &Reference[paralyzed apply=false] condition for the duration. At the end of each of its turns, the target repeats the save, ending the spell on itself on a success.

Usando Espaços de Magia de Círculo Superior. You can target one additional Humanoid for each spell slot level above 2.

Paralyzed.name: Paralisado
Paralyzed.description: At the end of each of its turns, the target repeats the [[/save ability=wis]] save, ending the spell on itself on a success.

Wand.name: Wand
Wand.description: An @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagArcaneFocus]{Arcane Focus} is bejeweled or carved to channel arcane magic. A Sorcerer, Warlock, or Wizard can use such an item as a Spellcasting Focus.

Gloves of Thievery.name: Gloves of Thievery
Gloves of Thievery.description:
Wondrous Item, Uncommon

These gloves are imperceptible while worn. While wearing them, you gain a +5 bonus to Dexterity (Prestidigitação) checks.

Nota do Foundry

The Gloves On Active Effect automates the +5 to your Prestidigitação checks.

Potion of Healing.name: Potion of Healing
Potion of Healing.description: This potion is a magic item. As a Bonus Action, you can drink it or administer it to another creature within 5 feet of yourself. The creature that drinks the magical red fluid in this vial regains 2d4 + 2 Hit Points.

Case, Map or Scroll.name: Case, Map or Scroll
Case, Map or Scroll.description: A Map or Scroll Case holds up to 10 sheets of paper or 5 sheets of parchment.

Mage Hand.name: Mage Hand
Mage Hand.description:
A spectral, floating hand appears at a point you choose within range. The hand lasts for the duration. The hand vanishes if it is ever more than 30 feet away from you or if you cast this spell again.

When you cast the spell, you can use the hand to manipulate an object, open an unlocked door or container, stow or retrieve an item from an open container, or pour the contents out of a vial.

As a Magic action on your later turns, you can control the hand thus again. As part of that action, you can move the hand up to 30 feet.

The hand can't attack, activate magic items, or carry more than 10 pounds.

Otherworldly Leap.name: Salto Sobrenatural
Otherworldly Leap.description:
Pré-requisitos: bruxo de 2º nível ou superior

Você pode conjurar @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplJump000000]{salto} em si mesmo sem gastar um espaço de magia.

Nota do Foundry

Essa característica pode ser usada no lugar da magia salto e inclui um efeito ativo para monitorar.

Jump.name: Salto
Jump.description: Uma vez a cada um de seus turnos até a magia terminar, essa criatura pode saltar até 9 metros gastando 3 metros de movimento.

Dark One's Own Luck.name: A Sorte do Próprio Tenebroso
Dark One's Own Luck.description:
Você pode apelar a seu patrono ínfero para que ele altere o destino a seu favor. Ao fazer um teste de atributo ou salvaguarda, você pode usar esta característica para adicionar 1d10 à sua jogada. Isso pode ser feito após a jogada inicial, porém antes de ela surtir efeito.

Você pode usar esta característica um número de vezes igual ao seu modificador de Carisma (mínimo de 1 vez), mas não pode usá-la mais de uma vez por jogada. Você recupera todos os usos ao final de um descanso longo.

Luck.name: Sorte
Luck.condition: Ao fazer um teste de atributo ou salvaguarda

Devil's Sight.name: Visão Diabólica
Devil's Sight.description:
Pré-requisitos: bruxo de 2º nível ou superior

Você pode ver normalmente em meia-luz e na escuridão, tanto mágica quanto não mágica, a uma distância de até 36 metros de você.

Nota do Foundry

Essa habilidade inclui um Efeito Ativo que lhe concede visão no escuro até 36 metros.

Fire Shield.name: Fire Shield
Fire Shield.description:
Wispy flames wreathe your body for the duration, shedding Bright Light in a 10-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 10 feet.

The flames provide you with a warm shield or a chill shield, as you choose. The warm shield grants you Resistance to Cold damage, and the chill shield grants you Resistance to Fire damage.

In addition, whenever a creature within 5 feet of you hits you with a melee attack roll, the shield erupts with flame. The attacker takes [[/damage 2d8 type=fire]] damage from a warm shield or [[/damage 2d8 type=cold]] damage from a chill shield.
Fire Shield.materials: a bit of phosphorus or a firefly

Warm Shield.name: Warm Shield
Warm Shield.description: Whenever a creature within 5 feet of you hits you with a melee attack roll, the attacker takes [[/damage 2d8 type=fire]] damage.

Chill Shield.name: Chill Shield
Chill Shield.description: Whenever a creature within 5 feet of you hits you with a melee attack roll, the attacker takes [[/damage 2d8 type=cold]] damage.

Wall of Fire.name: Wall of Fire
Wall of Fire.description:
You create a wall of fire on a solid surface within range. You can make the wall up to 60 feet long, 20 feet high, and 1 foot thick, or a ringed wall up to 20 feet in diameter, 20 feet high, and 1 foot thick. The wall is opaque and lasts for the duration.

When the wall appears, each creature in its area makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking 5d8 Fire damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

One side of the wall, selected by you when you cast this spell, deals 5d8 Fire damage to each creature that ends its turn within 10 feet of that side or inside the wall. A creature takes the same damage when it enters the wall for the first time on a turn or ends its turn there. The other side of the wall deals no damage.

Usando Espaços de Magia de Círculo Superior. The damage increases by 1d8 for each spell slot level above 4.

Contact Patron.name: Contatar Patrono
Contact Patron.description:
No passado, você costumava contatar seu patrono por meio de intermediários. Agora você pode se comunicar diretamente; você sempre tem a magia @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplContactOth]{contato extra-planar} preparada. Com essa característica você pode conjurar a magia sem gastar um espaço de magia para contatar seu patrono e, além disso, é automaticamente bem-sucedido na salvaguarda da magia.

Uma vez que conjurar a magia dessa forma, você não poderá fazê-lo novamente até que termine um descanso longo.

Nota do Foundry

A magia é concedida a você automaticamente neste nível, com utilização gratuita.

Contact Other Plane.name: Contact Other Plane
Contact Other Plane.description:
You mentally contact a demigod, the spirit of a long-dead sage, or some other knowledgeable entity from another plane. Contacting this otherworldly intelligence can break your mind. When you cast this spell, make a DC 15 Intelligence saving throw. On a successful save, you can ask the entity up to five questions. You must ask your questions before the spell ends. The DM answers each question with one word, such as "yes," "no," "maybe," "never," "irrelevant," or "unclear" (if the entity doesn't know the answer to the question). If a one-word answer would be misleading, the DM might instead offer a short phrase as an answer.

On a failed save, you take 6d6 Psychic damage and have the &Reference[Incapacitated] condition until you finish a Long Rest. A @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplGreaterRes]{Restauração Maior} spell cast on you ends this effect.

Repelling Blast.name: Explosão Repulsiva
Repelling Blast.description:
Pré-requisitos: bruxo de 2º nível ou superior, um truque de bruxo que cause dano com uma jogada de ataque

Escolha um dos truques de bruxo que exija uma jogada de ataque e que você conheça. Ao atingir uma criatura Grande ou menor com esse truque, você pode empurrar a criatura até 3 metros de distância em linha reta para longe de você.

Repetível. Você pode escolher essa Invocação mais de uma vez. Cada vez que o fizer, escolha um truque elegível diferente.

Nota do Foundry

A atividade Tornar Repulsivo pode ser usada para encantar um truque adicionando Repulsivo como um lembrete.
Repelling Blast.requirements: Truque de bruxo que cause dano com uma jogada de ataque

Repelling Blast.name: Explosão Repulsiva
Repelling Blast.description: Escolha um dos truques de bruxo que exija uma jogada de ataque e que você conheça. Ao atingir uma criatura Grande ou menor com esse truque, você pode empurrar a criatura até 3 metros de distância em linha reta para longe de você.

Geas.name: Geas
Geas.description:
You give a verbal command to a creature that you can see within range, ordering it to carry out some service or refrain from an action or a course of activity as you decide. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or have the &Reference[Charmed apply=false] condition for the duration. The target automatically succeeds if it can't understand your command.

While Charmed, the creature takes [[/damage 5d10 type=psychic]] damage if it acts in a manner directly counter to your command. It takes this damage no more than once each day.

You can issue any command you choose, short of an activity that would result in certain death. Should you issue a suicidal command, the spell ends.

A @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplRemoveCurs]{Remove Curse}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplGreaterRes]{Restauração Maior}, or @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplWish000000]{Wish} spell ends this spell.

Usando Espaços de Magia de Círculo Superior. If you use a level 7 or 8 spell slot, the duration is 365 days. If you use a level 9 spell slot, the spell lasts until it is ended by one of the spells mentioned above.

Under Orders.name: Under Orders
Under Orders.description: While &Reference[Charmed apply=false], the creature takes [[/damage 5d10 type=psyhic]] damage if it acts in a manner directly counter to your command. It takes this damage no more than once each day.

Insect Plague.name: Insect Plague
Insect Plague.description:
Swarming locusts fill a 20-foot-radius Sphere centered on a point you choose within range. The Sphere remains for the duration, and its area is &Reference[LightlyObscured] and &Reference[DifficultTerrain].

When the swarm appears, each creature in it makes a Constitution saving throw, taking 4d10 Piercing damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature also makes this save when it enters the spell's area for the first time on a turn or ends its turn there. A creature makes this save only once per turn.

Usando Espaços de Magia de Círculo Superior.The damage increases by 1d10 for each spell slot level above 5.

Fiendish Resilience.name: Resistência Ínfera
Fiendish Resilience.description:
Escolha um tipo de dano além de energético sempre que terminar um descanso curto ou longo. Você tem Resistência a esse tipo de dano até escolher um tipo diferente com esta característica.

Nota do Foundry

Essa característica inclui um Efeito Ativo para cada tipo de dano, que lhe concederá a Resistência adequada. Aplique e desative os efeitos conforme necessário ao mudar de tipo.

Mystic Arcanum.name: Mystic Arcanum
Mystic Arcanum.description:
Your patron grants you a magical secret called an arcanum. Choose one level 6 Warlock spell as this arcanum.

You can cast your arcanum spell once without expending a spell slot, and you must finish a Long Rest before you can cast it in this way again.

You gain another Warlock spell of your choice that can be cast in this way when you reach Warlock levels 13 (level 7 spell), 15 (level 8 spell), and 17 (level 9 spell). You regain all uses of your Mystic Arcanum when you finish a Long Rest.

Whenever you gain a Warlock level, you can replace one of your arcanum spells with another Warlock spell of the same level.

Mystic Arcanum (6th level).title: Mystic Arcanum (6th level)
Mystic Arcanum (6th level).hint: Choose one level 6 Warlock spell as this arcanum. You can cast your arcanum spell without expending a spell slot, and you must finish a Long Rest before you can cast it this way again.

Mystic Arcanum (7th level).title: Mystic Arcanum (7th level)
Mystic Arcanum (7th level).hint: Choose one level 7 Warlock spell as this arcanum. You can cast your arcanum spell without expending a spell slot, and you must finish a Long Rest before you can cast it this way again.

Mystic Arcanum (8th level).title: Mystic Arcanum (8th level)
Mystic Arcanum (8th level).hint: Choose one level 8 Warlock spell as this arcanum. You can cast your arcanum spell without expending a spell slot, and you must finish a Long Rest before you can cast it this way again.

Mystic Arcanum (9th level).title: Mystic Arcanum (9th level)
Mystic Arcanum (9th level).hint: Choose one level 9 Warlock spell as this arcanum. You can cast your arcanum spell without expending a spell slot, and you must finish a Long Rest before you can cast it this way again.

Create Undead.name: Create Undead
Create Undead.description:
You can cast this spell only at night. Choose up to three corpses of Medium or Small Humanoids within range. Each one becomes a @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.monsters.Actor.OBujQLLPSmlJiZnL]{Ghoul} under your control (see the Livro dos Monstros for its stat block).

As a Bonus Action on each of your turns, you can mentally command any creature you animated with this spell if the creature is within 120 feet of you (if you control multiple creatures, you can command any of them at the same time, issuing the same command to them). You decide what action the creature will take and where it will move on its next turn, or you can issue a general command, such as to guard a particular place. If you issue no commands, the creature takes the &Reference[Dodge] action and moves only to avoid harm. Once given an order, the creature continues to follow the order until its task is complete.

The creature is under your control for 24 hours, after which it stops obeying any command you've given it. To maintain control of the creature for another 24 hours, you must cast this spell on the creature before the current 24-hour period ends. This use of the spell reasserts your control over up to three creatures you have animated with this spell rather than animating new ones.

Usando Espaços de Magia de Círculo Superior.If you use a level 7 spell slot, you can animate or reassert control over four Ghouls. If you use a level 8 spell slot, you can animate or reassert control over five Ghouls or two @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.monsters.Actor.IyIybE5t2adMEVUM]{Ghasts} or @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.monsters.Actor.rbyp54px2D0ql4QK]{Wights}. If you use a level 9 spell slot, you can animate or reassert control over six Ghouls, three Ghasts or Wights, or two @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.monsters.Actor.t8WYD7ak07X7xpx8]{Mummies}. See the Livro dos Monstros for these stat blocks.
Create Undead.materials: one 150+ GP black onyx stone for each corpse

Minor Illusion.name: Minor Illusion
Minor Illusion.description:
You create a sound or an image of an object within range that lasts for the duration. See the descriptions below for the effects of each. The illusion ends if you cast this spell again.

If a creature takes a Study action to examine the sound or image, the creature can determine that it is an illusion with a successful [[/check ability=int skill=inv dc=@attributes.spell.dc]] check against your spell save DC. If a creature discerns the illusion for what it is, the illusion becomes faint to the creature.

Sound. If you create a sound, its volume can range from a whisper to a scream. It can be your voice, someone else's voice, a lion's roar, a beating of drums, or any other sound you choose. The sound continues unabated throughout the duration, or you can make discrete sounds at different times before the spell ends.

Image. If you create an image of an object—such as a chair, muddy footprints, or a small chest—it must be no larger than a 5-foot Cube. The image can't create sound, light, smell, or any other sensory effect. Physical interaction with the image reveals it to be an illusion, since things can pass through it.

Invisibility.name: Invisibility
Invisibility.description:
A creature you touch has the &Reference[invisible apply=false] condition until the spell ends. Esta magia termina mais cedo imediatamente após o alvo fazer uma jogada de ataque, causar dano ou conjurar uma magia.

Usando Espaços de Magia de Círculo Superior. You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 2.

Invisible.name: Invisível
Invisible.description: Esta magia termina mais cedo imediatamente após o alvo fazer uma jogada de ataque, causar dano ou conjurar uma magia.

Hypnotic Pattern.name: Hypnotic Pattern
Hypnotic Pattern.description:
You create a twisting pattern of colors in a 30-foot Cube within range. The pattern appears for a moment and vanishes. Each creature in the area who can see the pattern must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or have the &Reference[charmed apply=false] condition for the duration. While Charmed, the creature has the &Reference[incapacitated apply=false] condition and a Speed of 0.

The spell ends for an affected creature if it takes any damage or if someone else uses an action to shake the creature out of its stupor.

Hypnotized.name: Hypnotized
Hypnotized.description:
While &Reference[charmed apply=false], the creature has the &Reference[incapacitated apply=false] condition and a Speed of 0.

The spell ends for an affected creature if it takes any damage or if someone else uses an action to shake the creature out of its stupor.

Banishment.name: Banishment
Banishment.description:
One creature that you can see within range must succeed on a Charisma saving throw or be transported to a harmless demiplane for the duration. While there, the target has the &Reference[Incapacitated apply=false] condition. When the spell ends, the target reappears in the space it left or in the nearest unoccupied space if that space is occupied.

If the target is an Aberration, a Celestial, an Elemental, a Fey, or a Fiend, the target doesn't return if the spell lasts for 1 minute. The target is instead transported to a random location on a plane (DM's choice) associated with its creature type.

Usando Espaços de Magia de Círculo Superior. You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 4.

Banished.name: Banished
Banished.description:
While there, the target has the &Reference[Incapacitated apply=false] condition. When the spell ends, the target reappears in the space it left or in the nearest unoccupied space if that space is occupied.

If the target is an Aberration, a Celestial, an Elemental, a Fey, or a Fiend, the target doesn’t return if the spell lasts for 1 minute. The target is instead transported to a random location on a plane (DM’s choice) associated with its creature type.

Hold Monster.name: Hold Monster
Hold Monster.description:
Choose a creature that you can see within range. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or have the Paralyzed condition for the duration. At the end of each of its turns, the target repeats the save, ending the spell on itself on a success.

Usando Espaços de Magia de Círculo Superior. You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 5.

Paralyzed.name: Paralisado
Paralyzed.description: At the end of each of its turns, the target repeats the [[/save ability=wis]] save, ending the spell on itself on a success.

Dimension Door.name: Dimension Door
Dimension Door.description:
You teleport to a location within range. You arrive at exactly the spot desired. It can be a place you can see, one you can visualize, or one you can describe by stating distance and direction, such as "200 feet straight downward" or "300 feet upward to the northwest at a 45-degree angle."

You can also teleport one willing creature. The creature must be within 5 feet of you when you teleport, and it teleports to a space within 5 feet of your destination space.

If you, the other creature, or both would arrive in a space occupied by a creature or completely filled by one or more objects, you and any creature traveling with you each take 4d6 Force damage, and the teleportation fails.

Pipes of Haunting.name: Pipes of Haunting
Pipes of Haunting.description:
Wondrous Item, Uncommon

These pipes have 3 charges and regain 1d3 expended charges daily at dawn. You can take a Magic action to play them and expend 1 charge to create an eerie, spellbinding tune. Each creature of your choice within 30 feet of you must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or have the &Reference[Frightened apply=false] condition for 1 minute. A creature that fails the save repeats it at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. A creature that succeeds on its save is immune to the effect of these pipes for 24 hours.

Cloak of Protection.name: Cloak of Protection
Cloak of Protection.description:
Wondrous Item, Uncommon (Requires Attunement)

You gain a +1 bonus to Armor Class and saving throws while you wear this cloak.

Dispel Magic.name: Dispel Magic
Dispel Magic.description:
Choose one creature, object, or magical effect within range. Any ongoing spell of level 3 or lower on the target ends. For each ongoing spell of level 4 or higher on the target, make an ability check using your spellcasting ability (DC 10 plus that spell's level). On a successful check, the spell ends.

Usando Espaços de Magia de Círculo Superior. You automatically end a spell on the target if the spell's level is equal to or less than the level of the spell slot you use.

Remove Curse.name: Remove Curse
Remove Curse.description: At your touch, all curses affecting one creature or object end. If the object is a cursed magic item, its curse remains, but the spell breaks its owner's Attunement to the object so it can be removed or discarded.

Tongues.name: Tongues
Tongues.description: This spell grants the creature you touch the ability to understand any spoken or signed language that it hears or sees. Moreover, when the target communicates by speaking or signing, any creature that knows at least one language can understand it if that creature can hear the speech or see the signing.

Mask of Many Faces.name: Máscara das Muitas Faces
Mask of Many Faces.description:
Pré-requisitos: bruxo de 2º nível ou superior

Você pode conjurar @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplDisguiseSe]{disfarçar-se} sem gastar um espaço de magia.

Nota do Foundry

A atividade Conjurar pode ser usada no lugar de “Disfarçar-se” e inclui um Efeito Ativo para monitorar quando você está disfarçado.

Disguised.name: Disfarçado
Disguised.description: Para descobrir que você está disfarçado, uma criatura pode usar uma ação estudar para inspecionar sua aparência, devendo ser bem-sucedida em um [[/check ability=int skill=inv]]{teste de Inteligência (Investigação)} contra sua CD para evitar magia.

Forcecage.name: Forcecage
Forcecage.description:
An immobile, Invisible, Cube-shaped prison composed of magical force springs into existence around an area you choose within range. The prison can be a cage or a solid box, as you choose.

A prison in the shape of a cage can be up to 20 feet on a side and is made from 1/2-inch diameter bars spaced 1/2 inch apart. A prison in the shape of a box can be up to 10 feet on a side, creating a solid barrier that prevents any matter from passing through it and blocking any spells cast into or out from the area.

When you cast the spell, any creature that is completely inside the cage's area is trapped. Creatures only partially within the area, or those too large to fit inside it, are pushed away from the center of the area until they are completely outside it.

A creature inside the cage can't leave it by nonmagical means. If the creature tries to use teleportation or interplanar travel to leave, it must first make a [[/save ability=cha dc=@attributes.spell.dc format=long]]. On a successful save, the creature can use that magic to exit the cage. On a failed save, the creature doesn't exit the cage and wastes the spell or effect. The cage also extends into the Ethereal Plane, blocking ethereal travel.

This spell can't be dispelled by Dispel Magic.
Forcecage.materials: ruby dust worth 1,500+ GP, which the spell consumes

Hurl Through Hell.name: Lançar no Inferno
Hurl Through Hell.description:
Uma vez por turno, ao atingir uma criatura com uma jogada de ataque, você pode tentar transportar instantaneamente o alvo pelos Planos Inferiores. O alvo deve ser bem-sucedido em uma salvaguarda de Carisma contra sua CD para evitar magia, ou o alvo desaparece e é lançado em uma paisagem de pesadelos. O alvo sofre 8d10 pontos de dano psíquico se não for um ínfero, e fica com a condição &Reference[Incapacitated] até o fim do seu próximo turno, quando retorna ao espaço que ocupava anteriormente ou ao espaço desocupado mais próximo.

Uma vez que use essa característica, você não poderá fazê-lo novamente até terminar um descanso longo, a menos que gaste um espaço de magia de Magia de Pacto (nenhuma ação necessária) para restaurar este uso.

Nota do Foundry

Essa característica inclui um uso limitado.

A atividade Recuperar Uso consumirá um espaço de magia de Magia do Pacto e restaurará um uso dessa característica.

Hurl Through Hell.name: Lançar no Inferno
Hurl Through Hell.condition: Uma vez por turno, ao atingir uma criatura com uma jogada de ataque

Witch Sight.name: Visão da Bruxa
Witch Sight.description:
Pré-requisitos: bruxo de 15º nível ou superior

Você tem Visão Verdadeira até uma distância de 9 metros.

Nota do Foundry

Essa característica inclui um Efeito Ativo que concede automaticamente Visão Verdadeira a você.

Dominate Monster.name: Dominate Monster
Dominate Monster.description:
One creature you can see within range must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or have the &Reference[Charmed apply=false] condition for the duration. The target has Advantage on the save if you or your allies are fighting it. Whenever the target takes damage, it repeats the save, ending the spell on itself on a success.

You have a telepathic link with the Charmed target while the two of you are on the same plane of existence. On your turn, you can use this link to issue commands to the target (no action required), such as "Attack that creature," "Move over there," or "Fetch that object." The target does its best to obey on its turn. If it completes an order and doesn't receive further direction from you, it acts and moves as it likes, focusing on protecting itself.

You can command the target to take a Reaction but must take your own Reaction to do so.

Usando Espaços de Magia de Círculo Superior. Your Concentration can last longer with a level 9 spell slot (up to 8 hours).

Dominated.name: Dominated
Dominated.description: Whenever the target takes damage, it repeats the [[/save ability=wis]] save, ending the spell on itself on a success.

True Polymorph.name: True Polymorph
True Polymorph.description:
Choose one creature or nonmagical object that you can see within range. The creature shape-shifts into a different creature or a nonmagical object, or the object shape-shifts into a creature (the object must be neither worn nor carried). The transformation lasts for the duration or until the target dies or is destroyed, but if you maintain Concentration on this spell for the full duration, the spell lasts until dispelled.

An unwilling creature can make a Wisdom saving throw, and if it succeeds, it isn't affected by this spell.

Creature into Creature. If you turn a creature into another kind of creature, the new form can be any kind you choose that has a Challenge Rating equal to or less than the target's Challenge Rating or level. The target's game statistics are replaced by the stat block of the new form, but it retains its Hit Points, Hit Point Dice, alignment, and personality.

The target gains a number of Temporary Hit Points equal to the Hit Points of the new form. These Temporary Hit Points vanish if any remain when the spell ends.
